cards.lore: “‘...the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam....'”

fields.title: Der Eine Ring
fields.subtitle: Isildurs Fluch
fields.lore: "...doch der Ring glitt von seinem Finger, als er schwamm...“

fields.title: El Anillo Único
fields.subtitle: El Daño de Isildur
fields.lore: “...el Anillo se le salió del dedo mientras nadaba...”

fields.title: L'Anneau Unique
fields.subtitle: Fléau d'Isildur
fields.lore: “‘...l'Anneau glissa de son doigt tandis qu'il nageait....'”

fields.title: L'Unico Anello
fields.subtitle: Flagello di Isildur
fields.lore: “‘...mentre nuotava l'Anello gli scivolò dal dito....'”

fields.lore: “One Ring to rule them all....”

fields.title: Der Eine Ring
fields.subtitle: der Meisterring
fields.lore: "Ein Ring, sie zu knechten...“

fields.title: El Anillo Único
fields.subtitle: El Anillo Soberano
fields.lore: “Un Anillo para gobernarlos a todos...”

fields.title: L'Anneau Unique
fields.subtitle: L'Anneau Souverain
fields.lore: “Un Anneau pour les gouverner tous....”

fields.title: L'Unico Anello
fields.subtitle: L'Anello Dominante
fields.lore: “Un Anello per domarli...”

cards.title: Axe Strike
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +3 if bearing a [DWARVEN] hand weapon).
cards.lore: Though Gimli's words were praised by the Lady of Light, he proved his best skill was swinging his axe.

fields.title: Axe Strike
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +3 if bearing an axe).
fields.lore: Though Gimli's words were praised by the Lady of Light, he proved his best skill was swinging his axe.

fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +3 if bearing a [DWARVEN] hand weapon).

fields.title: Axthieb
fields.lore: Obwohl Gimlis Worte von der Herrin des Lichts wohlwollend aufgenommen wurden, bewies er sein größtes Talent im Umgang mit der Axt.

fields.title: Golpe de Hacha
fields.lore: A pesar de que las palabras de Gimli fueron alabadas por la Dama de la Luz, él demostró que su mejor habilidad era golpear con su hacha.

fields.title: Coup de Hache
fields.lore: Même si les paroles de Gimli furent louées par la Dame Blanche, il prouva que son meilleur talent était le balancement de sa hache.

fields.title: Colpo d'Ascia
fields.lore: Sebbene la parole di Gimli fossero elogiate dalla Dama della Luce, lui aveva dimostrato che la sua migliore capacità era di far roteare la sua ascia.

cards.title: Battle Fury
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1.
cards.lore: The Dwarves quickly dispatch Orcs and Uruk-hai with their mighty battle axes.

fields.title: Battle Fury
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1.
fields.lore: The Dwarves quickly dispatch Orcs and Uruk-hai with their mighty battle axes.

fields.title: Kampfrausch
fields.lore: Zwerge erschlagen Orks und Uruk-hai kurzerhand mit ihren gewaltigen Streitäxten.

fields.title: Furia de Batalla
fields.lore: Los Enanos despachan Orcos y Uruk-hai rápidamente con sus poderosas hachas de batalla.

fields.title: Fureur de la Bataille
fields.lore: Les Nains expédièrent rapidement Orques et Ourouk-Haï avec leurs puissantes haches de bataille.

fields.title: Furia della Battaglia
fields.lore: I Nani uccidono velocemente Orchi ed Uruk-hai con le loro potenti asce da battaglia.

cards.title: Cleaving Blow
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.
cards.lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.

fields.title: Cleaving Blow
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.
fields.lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.

fields.title: Cleaving Blow
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.  Discard a Shadow item borne by a minion that Dwarf is skirmishing.

fields.title: Spaltender Schlag
fields.lore: Die minderwertige Arbeit eines Orkschmieds kann dem Zorn von Durins Volk nicht widerstehen.

fields.title: Golpe Cortante
fields.lore: La artesanía de pacotilla de los herreros Orcos no puede resistir la furia de la Gente de Durin.

fields.title: Coup Tranchant
fields.lore: Les médiocres talents des forgerons Orques ne peuvent pas résister à la fureur du peuple de Durin.

fields.title: Colpo Devastante
fields.lore: La scadente lavorazione di un fabbro Orco non può sostenere la furia della gente di Durin.

cards.title: Delving
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion to draw 3 cards.
cards.lore: “‘...they delved too greedily and too deep, and disturbed that from which they fled, Durin's Bane.'”

fields.title: Delving
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion to draw 3 cards.
fields.lore: “‘...they delved too greedily and too deep, and disturbed that from which they fled, Durin's Bane.'”

fields.title: Ausschachten
fields.lore: "...sie gruben zu gierig und zu tief und störten das auf, wovor sie flohen: Durins Fluch.“

fields.title: Cavar
fields.lore: “...que cavaron con demasiada codicia, demasiado abajo, y perturbaron aquello de que huían, el Daño de Durin.”

fields.title: Fouilles
fields.lore: “‘...ils creusèrent avec trop d'avidité et allèrent trop profondément, et ils dérangèrent ainsi ce qu'ils fuyaient, le Fléau de Durin.'”

fields.title: Scavare
fields.lore: “‘...scavarono troppo avidamente e troppo in profondità, disturbando ciò da cui fuggivano, il Flagello di Durin.'”

cards.title: Dwarf Guard
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf.
cards.lore: Dwarves from Dáin's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.

fields.title: Dwarf Guard
fields.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf.
fields.lore: Dwarves from Dáin's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.

fields.title: Zwergenwache
fields.lore: Zwerge aus Dáins Volk sind gute Gefährten, loyal und vertrauenswürdig.

fields.title: Guardián Enano
fields.lore: Los Enanos de la gente de Dain son compañeros recios, leales y dignos de confianza.

fields.title: Garde Nain
fields.lore: Les Nains du peuple de Dáin sont de vaillants compagnons, dignes de confiance et loyaux.

fields.title: Guardia dei Nani
fields.lore: I Nani del popolo di Dáin sono compagni coraggiosi, fidati e leali.

cards.title: Dwarven Armor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
cards.lore: The strongest armour still being made in Middle-earth is forged by Dwarves. It is so heavy that only they can bear it.

fields.title: Dwarven Armor
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
fields.lore: The strongest armour still being made in Middle-earth is forged by Dwarves. It is so heavy that only they can bear it.

fields.title: Zwergenrüstung
fields.lore: Die stärksten Rüstungen in Mittelerde werden von den Zwergen geschmiedet. Sie sind so schwer, dass nur Zwerge sie tragen können.

fields.title: Armadura Enana
fields.lore: La armadura mas fuerte que todavía se fabrica en la Tierra Media es forjada por Enanos. Es tan pesada que solo ellos pueden llevarla.

fields.title: Armure Naine
fields.lore: La plus robuste des armures jamais faite en Terre du Milieu fut forgée par les Nains. Elle est si lourde qu'eux seuls peuvent la porter.

fields.title: Armatura dei Nani
fields.lore: La più forte armatura ancora esistente nella Terra di Mezzo è stata forgiata dai Nani. È così pesante che solo loro la possono indossare.

cards.title: Dwarven Axe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a player's minion loses a skirmish to bearer, that player discards the top card from his draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'”

fields.title: Dwarven Axe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a player's minion loses a skirmish to bearer, that player discards the top card from his draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'”

fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a minion loses a skirmish to bearer, that minion's owner must exert a minion or discard the bottom card of their draw deck.

fields.title: Dwarven Axe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a minion loses a skirmish to bearer, you may make a minion strength -1 until the regroup phase. The Shadow player may discard 2 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.

fields.title: Zwergenaxt
fields.lore: "Von Panzerhemden, Schild und Speer / Die Borte in den Kammern schwer.“

fields.title: Hacha Enana
fields.lore: “y la espada y la lanza brillantes / el escudo, la malla y el hacha.”

fields.title: Hache Naine
fields.lore: “‘Le bouclier et le corselet, la hache et l'épée, / Et les lances brillantes étaient couchées en amas.'”

fields.title: Ascia dei Nani
fields.lore: “‘Scudi e corazze, asce, spade pugnali / E fiammanti speroni come non se ne fabbricano d'uguali.'”

cards.title: Dwarven Heart
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. When you play this condition, heal bearer up to 2 times. At the start of each of your turns, exert bearer.
cards.lore: “‘...a Dwarf goes on, be the burden twice his own weight....'”

fields.title: Dwarven Heart
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Dwarf. When you play this condition, heal bearer up to 2 times. At the start of each of your turns, exert bearer.
fields.lore: “‘...a Dwarf goes on, be the burden twice his own weight....'”

fields.title: Das Herz eines Zwergs
fields.lore: "...während ein Zwerg weitergeht, und sei die Last auch das Doppelte seines Eigengewichts...“

fields.title: Corazón Enano
fields.lore: “...pero un Enano nunca cae, aunque lleve una carga dos veces mas pesada que el mismo...”

fields.title: Courage Nain
fields.lore: “‘...un Nain va toujours, le fardeau fut-il deux fois plus lourd que lui....'”

fields.title: Cuore dei Nani
fields.lore: “‘...mentre quelle dei Nani avanzano senza indugio, anche con un fardello due volte più pesante di loro....'”

cards.title: Farin
cards.subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.
cards.lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.

fields.title: Farin
fields.subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
fields.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.
fields.lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.

fields.subtitle: Gesandter der Zwerge
fields.lore: Unter der Gefolgschaft, welche die Zwerge vom Einsamen Berg zum Rat von Elrond geschickt hatten, war Farin, ein junger, aber weiser Zwerg und ein gefürchteter Kämpfer.

fields.subtitle: Emisario Enano
fields.lore: Entre los enviados para representar a los Enanos de Erebor en el Concilio de Elrond estaba Farin, un joven pero sabio Enano, y un fiero enemigo en la batalla.

fields.subtitle: Émissaire Nain
fields.lore: Parmi les diplomates envoyés pour représenter les Nains d'Erebor au Conseil d'Elrond se trouvait Farin, un Nain jeune mais sage, et un ennemi acharné dans la bataille.

fields.subtitle: Emissario dei Nani
fields.lore: Tra gli emissari mandati a rappresentare i Nani di Erebor al Consiglio di Elrond c'era Farin, un giovane ma saggio Nano, e un feroce nemico in battaglia.

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck.
cards.lore: “Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.”

fields.title: Gimli
fields.subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Fellowship: Add (2) to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck.
fields.lore: “Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.”

Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) and place a card from hand beneath your draw deck to draw a card.

fields.subtitle: Zwerg vom Erebor
fields.lore: Gimli ging jetzt mit dem Zauberer voraus, so begierig war er, nach Moria zu kommen.

fields.subtitle: Enano de Erebor
fields.lore: “Gimli caminaba ahora delante junto al mago, tan ansioso estaba de llegar a Moria.”

fields.subtitle: Nain d'Erebor
fields.lore: “Gimli marchait à présent en tête à côté du magicien, tant il était impatient d'arriver dans la Moria.”

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Son of Gloin
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make him strength +2.
cards.lore: “There was a younger dwarf at Glóin's side: his son Gimli.”

fields.title: Gimli
fields.subtitle: Son of Gloin
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make him strength +2.
fields.lore: “There was a younger dwarf at Glóin's side: his son Gimli.”

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Glóin
fields.lore: Da war ein jüngerer Zwerg an Glóins Seite: sein Sohn Gimli.

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Gloin
fields.lore: “Había un Enano joven junto a Gloin: su hijo Gimli.”

fields.subtitle: Fils de Glóin
fields.lore: “À côté de Glóin se trouvait un jeune Nain: son fils Gimli.”

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Glóin
fields.lore: “C'era un Nano più giovane al fianco di Glóin: suo figlio Gimli.”

cards.title: Gimli's Battle Axe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound an Orc.
cards.lore: “Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe.”

fields.title: Gimli's Battle Axe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound an Orc.
fields.lore: “Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe.”

fields.title: Gimlis Streitaxt
fields.lore: Neben ihnen stand Gimli breitbeinig da und schwang seine Zwergenaxt.

fields.title: Hacha de Batalla de Gimli
fields.lore: “Gimli estaba de pie junto a ellos, las piernas separadas, esgrimiendo su hacha de enano.”

fields.title: Hache de Bataille de Gimli
fields.lore: “À leur côté, Gimli, ses fortes jambes écartées, maniait sa hache de Nain.”

fields.title: Ascia da Battaglia di Gimli
fields.lore: “Lì vicino Gimli roteava la sua ascia di Nano, ben piantato sulle robuste gambe divaricate.”

cards.title: Gimli's Helm
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to prevent all wounds to him.
cards.lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.

fields.title: Gimli's Helm
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to prevent all wounds to him.
fields.lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.

fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to make Gimli unable to take wounds.

fields.title: Gimlis Helm
fields.lore: Ein Helm, angefertigt unter dem Einsamen Berg, schützt den Kopf von Gimli, dem Zwerg.

fields.title: Yelmo de Gimli
fields.lore: Un yelmo hecho bajo la Montaña Solitaria protege la cabeza de Gimli el Enano.

fields.title: Heaume de Gimli
fields.lore: Un heaume fabriqué sous le Mont Solitaire protège la tête de Gimli le Nain.

fields.title: Elmo di Gimli
fields.lore: Un elmo, forgiato sotto la Montagna Solitaria, protegge la testa di Gimli il Nano.

cards.title: Greatest Kingdom of My People
cards.gameText: Tale. Exert a Dwarf to play this condition. Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays an Orc, that player discards the top card of his or her draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'”

fields.title: Greatest Kingdom of My People
fields.gameText: Tale. Exert a Dwarf to play this condition. Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays an Orc, that player discards the top card of his or her draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'”

fields.gameText: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. The first time your opponent plays an Orc each turn, you may take a [DWARVEN] card into hand from your discard pile. The Shadow player may discard the bottom 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

fields.title: Das größte Königreich meines Volkes
fields.lore: "Mit Gold verziert und Edelstein und silbern köstlich ausgelegt, das Tor von Runenkraft geprägt.“

fields.title: El Reino Más Grande de Mi Gente
fields.lore: “Y runas poderosas en la puerta, / de bóvedas de oro y de suelo de plata.”

fields.title: Le Plus Grand Royaume de mon Peuple
fields.lore: “‘Avec des toits d'or et des parquets d'argent / Et des runes de puissance sur la porte.'”

fields.title: Il più Grande Regno del Mio Popolo
fields.lore: “‘Sul suo capo i soffitti d'argento/ Su porte le rune del potere, e d'oro il pavimento.'”

cards.title: Grimir
cards.subtitle: Dwarven Elder
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Grimir to shuffle a [DWARVEN] event from your discard pile into your draw deck.
cards.lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.

fields.title: Grimir
fields.subtitle: Dwarven Elder
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Grimir to shuffle a [DWARVEN] event from your discard pile into your draw deck.
fields.lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.

fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Grimir and discard the top card of your draw deck to place a [DWARVEN] event from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

fields.title: Grimir
fields.subtitle: Dwarven Elder
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a [dwarven] companion and exert Grimir to play a [dwarven] event from your discard pile, then remove it from the game.
Skirmish: Spot a [DWARVEN] companion and exert Grimir twice to play a [DWARVEN] skirmish event from your discard pile, then remove it from the game.

fields.subtitle: Zwergenältester
fields.lore: Grimir, obwohl von vielen Jahren im Exil, bereits alt und grau, führt seine Axt immer noch mit großer Kraft.

fields.subtitle: Anciano Enano
fields.lore: Gris y viejo después de muchos años de exilio antes de que la Montaña Solitaria fuera reclamada, Grimir todavía puede empuñar su hacha con fuerza.

fields.subtitle: Ancien Nain
fields.lore: Vieux et gris après de nombreuses années passées en exil avant que le Mont Solitaire ne soit récupéré, Grimir peut encore manier sa hache avec force.

fields.subtitle: Anziano dei Nani
fields.lore: Vecchio e grigio dopo i molti anni trascorsi in esilio prima che la Montagna Solitaria fosse recuperata, Grimir può ancora maneggiare la sua ascia con forza.

cards.title: Halls of My Home
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of any draw deck. You may discard 1 Shadow card revealed. Return the rest in any order.
cards.lore: “‘I will go and look on the halls of Durin, whatever may wait there....'”

fields.title: Halls of My Home
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of any draw deck. You may discard 1 Shadow card revealed. Return the rest in any order.
fields.lore: “‘I will go and look on the halls of Durin, whatever may wait there....'”

fields.title: Die Hallen meiner Ahnen
fields.lore: "Ich will mitgehen und einen Blick auf Durins Hallen werfen, was immer dort auf uns wartet...“

fields.title: Salas de Mi Hogar
fields.lore: “Iré contigo y explorare las salas de Durin, cualquiera que sea el riesgo...”

fields.title: Les Salles de ma Patrie
fields.lore: “‘J'irai regarder les salles de Durin, quel que soit le sort qui m'y attend....'”

fields.title: Le Sale della Mia Dimora
fields.lore: “‘Andrò a mirare le dimore di Durin, noncurante di ciò che ivi potrebbe attenderci...'”

cards.title: Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound 2 Orcs or to wound 1 Orc twice.
cards.lore: “‘I have looked on Moria, and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful; and we have found no sign of my kindred.'”

fields.title: Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound 2 Orcs or to wound 1 Orc twice.
fields.lore: “‘I have looked on Moria, and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful; and we have found no sign of my kindred.'”

fields.title: Hier liegt Balin, Fundins Sohn
fields.lore: "Ich habe Moria gesehen, und es ist sehr groß, aber es ist dunkel und schrecklich; und wir haben keine Spur von meiner Sippe gefunden.“

fields.title: Aquí Yace Balin, Hijo de Fundin
fields.lore: “Ya he visto Moria, y es muy grande, pero se ha convertido en un sitio oscuro y terrible, y no hemos encontrado señales de mi gente.”

fields.title: Ici Repose Balin, Fils de Fundin
fields.lore: “‘J'ai regardé la Moria, et elle est très grande, mais elle est devenue sombre et terrible ; et nous n'avons trouvé aucun signe de ceux de ma race.'”

fields.title: Qui Giace Balin, Figlio di Fundin
fields.lore: “‘Il mio sguardo si è posato su Moria; è immensa, ma è divenuta oscura e spaventosa, e non vi è traccia della mia gente.'”

cards.title: Let Them Come!
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish against an Orc, discard that Orc. Discard this condition if a Dwarf loses a skirmish.
cards.lore: “‘There is one Dwarf yet in Moria who still draws breath!'”

fields.title: Let Them Come!
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish against an Orc, discard that Orc. Discard this condition if a Dwarf loses a skirmish.
fields.lore: “‘There is one Dwarf yet in Moria who still draws breath!'”

fields.title: Lasst sie nur kommen!
fields.lore: "Noch gibt es einen Zwerg in Moria, der atmet!“

fields.title: ¡Dejad Que Vengan!
fields.lore: “Hay un Enano en Moria que todavía respira!”

fields.title: Laissez-les Venir !
fields.lore: “‘Il y a encore un Nain dans la Moria à qui il reste du souffle !'”

fields.title: Lasciateli Venire!
fields.lore: “‘C'è ancora un Nano a Moria che respira!'”

cards.title: Lord of Moria
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Dwarf is damage +1.
cards.lore: Gimli rushed ahead into the vast, empty chamber to see a huge slab of white stone. Knowing instinctively the significance of this tomb, he fell to his knees, overcome with grief.

fields.title: Lord of Moria
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Dwarf is damage +1.
fields.lore: Gimli rushed ahead into the vast, empty chamber to see a huge slab of white stone. Knowing instinctively the significance of this tomb, he fell to his knees, overcome with grief.

fields.title: Herr von Moria
fields.lore: Gimli stürzte voran in die weite, leere Kammer und sah dort eine große, weisse Steinplatte. Er fühlte die Bedeutung dieser Grabstätte und fiel, von Trauer übermannt, auf die Knie.

fields.title: Señor de Moria
fields.lore: Gimli se apresuro en la gran cámara vacía para ver una enorme losa de piedra blanca. Conociendo instintivamente el significado de esta tumba, se arrodillo, superado por la pena.

fields.title: Seigneur de la Moria
fields.lore: Gimli s'engouffra dans la vaste chambre vide et vit une énorme dalle de pierre blanche. Reconnaissant instinctivement cette tombe, il tomba à genoux, submergé par le chagrin.

fields.title: Signore di Moria
fields.lore: Gimli si precipitò in avanti nella vasta, vuota sala per vedere un'enorme lastra di pietra bianca. Intuendo istintivamente l'importanza di questa tomba, cadde sulle sue ginocchia, avanzò con dolore.

cards.title: Mithril Shaft
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to discard cards from the top of your draw deck until you choose to stop (limit 5). Add (1) for each card discarded in this way. Take the last card discarded into hand.
cards.lore: “‘Mithril! All folk desired it.'”

fields.title: Mithril Shaft
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to discard cards from the top of your draw deck until you choose to stop (limit 5). Add (1) for each card discarded in this way. Take the last card discarded into hand.
fields.lore: “‘Mithril! All folk desired it.'”

fields.title: Mithrilader
fields.lore: "Mithril! Jedermann wollte es.“

fields.title: Veta de Mithril
fields.lore: “¡Mithril! Todo el mundo lo deseaba.”

fields.title: Puits de Mithril
fields.lore: “‘Le mithril ! Il faisait l'objet du désir de tous.'”

fields.title: Vena di Mithril
fields.lore: “‘Mithril! Tutti i popoli lo desideravano.'”

cards.title: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
cards.gameText: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'”

fields.title: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
fields.gameText: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'”

fields.gameText: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, discard a Shadow card. Its owner may discard 3 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.

fields.title: Niemand schubst einen Zwerg herum!
fields.lore: "Mein Volk hat niemals mit irgendeinem der Diener des Feindes etwas zu tun gehabt.“

fields.title: Nadie Deja de Lado a un Enano
fields.lore: “Mi gente nunca ha tenido tratos con los sirvientes del Enemigo.”

fields.title: Personne ne Lance un Nain
fields.lore: “‘Les miens n'ont jamais eu de rapports avec aucun serviteur de l'Ennemi.'”

fields.title: Nessuno Calunni un Nano
fields.lore: “‘Il mio popolo non ha mai avuto rapporti con alcuno dei servitori del Nemico.'”

cards.title: Stairs of Khazad-dûm
cards.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. While a Dwarf skirmishes a [MORIA] minion, that Dwarf is strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘Moria – Khazad-dûm! Greatest of the dwarf-halls – What I would not give to look upon its treasures!'”

fields.title: Stairs of Khazad-dûm
fields.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. While a Dwarf skirmishes a [MORIA] minion, that Dwarf is strength +1.
fields.lore: “‘Moria – Khazad-dûm! Greatest of the dwarf-halls – What I would not give to look upon its treasures!'”

fields.title: Die Treppen von Khazad-dûm
fields.lore: "Moria – Khazad-dûm! Größtes aller Zwergenreiche – Was würde ich nicht alles geben, seine Pracht zu sehen!“

fields.title: Escaleras de Khazad-dûm
fields.lore: “‘¡Moria – Khazad-dûm! El más grande de los pabellones Enanos – Que no daría por contemplar sus tesoros!'”

fields.title: Escalier de Khazad-dûm
fields.lore: “‘La Moria – Khazad-dûm ! La plus grande des demeures naines – Que ne donnerais-je pas pour examiner ses trésors !'”

fields.title: Le Scale di Khazad-dûm
fields.lore: “‘Moria – Khazad-dûm! Il più grande palazzo dei Nani – Cosa non darei per sbirciare i suoi tesori!'”

cards.title: Still Draws Breath
cards.gameText: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, heal that Dwarf.
cards.lore: “When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....”

fields.title: Still Draws Breath
fields.gameText: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, heal that Dwarf.
fields.lore: “When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....”

fields.title: Still Draws Breath
fields.gameText: Tale.\Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may discard a card from hand to heal that Dwarf.

fields.title: Er atmet noch
fields.lore: "Als dreizehn gefallen waren, ergriffen die übrigen schreiend die Flucht und liessen die Verteidiger unverletzt zurück...“

fields.title: Todavía Respira
fields.lore: “Cuando ya habían caído trece, el resto huyo chillando, dejando a los defensores indemnes...”

fields.title: Encore du Souffle
fields.lore: “Quand treize furent tombés, les autres s'enfuirent en hurlant, laissant les défenseurs indemnes....”

fields.title: Respira Ancora
fields.lore: “Quando ne furono caduti tredici, gli altri fuggirono strillando, lasciando la Compagnia illesa....”

cards.title: Their Halls of Stone
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).
cards.lore: “‘These are not holes,' said Gimli. ‘This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.'”

fields.title: Their Halls of Stone
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).
fields.lore: “‘These are not holes,' said Gimli. ‘This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.'”

fields.title: Ihre Hallen aus Stein
fields.lore: "Das sind keine Höhlen“, antwortete Gimli. "Dies ist das große Reich und die Stadt Zwergenbinge. Und einstmals war es hier nicht dunkel, sondern voller Licht und Glanz, wie es noch in unseren Liedern überliefert wird.“

fields.title: Sus Salas de Piedra
fields.lore: “No son agujeros – dijo Gimli –. Esto es el gran reino y la ciudad de la Mina del Enano. Y antiguamente no era oscura sino luminosa y espléndida, como lo recuerdan aún nuestras canciones.”

fields.title: Leurs Demeures de Pierre
fields.lore: “‘Ce ne sont pas des trous', dit Gimli. ‘C'est le grand royaume et domaine du Cavenain. Et jadis il n'était pas sombre, mais plein de lumière et de splendeur, comme nous nous le rappelons dans nos chansons.'”

fields.title: I Loro Saloni di Pietra
fields.lore: “Questi non sono buchi”, disse Gimli. “Qui è il grande reame e la città del Nanosterro. In antico non era tenebroso, bensì inondato di luce e splendore, come ancora ricordano le nostre canzoni”

cards.title: Thrarin
cards.subtitle: Dwarven Smith
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Thrarin to allow him to participate in archery fire and skirmishes until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: A blacksmith by trade, Thrarin puts down his hammer and takes up his axe to fight when the need arises.

fields.title: Thrarin
fields.subtitle: Dwarven Smith
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Thrarin to allow him to participate in archery fire and skirmishes until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: A blacksmith by trade, Thrarin puts down his hammer and takes up his axe to fight when the need arises.

fields.subtitle: Zwergenschmied
fields.lore: Eigentlich ein Hufschmied, legt Thrarin seinen Hammer nieder, wenn nötig, und ergreift seine Axt, um zu kämpfen.

fields.subtitle: Herrero Enano
fields.lore: De oficio herrero, Thrarin deja su martillo y toma su hacha para luchar cuando surge la necesidad.

fields.subtitle: Forgeron Nain
fields.lore: Forgeron de métier, Thrarin dépose son marteau et prend sa hache pour combattre quand le besoin s'en fait sentir.

fields.subtitle: Fabbro dei Nani
fields.lore: Fabbro ferraio di professione, Tharin mette giù il suo martello e prende la sua ascia per combattere quando si presenti la necessità.

cards.title: Wealth of Moria
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
cards.lore: “‘For here alone in all the world was found Moria-silver, or true-silver as some have called it: mithril is the Elvish name.'”

fields.title: Wealth of Moria
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
fields.lore: “‘For here alone in all the world was found Moria-silver, or true-silver as some have called it: mithril is the Elvish name.'”

fields.title: Morias Reichtum
fields.lore: "Doch allein hier und sonst nirgends in der Welt wurde Moria-Silber gefunden, oder Wahr-Silber, wie manche es genannt haben: mithril ist der elbische Name.“

fields.title: Riqueza de Moria
fields.lore: “Pues este era el único sitio del mundo donde había plata de Moria, o plata autentica como algunos la llamaban: mithril es el nombre Élfico.”

fields.title: Richesse de la Moria
fields.lore: “‘Du monde entier ce n'est qu'ici qu'on trouvait l'argent de la Moria ou vrai-argent, comme d'aucuns l'ont appelé. Mithril est son nom elfique.'”

fields.title: Ricchezze di Moria
fields.lore: “‘Codesto è l'unico posto al mondo ove si trovi l'argento di Moria o, come l'hanno chiamato alcuni, il vero-argento: mithril è il nome elfico.'”

cards.title: Ancient Enmity
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, that minion's owner discards 2 cards at random from hand.
cards.lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

fields.title: Ancient Enmity
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, that minion's owner discards 2 cards at random from hand.
fields.lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

fields.gameText: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, you may heal an Elf; any shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Uralte Feindschaft
fields.lore: Groß und bitter ist der Hass der Elben auf die Orks, da sie viele Brüder und Schwestern an sie verloren haben.

fields.title: Rencor Antiguo
fields.lore: Duro y amargo es el odio élfico por los Orcos, ya que ellos han perdido un gran numero de parientes al salvajismo de los Orcos.

fields.title: Ancienne Haine
fields.lore: Forte et profonde est la haine des Elfes vis-à-vis des Orques, car ils ont perdu de nombreux parents face à la sauvagerie orque.

fields.title: Antica Ostilità
fields.lore: Forte e amaro è l'odio degli Elfi per gli Orchi, poiché hanno perso molti consanguinei a causa della crudeltà degli Orchi.

cards.title: Arwen
cards.subtitle: Daughter of Elrond
cards.gameText: Ranger. While skirmishing a Nazgul, Arwen is strength +3.
cards.lore: “Long she had been in the land of her mother's kin, in Lórien beyond the mountains, and was but lately returned to Rivendell to her father's house.”

fields.title: Arwen
fields.subtitle: Daughter of Elrond
fields.gameText: Ranger. While skirmishing a Nazgul, Arwen is strength +3.
fields.lore: “Long she had been in the land of her mother's kin, in Lórien beyond the mountains, and was but lately returned to Rivendell to her father's house.”

fields.subtitle: Elronds Tochter
fields.lore: Lange war sie im Land der Verwandten ihrer Mutter gewesen, in Lórien jenseits des Gebirges, und erst kürzlich war sie nach Bruchtal in ihres Vaters Haus zurückgekehrt.

fields.subtitle: Hija de Elrond
fields.lore: “Había permanecido mucho tiempo en la tierra de la familia de la madre, en Lórien, mas allá de las montañas, y había regresado hacia poco a Rivendel, a la casa del padre.”

fields.subtitle: Fille d'Elrond
fields.lore: “Longtemps elle était demeurée dans le pays de sa famille maternelle, en Lórien au-delà des montagnes, et elle n'était que récemment revenue à Fondcombe dans la maison de son père.”

fields.subtitle: Figlia di Elrond
fields.lore: “Aveva trascorso molti anni nella terra della famiglia materna, a Lòrien al di là dei monti, e da poco era tornata a Gran Burrone nella casa paterna.”

cards.title: Asfaloth
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an Elf. When played on Arwen, Asfaloth's twilight cost is -2. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard Asfaloth when at an underground site.
cards.lore: “‘Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'”

fields.title: Asfaloth
fields.gameText: Bearer must be an Elf. When played on Arwen, Asfaloth's twilight cost is -2. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard Asfaloth when at an underground site.
fields.lore: “‘Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'”
"Noro lim, noro lim, Asfaloth!“
“¡Noro Lim, Asfaloth, noro Lim!”

cards.title: Border Defenses
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
cards.lore: “‘None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lórien. And there will be many Elves hidden on the northern border before another night falls.'”

fields.title: Border Defenses
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
fields.lore: “‘None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lórien. And there will be many Elves hidden on the northern border before another night falls.'”

fields.title: Verteidigung der Grenzen
fields.lore: "Nicht einer von den Orks wird je aus Lórien zurückkehren. Und viele Elben werden an der Nordgrenze auf der Lauer liegen, ehe die nächste Nacht hereinbricht.“

fields.title: Defensas Fronterizas
fields.lore: “Ninguno de los Orcos saldrá jamás de Lórien. Y habrá muchos Elfos ocultos en la frontera norte antes que caiga otra noche.”

fields.title: Défenses Frontalières
fields.lore: “‘Aucun des Orques ne ressortira jamais de la Lórien. Et il y aura beaucoup d'Elfes cachés à la lisière nord avant la tombée de la nuit.'”

fields.title: Difese di Confine
fields.lore: “Di quegli Orchi nemmeno uno uscirà vivo da Lòrien. E vi saranno molti Elfi nascosti al confine settentrionale prima del calar della prossima notte.'”

cards.title: Bow of the Galadhrim
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion.
cards.lore: “To Legolas she gave a bow such as the Galadhrim used, longer and stouter than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elf-hair.”

fields.title: Bow of the Galadhrim
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion.
fields.lore: “To Legolas she gave a bow such as the Galadhrim used, longer and stouter than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elf-hair.”

fields.title: Der Bogen der Galadrim
fields.lore: Legolas schenkte sie einen Bogen, wie ihn die Galadrim benutzen, länger und handfester als die Bögen von Düsterwald und bespannt mit einer Sehne aus Elbenhaar.

fields.title: Arco de Los Galadrim
fields.lore: “A Legolas le dio un arco como los que usaban los Galadrim, mas largo y mas fuerte que los arcos del Bosque Negro, y la cuerda era de cabellos élficos.”

fields.title: Arc des Galadhrim
fields.lore: “À Legolas elle donna un arc de la sorte qui était en usage chez les Galadhrim, plus long et plus fort que ceux de la Forêt Noire, et monté d'une corde de cheveux d'Elfe.”

fields.title: Arco dei Galadhrim
fields.lore: “A Legolas offrì un arco come quello dei Galadhrim, più lungo e robusto degli archi di Bosco Atro, la cui corda era fatta di capelli elfici.”

cards.title: Celeborn
cards.subtitle: Lord of Lorien
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Celeborn to heal an [ELVEN] ally.
cards.lore: “They were clad wholly in white... and the hair of the Lord Celeborn was of silver long and bright; but no sign of age was upon them, unless it were in the depths of their eyes; for these were keen as lances in the starlight, and yet profound....”

fields.title: Celeborn
fields.subtitle: Lord of Lorien
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Celeborn to heal an [ELVEN] ally.
fields.lore: “They were clad wholly in white... and the hair of the Lord Celeborn was of silver long and bright; but no sign of age was upon them, unless it were in the depths of their eyes; for these were keen as lances in the starlight, and yet profound....”

fields.subtitle: Herrscher von Lórien
fields.lore: Sie waren ganz in Weiss gekleidet... und das Haar des Herrn Celeborn war silbern, lang und leuchtend; aber kein Zeichen des Alters war an ihnen, es sei denn in den Tiefen ihrer Augen; denn ihre Augen waren scharf wie Lanzen im Sternenlicht, und doch tiefg

fields.subtitle: Señor de Lórien
fields.lore: “Estaban vestidos de blanco... y los cabellos del Señor Celeborn eran de plata, largos y brillantes; pero no había en ellos signos de vejez, excepto quizás en lo profundo de los ojos, pues estos eran penetrantes como lanzas a la luz de las estrellas, y si

fields.subtitle: Seigneur de Lórien
fields.lore: “Ils étaient entièrement vêtus de blanc ... et les cheveux du Seigneur Celeborn, longs et brillants, étaient d'argent ; mais il n'y avait en eux aucun signe de l'âge, sinon dans l'intensité de leurs regards ; car leurs yeux étaient aussi pénétrants que de

fields.subtitle: Signore di Lórien
fields.lore: “Le vesti erano bianche... e i capelli del Sire Celeborn d'argento, lunghi e lucenti; nessuna traccia d'età, salvo forse la profondità dei loro occhi, penetranti come lance, eppur impenetrabili...”

cards.title: The Council of Elrond
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to play a tale from your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘You will hear today all that you need in order to understand the purposes of the Enemy.... What shall we do with the Ring, the least of rings, the trifle that Sauron fancies? That is the doom that we must deem.'”

fields.title: The Council of Elrond
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to play a tale from your draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘You will hear today all that you need in order to understand the purposes of the Enemy.... What shall we do with the Ring, the least of rings, the trifle that Sauron fancies? That is the doom that we must deem.'”

fields.title: Der Rat von Elrond
fields.lore: "Ihr werdet heute alles hören, dessen ihr bedürft, um die Absichten des Feindes zu begreifen....Was sollen wir mit dem Ring tun, dem unbedeutendsten von allen Ringen, mit der Kleinigkeit, die Sauron haben möchte? Das ist die Entscheidung, die wir fällen m

fields.title: El Concilio de Elrond
fields.lore: “Oirás hoy todo lo que necesitas saber para entender los propósitos del Enemigo... ¿Qué haremos con el Anillo, el más insignificante de los anillos, la fruslería que es un capricho de Sauron? Ese es el destino que hemos de considerar.”

fields.title: Le Conseil d'Elrond
fields.lore: “Vous entendrez aujourd'hui tout ce qu'il vous est nécessaire de savoir pour comprendre les desseins de l'Ennemi..... Que ferons-nous de l'Anneau, ce moindre des anneaux, cette bagatelle dont Sauron s'est entiché ? C'est le destin que nous devons considér

fields.title: Il Consiglio di Elrond
fields.lore: “‘Udrai oggi tutto ciò che è necessario per capire gli scopi del Nemico .... Che fare dell'anello, il minore degli anelli, il gingillo che piace a Sauron? Questa è la decisione che dobbiamo prendere.'”

cards.title: Curse Their Foul Feet!
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. That player discards a card from hand for each Orc revealed.
cards.lore: “‘A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'”

fields.title: Curse Their Foul Feet!
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. That player discards a card from hand for each Orc revealed.
fields.lore: “‘A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'”

fields.gameText: Exert an Elf to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Make the fellowship archery total +X until the regroup phase, where X is the number of Orcs revealed. That player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Verflucht seien ihre schmutzigen Füsse!
fields.lore: "Eine große Schar Orks ist vorbeigezogen. Sie haben den Nimrodel überquert – verflucht seien ihre schmutzigen Füsse in diesem reinen Wasser!“

fields.title: Malditos Sean Esos Pies Infectos
fields.lore: “Una fuerte compañía de Orcos ha pasado por aquí. Cruzaron el Nimrodel, ¡y malditos sean esos pies infectos en el agua pura!”

fields.title: Maudits Soient leurs Infects Pieds !
fields.lore: “Une forte compagnie d'Orques est passée. Ils ont traversé la Nimrodel – maudits soient leurs infects pieds dans son eau pure !”

fields.title: Maledetti i Loro Immondi Piedi!
fields.lore: “‘Una forte Compagnia di Orchi è passata or ora. Hanno attraversato il Nimdorel – maledetti i loro immondi piedi nelle sue limpide acque!'”

cards.title: Defiance
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul).
cards.lore: “‘If you want him, come and claim him!'”

fields.title: Defiance
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul).
fields.lore: “‘If you want him, come and claim him!'”

fields.title: Trotz
fields.lore: "Wenn ihr ihn haben wollt, kommt und verlangt nach ihm.“

fields.title: Desafío
fields.lore: “¡Si lo queréis, venid y reclamadlo!”

fields.title: Défi
fields.lore: “Si vous le voulez, venez le chercher !”

fields.title: Sfida
fields.lore: “‘Se lo vuoi, vieni a reclamarlo!'”

cards.title: Double Shot
cards.gameText: Archery: Spot an Elf archer companion to make the fellowship archery total +1.
cards.lore: “The affray was sharp, but the orcs were dismayed by the fierceness of the defence. Legolas shot two through the throat.”

fields.title: Double Shot
fields.gameText: Archery: Spot an Elf archer companion to make the fellowship archery total +1.
fields.lore: “The affray was sharp, but the orcs were dismayed by the fierceness of the defence. Legolas shot two through the throat.”

fields.title: Zweifachschuss
fields.lore: Der Ansturm war heftig, aber die erbitterte Verteidigung entmutigte die Orks. Legolas schoss zweien durch die Kehle.

fields.title: Disparo Doble
fields.lore: “...los Orcos atacaron decididamente, pero el furor de la defensa los desanimo muy pronto. Legolas les atravesó la garganta a dos de ellos.”

fields.title: Doublet
fields.lore: “La bataille fut vive, mais la fureur de la défense épouvanta les Orques. Legolas en tira deux en pleine gorge.”

fields.title: Doppio Tiro
fields.lore: “La rissa era tumultuosa, ma gli Orchi furono sbigottiti dalla violenza della difesa. Legolas ne trafisse due alla gola.”

cards.title: Elf-song
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to remove a burden.
cards.lore: “...the beauty of the melodies and of the interwoven words in elven-tongues, even though he understood them little, held him in a spell, as soon as he began to attend to them.”

fields.title: Elf-song
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to remove a burden.
fields.lore: “...the beauty of the melodies and of the interwoven words in elven-tongues, even though he understood them little, held him in a spell, as soon as he began to attend to them.”

fields.title: Elbenlied
fields.lore: "Zuerst bezauberten ihn die Schönheit der Melodien und die eingeflochtenen Wörter in der Elbensprache, obwohl er sie kaum verstand, sobald er begonnen hatte, aufzumerken.“

fields.title: Canción Élfica
fields.lore: “...la belleza de las melodías y de las palabras entrelazadas en lengua élfica, aunque entendía poco, obraron sobre el cómo un encantamiento.”

fields.title: Chant Elfique
fields.lore: “...la beauté des mélodies et les mots entrelacés en langues elfiques, même s'il les comprenait peu, le tinrent sous le charme aussitôt qu'il eut commencé d'y prêter attention.”

fields.title: Canzone Elfica
fields.lore: “...sulle prime la bellezza delle melodie intrecciate alle parole di lingua elfica lo avvolse come un incantesimo, benché egli non capisse molto di ciò che veniva cantato.”

cards.title: Elrond
cards.subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to draw a card.
cards.lore: “He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.”

fields.title: Elrond
fields.subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
fields.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to draw a card.
fields.lore: “He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.”

fields.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond twice (or once if you can spot 2 other [Elven] allies) to draw a card.

fields.subtitle: Herrscher von Bruchtal
fields.lore: Er war der Herr von Bruchtal und mächtig unter Elben und Menschen.

fields.subtitle: Señor de Rivendel
fields.lore: “Era el Señor de Rivendel, poderoso tanto entre los Elfos como entre los Hombres.”

fields.subtitle: Seigneur de Fondcombe
fields.lore: Compagnie: Affaiblissez Elrond pour piocher une carte.

fields.subtitle: Signore di Gran Burrone
fields.lore: “Egli era il Signore di Gran Burrone, potente tanto tra gli Elfi che tra gli Uomini.”

cards.title: Elven Bow
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.
cards.lore: “‘We live now upon an island amid many perils, and our hands are more often upon the bowstring than upon the harp.'”

fields.title: Elven Bow
fields.gameText: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.
fields.lore: “‘We live now upon an island amid many perils, and our hands are more often upon the bowstring than upon the harp.'”

fields.title: Elbenbogen
fields.lore: "Wir leben jetzt auf einer Insel inmitten vieler Gefahren, und unsere Hände liegen häufiger auf der Bogensehne als auf der Harfe.“

fields.title: Arco Élfico
fields.lore: “Vivimos ahora como en una isla, rodeados de peligros, y nuestras manos están mas a menudo sobre los arcos que sobre las arpas.”

fields.title: Arc Elfique
fields.lore: “Nous vivons à présent sur une île au milieu de nombreux périls, et nos mains jouent plus souvent de la corde de l'arc que de celles de la harpe.”

fields.title: Arco Elfico
fields.lore: “‘Viviamo ormai su un'isola in mezzo alle insidie, e le nostre mani si posano più sovente sulla corda dell'arco, che non su quelle dell'arpa.'”

cards.title: Elven Cloak
cards.gameText: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. The minion archery total is -1.
cards.lore: “‘...never before have we clad strangers in the garb of our own people.'”

fields.title: Elven Cloak
fields.gameText: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. The minion archery total is -1.
fields.lore: “‘...never before have we clad strangers in the garb of our own people.'”

fields.title: Elbenmantel
fields.lore: "...und niemals zuvor haben wir Fremde in die Gewänder unseres eigenen Volkes gekleidet.“

fields.title: Capa Élfica
fields.lore: “...y nunca hasta ahora habíamos vestido a extranjeros con las ropas de los nuestros.”

fields.title: Cape Elfique
fields.lore: “...et jamais auparavant nous n'avons vêtu des étrangers du costume des nôtres.”

fields.title: Mantello Elfico
fields.lore: “‘...mai prima d'oggi avevamo vestito degli stranieri con abiti uguali ai nostri.'”

cards.title: Far-seeing Eyes
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, choose an opponent to discard a card from hand.
cards.lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.

fields.title: Far-seeing Eyes
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, choose an opponent to discard a card from hand.
fields.lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, draw a card. Any Shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Weitblick
fields.lore: Die scharfen Augen der Elben sehen weiter und besser als die der Menschen oder Zwerge.

fields.title: Ojos Que Ven Lejos
fields.lore: Los agudos ojos Élficos ven mas lejos y mas claramente que los de los Hombres o los Enanos.

fields.title: Yeux Perçants
fields.lore: Les yeux perçants des Elfes voient plus loin et plus clairement que ceux des Hommes ou des Nains.

fields.title: Occhi che Vedono Lontano
fields.lore: Gli occhi acuti degli Elfi possono vedere più lontano e più chiaramente di quelli di Uomini e Nani.

cards.title: Foul Creation
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. You may discard a [ISENGARD] minion revealed to draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.

fields.title: Foul Creation
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. You may discard a [ISENGARD] minion revealed to draw 2 cards.
fields.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.

fields.title: Foul Creation
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. If an [isengard] minion was revealed, you may draw 2 cards.

fields.title: Verdorbene Schöpfung
fields.lore: Sarumans Uruk-hai entsprechen ganz dem Charakter ihres Schöpfers. All denjenigen, denen sie begegnen, bringen sie nur Verachtung und Ekel entgegen.

fields.title: Creación Inmunda
fields.lore: Los Uruk-hai de Saruman reflejan el peculiar enfoque de su amo, observando con desprecio y disgusto todo lo que se encuentran.

fields.title: Création Infecte
fields.lore: Les Ourouk-Haï de Saroumane reflètent le point particulier de leur maître, regardant avec mépris et dégoût tout ce qu'ils rencontrent.

fields.title: Creazione Ripugnante
fields.lore: Gli Uruk-hai di Saruman rispecchiavano il peculiare atteggiamento del loro padrone, osservando con disprezzo e disgusto tutti coloro che incontrano.

cards.title: Galadriel
cards.subtitle: Lady of Light
cards.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf for free.
cards.lore: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....”

fields.title: Galadriel
fields.subtitle: Lady of Light
fields.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf for free.
fields.lore: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....”

fields.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf; that Elf's twilight cost is -1.

fields.subtitle: Herrin des Lichts
fields.lore: "Sehr groß waren sie, und die Herrin nicht weniger groß als der Herr; und sie waren ernst und schön. ...Frau Galadriels Haar war tiefgolden...“

fields.subtitle: Dama de La Luz
fields.lore: “Muy altos eran, y la Dama no menos alta que el Señor, y hermosos y graves... y los cabellos de la Dama eran de oro...”

fields.subtitle: La Dame Blanche
fields.lore: “Ils étaient très grands, la Dame non moins que le Seigneur ; et ils étaient graves et beaux ... et les cheveux de la Dame étaient d'or foncé....”

fields.subtitle: Dama della Luce
fields.lore: “Erano molto alti, e la statura della Dama pari a quella del Signore; i loro volti erano gravi e belli... e i capelli della dama di un oro intenso....”

cards.title: Gift of Boats
cards.gameText: To play, exert an Elf ally. Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from a river during the fellowship phase, the move limit for this turn is +1.
cards.lore: “‘They will not sink, lade them as you will; but they are wayward if mishandled.'”

fields.title: Gift of Boats
fields.gameText: To play, exert an Elf ally. Plays to your support area. When the fellowship is at a river during the fellowship phase, the move limit for this turn is +1.
fields.lore: “‘They will not sink, lade them as you will; but they are wayward if mishandled.'”

fields.gameText: To play, exert an Elf ally. Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from a river during the fellowship phase, the move limit for this turn is +1.

fields.title: Drei kleine Boote
fields.lore: "Sie sinken nicht, wie schwer ihr sie auch beladen mögt; aber sie sind unberechenbar, wenn sie falsch behandelt werden.“

fields.title: Don de Los Botes
fields.lore: “No se hundirán, aunque las carguéis demasiado, pero no son fáciles de manejar.”

fields.title: Offrande de Bateaux
fields.lore: “Elles ne couleront pas, quel que soit leur chargement ; mais elles sont indociles, quand on ne sait pas les manier.”

fields.title: Il Regalo delle Barche
fields.lore: “‘Non affondano, qualunque sia il carico; ma se vengono trattate male, sono capricciose.'”

cards.title: Gwemegil
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Arwen. She is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Arwen or discard 2 cards from hand to make her strength +1.
cards.lore: Forged by the Elven-smiths of Rivendell, Arwen's blade bears enchantments to ward off the forces of the Great Eye.

fields.title: Gwemegil
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Arwen. She is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Arwen or discard 2 cards from hand to make her strength +1.
fields.lore: Forged by the Elven-smiths of Rivendell, Arwen's blade bears enchantments to ward off the forces of the Great Eye.
Arwens Klinge, von Elbenschmieden in Bruchtal gefertigt, besitzt Verzauberungen, um die Kräfte des lidlosen Auges abzuwehren.
Forjada por los herreros Élficos de Rivendel, la espada de Arwen tiene encantamientos para expulsar las fuerzas del Gran Ojo.
Forgée par les forgerons Elfes de Fondcombe, l'épée d'Arwen porte des enchantements pour écarter les forces du Grand *il.
Forgiata da fabbri elfici di Gran Burrone, sulla lama di Arwen sono incisi degli incantesimi a difesa dalle forze del Grande Occhio.

cards.title: Haldir
cards.subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
cards.gameText: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at site 6, 7, or 8, he is strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'”

fields.title: Haldir
fields.subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
fields.gameText: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at site 6, 7, or 8, he is strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'”

fields.title: Haldir
fields.subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
fields.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
While Haldir is at a forest or river (or any site 6, 7, or 8), he is strength +2 and an archer.

fields.subtitle: Elb des goldenen Waldes
fields.lore: "Doch einige von uns gehen noch immer in die Ferne, um Nachrichten zu sammeln und unsere Feinde zu beobachten.... Ich bin einer von ihnen. Haldir ist mein Name.“

fields.subtitle: Elfo del Bosque Dorado
fields.lore: “Pero algunos de los nuestros aun viajan lejos, para recoger noticias y observar a los enemigos... Soy uno de ellos. Me llamo Haldir.”

fields.subtitle: Elfe de la Forêt Dorée
fields.lore: “Mais il en est encore parmi nous qui vont loin pour récolter des nouvelles et surveiller nos ennemis..... Je suis de ceux là. Je me nomme Haldir.”

fields.subtitle: Elfo del Bosco D'Oro
fields.lore: “‘Ma alcuni dei nostri vanno ancora nelle terre straniere per raccogliere notizie e sorvegliare nemici... Io sono uno di loro; Haldir è il mio nome'”

cards.title: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is strength +1 for each Elf you can spot (limit +3).
cards.lore: “But Sauron of Mordor assailed them, and they made the Last Alliance of Elves and Men, and the hosts of Gil-galad and Elendil were mustered....”

fields.title: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is strength +1 for each Elf you can spot (limit +3).
fields.lore: “But Sauron of Mordor assailed them, and they made the Last Alliance of Elves and Men, and the hosts of Gil-galad and Elendil were mustered....”

fields.title: Das letzte Bündnis zwischen Elben und Menschen
fields.lore: "Doch Sauron von Mordor überfiel sie, und sie schlossen das Letzte Bündnis zwischen Elben und Menschen, und die Heerscharen von Gil-galad und Elendil sammelten sich...“

fields.title: La Última Alianza de Los Elfos y Los Hombres
fields.lore: “Pero Sauron de Mordor los ataco, y convinieron la Ultima Alianza de los Elfos y los Hombres, y las huestes de Gil-Galad y Elendil se reunieron...”

fields.title: La Dernière Alliance des Elfes et des Hommes
fields.lore: “Mais Sauron de Mordor les assaillit, et ils firent la Dernière Alliance des Elfes et des Hommes, et les armées de Gil-galad et d'Elendil furent rassemblées....”

fields.title: L'Ultima Alleanza di Elfi e Uomini
fields.lore: “Ma furono assaliti da Sauron di Mordor, e si unirono nell'Ultima Alleanza di Elfi e Uomini, e le schiere di Gil-galad e di Elendil si radunarono....”

cards.title: Legolas
cards.subtitle: Greenleaf
cards.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: “‘And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. ‘It would be faithless now to say farewell.'”

fields.title: Legolas
fields.subtitle: Greenleaf
fields.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
fields.lore: “‘And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. ‘It would be faithless now to say farewell.'”

fields.title: Legolas
fields.subtitle: Greenleaf
fields.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion. Exert him again unless he bears a ranged weapon or you can spot more minions than companions.

fields.subtitle: Grünblatt
fields.lore: "Und auch ich will mit ihm gehen“, sagte Legolas. "Es wäre treulos, jetzt Lebewohl zu sagen.“

fields.subtitle: Hojaverde
fields.lore: “Yo también iré con Frodo – dijo Legolas –. Seria desleal despedirme de él ahora.”

fields.subtitle: Vertefeuille
fields.lore: “‘Moi aussi, j'irai avec lui' dit Legolas. ‘Il serait déloyal de lui dire maintenant adieu.'”

fields.subtitle: Verdefoglia
fields.lore: “‘Anch'io andrò con lui,' disse Legolas. ‘Sarebbe sleale dirgli addio adesso.'”

cards.title: Legolas
cards.subtitle: Prince of Mirkwood
cards.gameText: Archer. While skirmishing a Nazgul, Legolas is strength +3.
cards.lore: “There was also a strange Elf clad in green and brown, Legolas, a messenger from his father, Thranduil, the King of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood.”

fields.title: Legolas
fields.subtitle: Prince of Mirkwood
fields.gameText: Archer. While skirmishing a Nazgul, Legolas is strength +3.
fields.lore: “There was also a strange Elf clad in green and brown, Legolas, a messenger from his father, Thranduil, the King of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood.”

fields.subtitle: Prinz des Düsterwalds
fields.lore: Auch ein fremder Elb war da, in grün und braun gekleidet, Legolas, ein Bote seines Vaters Thranduil, des Königs der Elben vom nördlichen Düsterwald.

fields.subtitle: Príncipe del Bosque Negro
fields.lore: “Estaba allí también un Elfo extraño, vestido de castaño y verde, que traía un mensaje de su padre, Thranduil, el Rey de los Elfos del Bosque Negro del Norte.”

fields.subtitle: Prince de la Forêt Noire
fields.lore: “Il y avait aussi un Elfe étrange, vêtu de vert et de brun, Legolas, messager de son père, Thranduil, le Roi des Elfes de la Forêt Noire du Nord.”

cards.title: Lightfootedness
cards.gameText: Archery: Spot an Elf companion to make the minion archery total -1.
cards.lore: “‘...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf, or over snow – an Elf.'”

fields.title: Lightfootedness
fields.gameText: Archery: Spot an Elf companion to make the minion archery total -1.
fields.lore: “‘...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf, or over snow – an Elf.'”

fields.title: Leichtfüßigkeit
fields.lore: "...lasst einen Pflüger pflügen, aber wählt zum Schwimmen einen Otter aus und zum Laufen über Gras und Blatt oder über Schnee – einen Elben.“

fields.title: Pies Ligeros
fields.lore: “...que el labrador empuje el arado, pero elige una nutria para nadar; y para correr levemente sobre la hierba y las hojas, o sobre la nieve... Un Elfo.”

fields.title: Pied Léger
fields.lore: “...'qu'un laboureur laboure, mais choisissez plutôt une loutre pour nager et pour courir légèrement sur l'herbe et les feuilles, ou même la neige' – un Elfe.”

fields.title: Passo Leggero
fields.lore: “‘... fate arare il campo al coltivatore, ma scegliete una lontra per nuotare, e per correre veloce su erbe e foglie, o sulla neve – un Elfo.'”

cards.title: Lórien Elf
cards.gameText: To play, spot an Elf.
cards.lore: “‘...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'”

fields.title: Lórien Elf
fields.gameText: To play, spot an Elf.
fields.lore: “‘...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'”

fields.title: Elb aus Lórien
fields.lore: "...denn wir leben jetzt im Herzen des Waldes und lassen uns nicht gern mit irgendwelchen anderen Leuten ein.“

fields.title: Elfo de Lórien
fields.lore: “...pues ahora vivimos en el corazón del bosque, y no tenemos tratos voluntarios con otras gentes.”

fields.title: Elfe de Lórien
fields.lore: “...nous vivons à présent au c*ur de la forêt, et nous n'entretenons pas volontiers de rapports avec les autres gens.”

fields.title: Elfo di Lórien
fields.lore: “‘...adesso viviamo nel cuore della foresta, e non trattiamo volentieri con altre genti.'”

cards.title: Mallorn-trees
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Reveal an [ELVEN] card from hand and place it beneath your draw deck.
cards.lore: “Upon the further side there rose to a great height a green wall encircling a green hill thronged with mallorn-trees taller than any they had yet seen in all the land.”

fields.title: Mallorn-trees
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Reveal an [ELVEN] card from hand and place it beneath your draw deck.
fields.lore: “Upon the further side there rose to a great height a green wall encircling a green hill thronged with mallorn-trees taller than any they had yet seen in all the land.”

fields.title: Mallornbäume
fields.lore: Auf der anderen Seite erhob sich zu großer Höhe eine grüne Mauer; sie umgab einen Berg, der dicht mit Mallornbäumen, größer als alle, die sie bisher in diesem Land gesehen hatten, bestanden war.

fields.title: Árboles Mallorn
fields.lore: “A la izquierda había una loma cubierta con una alfombra de hierba... Encima, como una corona doble, crecían dos círculos de árboles... los del interior eran Mallorn de gran altura...”

fields.title: Mallorne
fields.lore: “De l'autre côté, s'élevait à une grande hauteur un mur vert, qui entourait une colline verte couverte de mallornes plus hauts que tous ceux qu'ils avaient pu voir dans tout le pays.”

fields.title: Alberi di Mallorn
fields.lore: “Ancor oltre, si ergeva alto un verde muro che circondava un verde colle ove si affollavano gli alberi d'oro più imponenti che avessero visto in tutto il paese.”

cards.title: The Mirror of Galadriel
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: If an opponent has at least 7 cards in hand, exert Galadriel to look at 2 of those cards at random. Discard one and replace the other.
cards.lore: “‘What you will see I cannot tell....'”

fields.title: The Mirror of Galadriel
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to look at 2 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Discard one and replace the other.
fields.lore: “‘What you will see I cannot tell....'”

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Fellowship: If an opponent has at least 7 cards in hand, exert Galadriel to look at 2 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Discard one and replace the other.

Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: If an opponent has at least 7 cards in hand, exert Galadriel to look at 2 of those cards at random. Discard one and replace the other.

Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert Galadriel to reveal 3 cards at random from an opponent's hand.  Place one on top of that player's draw deck.

fields.title: Galadriels Spiegel
fields.lore: "Was du sehen wirst...kann ich dir nicht sagen.“

fields.title: El Espejo de Galadriel
fields.lore: “Lo que veras no lo puedo adivinar...”

fields.title: Le Miroir de Galadriel
fields.lore: “Ce que vous verrez, je ne saurais vous le dire.”

fields.title: Lo Specchio di Galadriel
fields.lore: “‘Cosa vedrai non posso dirtelo...'”

cards.title: Orophin
cards.subtitle: Lorien Bowman
cards.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Orophin to wound an Uruk-hai.
cards.lore: The swift bow of Orophin, Haldir's kinsman, has slain many Orcs.

fields.title: Orophin
fields.subtitle: Lorien Bowman
fields.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Orophin to wound an Uruk-hai.
fields.lore: The swift bow of Orophin, Haldir's kinsman, has slain many Orcs.

fields.subtitle: Bogenschütze aus Lórien
fields.lore: Der geschwinde Bogen von Orophin, Haldirs Verwandtem, tötete bereits viele Orks.

fields.subtitle: Arquero de Lórien
fields.lore: El rápido arco de Orophin, el pariente de Haldir, ha quitado la vida de gran cantidad de Orcos.

fields.subtitle: Archer de Lórien
fields.lore: L'arc vif d'Orophin, parent de Haldir, a tué de nombreux Orques.

cards.title: Rúmil
cards.subtitle: Elven Protector
cards.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Rumil to wound an Orc.
cards.lore: Brother to Haldir, Rúmil guards the northern marches of the Golden Wood.

fields.title: Rúmil
fields.subtitle: Elven Protector
fields.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert Rumil to wound an Orc.
fields.lore: Brother to Haldir, Rúmil guards the northern marches of the Golden Wood.

fields.subtitle: Grenzschützer der Elben
fields.lore: Rúmil, Haldirs Bruder, beschützt die nördlichen Gefilde des goldenen Waldes.

fields.subtitle: Protector Elfo
fields.lore: Hermano de Haldir, Rúmil vigila a las avanzadillas del norte del Bosque Dorado.

fields.subtitle: Protecteur Elfe
fields.lore: Frère de Haldir, Rúmil garde les marches septentrionales de la Forêt Dorée.

cards.title: The Seen and the Unseen
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert 2 Elves to discard a condition.
cards.lore: “‘You have entered the realm of the Lady of the Wood – you cannot go back.'”

fields.title: The Seen and the Unseen
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert 2 Elves to discard a condition.
fields.lore: “‘You have entered the realm of the Lady of the Wood – you cannot go back.'”

fields.title: Sichtbares und Unsichtbares
fields.lore: "Du hast das Reich der Herrin des Waldes betreten – du kannst nicht zurückgehen.“

fields.title: Lo Visible y Lo Invisible
fields.lore: “Habéis entrado en el reino de la Dama del Bosque – no podéis regresar.”

fields.title: Le Visible et l'Invisible
fields.lore: “Vous êtes entré dans le royaume de la Dame de la Forêt – vous ne pouvez repartir.”

fields.title: Visibili e Invisibili
fields.lore: “‘Siete entrati nel regno della Dama della Foresta – non potete tornare indietro.'”

cards.title: Shoulder to Shoulder
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.
cards.lore: “‘May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'”

fields.title: Shoulder to Shoulder
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.
fields.lore: “‘May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'”

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.

fields.title: Schulter an Schulter
fields.lore: "Möge es, obwohl die Welt jetzt düster ist, ein Zeichen sein, dass bessere Tage bevorstehen und die Freundschaft zwischen unseren Völkern erneuert wird."

fields.title: Hombro con Hombro
fields.lore: “Quizá es un anuncio de mejores días, aunque las sombras cubran ahora el mundo, y de una nueva amistad entre nuestros pueblos.”

fields.title: Épaule Contre Épaule
fields.lore: “Puisse cet Événement marquer la proximité de jours meilleurs, en dépit des heures sombres que traverse actuellement le monde, ainsi qu'un renouvellement de l'amitié entre nos deux peuples.”

fields.title: Spalla a Spalla
fields.lore: “‘Possa ciò essere un presagio che, malgrado l'odierna oscurità del mondo, giorni migliori ci attendano e che l'amicizia sia rinnovata tra i nostri popoli.'”

cards.title: Silinde
cards.subtitle: Elf of Mirkwood
cards.gameText: While you can spot your site 3, Silinde has the game text of that site.
cards.lore: Among the representatives of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood was Silinde, friend of the House of Thranduil.

fields.title: Silinde
fields.subtitle: Elf of Mirkwood
fields.gameText: While you can spot your site 3, Silinde has the game text of that site.
fields.lore: Among the representatives of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood was Silinde, friend of the House of Thranduil.

fields.subtitle: Elb aus dem Düsterwald
fields.lore: Unter den Gesandten der Elben des nördlichen Düsterwaldes befand sich Silinde, ein Freund des Hauses Thranduil.

fields.subtitle: Elfo del Bosque Negro
fields.lore: Entre los representantes de los Elfos del norte del Bosque Negro estaba Silinde, amigo de la Casa de Thranduil.

fields.subtitle: Elfe de la Forêt Noire
fields.lore: Parmi les représentants des Elfes du nord de la Forêt Noire se trouvait Silinde, ami de la Maison de Thranduil.

fields.subtitle: Elfo di Bosco Atro
fields.lore: Tra i rappresentanti degli elfi a nord del Bosco Atro c'era Silinde, amico della Casa di Thranduil.

cards.title: Songs of the Blessed Realm
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an [ELVEN] tale, you may remove a burden.
cards.lore: Elves seem to like music and poetry and tales as much as Hobbits like food.

fields.title: Songs of the Blessed Realm
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an [ELVEN] tale, you may remove a burden.
fields.lore: Elves seem to like music and poetry and tales as much as Hobbits like food.

fields.title: Lieder des glückseligen Reichs
fields.lore: Es scheint, dass Elben Musik und Dichtkunst eben so sehr lieben, wie die Hobbits das Essen.

fields.title: Canciones del Reino Bendecido
fields.lore: Parece ser que a los Elfos les gusta tanto la música la poesía y las canciones tanto como a los Hobbits la comida.

fields.title: Chants du Royaume Béni
fields.lore: Les Elfes semblent aimer la musique et la poésie autant que les Hobbits aiment la nourriture.

fields.title: Canzone del Reame Benedetto
fields.lore: Gli Elfi sembrano amare la musica, la poesia e i racconti quanto gli Hobbit amano il cibo.

cards.title: The Splendor of Their Banners
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make the fellowship archery total +1.
cards.lore: “‘It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'”

fields.title: The Splendor of Their Banners
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make the fellowship archery total +1.
fields.lore: “‘It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'”

fields.title: Die Pracht ihrer Banner
fields.lore: "Es erinnerte mich an den Glanz der Altvorderenzeit und an die Heere Beleriands, denn so viele große Fürsten und Hauptleute waren versammelt.“

fields.title: El Esplendor de Los Estandartes
fields.lore: “Me recordaron la gloria de los Días Antiguos y las huestes de Beleriand, tantos grandes príncipes y capitanes estaban allí presentes.”

fields.title: La Splendeur de leurs Bannières
fields.lore: “Elle me rappelait la gloire des Jours Anciens et les armées de Beleriand, où tant de grands princes et capitaines étaient assemblés.”

fields.title: Lo Splendore delle Loro Bandiere
fields.lore: “‘Ricordo perfettamente lo splendore delle loro bandiere, mi rammento la gloria dei Tempi remoti e degli eserciti del Beleriand dove tanti grandi principi e capitani si erano riuniti.'”

cards.title: Stand Against Darkness
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard a [SAURON] minion, a [SAURON] condition, or a [SAURON] possession.
cards.lore: “‘What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy...?'”

fields.title: Stand Against Darkness
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard a [SAURON] minion, a [SAURON] condition, or a [SAURON] possession.
fields.lore: “‘What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy...?'”

fields.title: Stand Against Darkness
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound a [SAURON] minion twice or discard a [SAURON] condition or possession.

fields.title: Kampf gegen die Dunkelheit
fields.lore: "Was an Macht noch bleibt, beruht auf uns hier in Imladris oder auf Círdan an den Anfurten, oder auf Lórien. Aber haben sie die Kraft, haben wir hier die Kraft, dem Feind zu widerstehen...?“

fields.title: En Contra de La Oscuridad
fields.lore: “El poder que todavía queda esta aquí, en Imladris, o en Cirdan de los Puertos, o en Lórien. ¿Pero tienen ellos la fuerza, tendremos nosotros la fuerza de resistir al Enemigo...?”

fields.title: Faire Face aux Ténèbres
fields.lore: “Ce qu'il reste encore de pouvoir réside en nous, ici à Imladris, chez Círdan aux Havres ou en Lórien. Mais ont-ils la force, avons-nous ici la force de résister à l'ennemi...?”

fields.title: Resistere all'Oscurità
fields.lore: “‘Il potere che sopravvive ancora si trova qui da noi a Imladris, o da Cìrdan ai Rifugi Oscuri; oppure a Lòrien. Ma hanno essi la forza di lottare, abbiamo noi la forza di resistere al Nemico...?'”

cards.title: Support of the Last Homely House
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 3. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
cards.lore: “Merely to be there was a cure for weariness, fear, and sadness.”

fields.title: Support of the Last Homely House
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 3. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
fields.lore: “Merely to be there was a cure for weariness, fear, and sadness.”

fields.title: Pflege im Letzten Heimeligen Haus
fields.lore: Das blosse Dortsein genügte, um Müdigkeit, Furcht und Traurigkeit zu heilen.

fields.title: Apoyo del Último Hogar
fields.lore: “Bastaba quedarse allí para curarse del cansancio, el miedo y la melancolía.”

fields.title: Soutien de la Dernière Maison Accueillante
fields.lore: “Le seul fait de se trouver là était un remède à la fatigue, à la peur ou à la tristesse.”

fields.title: Supporto dell'Ultima Casa Accogliente
fields.lore: “Il semplice fatto di viverci era una cura per la stanchezza, la paura e la tristezza.”

cards.title: Swan-ship of the Galadhrim
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 6. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
cards.lore: “...and suddenly they perceived that it was a ship, wrought and carved with elven-skill in the likeness of a bird.”

fields.title: Swan-ship of the Galadhrim
