fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 6. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
fields.lore: “...and suddenly they perceived that it was a ship, wrought and carved with elven-skill in the likeness of a bird.”

fields.title: Schwanenboot der Galadrim
fields.lore: "...und plötzlich merkten sie, dass es ein Schiff war, das die Geschicklichkeit der Elben als Abbild eines Vogels gearbeitet und geschnitzt hatte.“

fields.title: Nave-Cisne de Los Galadrim
fields.lore: “...y de pronto se dieron cuenta de que el cisne era una nave construida y esculpida con todo el arte élfico.”

fields.title: Vaisseau-Cygne des Galadhrim
fields.lore: “...et soudainement ils s'aperçurent que c'était un navire construit et sculpté, avec tout l'art elfique, à l'image d'un oiseau.”

fields.title: Nave-Cigno dei Galadhrim
fields.lore: “...d'un tratto si accorsero che era una barca, costruita e scolpita con le sembianze di un cigno dall'abilità degli Elfi.”

cards.title: The Tale of Gil-galad
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘Gil-galad was an Elven-king / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.'”

fields.title: The Tale of Gil-galad
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘Gil-galad was an Elven-king / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.'”

fields.title: Die Geschichte von Gil-galad
fields.lore: "Gil-galad war ein Elbenfürst. Die Harfe klagt im Liede noch: Von Berg und Meer umfriedet lag sein Reich im Glanz und ohne Joch.“

fields.title: El Cuento de Gil-Galad
fields.lore: “Gil-Galad era un Rey de los Elfos / los trovadores lamentaban la suerte / del ultimo reino libre y hermoso / entre las montañas y el océano.”

fields.title: Le Récit de Gil-galad
fields.lore: “Gil-galad était un roi des Elfes ; / De lui, les ménestrels chantent tristement: / Le dernier dont le royaume fut beau et libre / Des montagnes à la mer.”

fields.title: Il Racconto di Gil-galad
fields.lore: “Gil-galad sugli elfi soleva regnare / Tristi cantano ora i menestrelli: / i giorni ancor liberi e belli/ del suo regno tra i Monti ed il Mare.”

cards.title: Uruviel
cards.subtitle: Maid of Lorien
cards.gameText: While you can spot your site 6, Uruviel has the game text of that site.
cards.lore: An Elf-maid of the Galadhrim, Uruviel has dwelt for years beneath the mallorn trees of Lothlórien.

fields.title: Uruviel
fields.subtitle: Maid of Lorien
fields.gameText: While you can spot your site 6, Uruviel has the game text of that site.
fields.lore: An Elf-maid of the Galadhrim, Uruviel has dwelt for years beneath the mallorn trees of Lothlórien.

fields.subtitle: Maid aus Lórien
fields.lore: Als eine Elbenmaid der Galadrim lebt Uruviel seit vielen Jahren unter den Mallornbäumen Lothlóriens.

fields.subtitle: Doncella de Lórien
fields.lore: Una doncella Elfo de los Galadhrim, Uruviel ha vivido durante años bajo los árboles Mallorn de Lothlórien.

fields.subtitle: Demoiselle de Lórien
fields.lore: Une demoiselle Elfe des Galadhrim, Uruviel est restée des années sous les mallornes de Lothlórien.

fields.subtitle: Fanciulla di Lórien
fields.lore: Elfica fanciulla dei Galadhrim, Uruviel ha dimorato per anni sotto gli alberi d'oro di Lothlórien.

cards.title: The White Arrows of Lórien
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make an opponent discard 2 cards at random from hand.
cards.lore: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.

fields.title: The White Arrows of Lórien
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make an opponent discard 2 cards at random from hand.
fields.lore: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.

fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to exert a minion. An opponent may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Die weissen Pfeile von Lórien
fields.lore: Gradlinig und zielsicher, sind die Pfeile des goldenen Waldes bekannt für ihre Tödlichkeit.

fields.title: Las Flechas Blancas de Lórien
fields.lore: Rectas y certeras, las flechas del Bosque Dorado son conocidas por dejar una señal mortífera.

fields.title: Les Flèches Blanches de Lórien
fields.lore: Droites et solides, les flèches de la Forêt Dorée sont connues pour laisser une marque mortelle.

fields.title: Le Bianche Frecce di Lórien
fields.lore: Dritte e precise, le frecce del Bosco d'oro è risaputo che lascino un segno mortale.

cards.title: Albert Dreary
cards.subtitle: Entertainer From Bree
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf. Maneuver: Exert Albert Dreary to discard a [ISENGARD] or [MORIA] condition.
cards.lore: Typical of Bree-folk, Albert is a plain but stout-hearted fellow. He does not seek trouble, but he is willing to protect his home.

fields.title: Albert Dreary
fields.subtitle: Entertainer From Bree
fields.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf. Maneuver: Exert Albert Dreary to discard a [ISENGARD] or [MORIA] condition.
fields.lore: Typical of Bree-folk, Albert is a plain but stout-hearted fellow. He does not seek trouble, but he is willing to protect his home.

fields.subtitle: Unterhaltungskünstler aus Bree
fields.lore: Typisch für Breevolk, ist Albert ein einfacher, aber beherzter Kerl. Er sucht keinen Ärger, ist aber bereit Haus und Hof zu verteidigen.

fields.title: Alberto Lúgubre
fields.subtitle: Artista de Bree
fields.lore: Típico entre las gentes de Bree, Alberto es un tipo sencillo pero de corazón firme. No busca problemas, pero esta dispuesto a proteger su hogar.

fields.title: Albert Morne
fields.subtitle: Artiste de Bree
fields.lore: Représentatif des gens de Bree, Albert est un camarade simple mais au c*ur vaillant. Il ne recherche pas les problèmes, mais il est soucieux de protéger sa demeure.

fields.title: Alberto Lugubre
fields.subtitle: Intrattenitore di Brea
fields.lore: Tipico cittadino di Brea, Alberto è un compagno tranquillo ma coraggioso. Non cerca guai, ma è pronto a proteggere la sua casa.

cards.title: Barliman Butterbur
cards.subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a [GANDALF] event into hand from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. ‘He is wise enough on his own ground.'”

fields.title: Barliman Butterbur
fields.subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a [GANDALF] event into hand from your discard pile.
fields.lore: “‘You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. ‘He is wise enough on his own ground.'”

fields.title: Barliman Butterbur
fields.subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a spell into hand from your discard pile.

fields.title: Gerstenmann Butterblume
fields.subtitle: Wirt des Tänzelnden Pony
fields.lore: "Nicht einmal über sie wisst ihr viel, wenn du den alten Gerstenmann für dumm hälst“, sagte Gandalf. "Auf seinem Gebiet ist er weise genug.“

fields.title: Cebadilla Mantecona
fields.subtitle: Propietario del Poney Pisador
fields.lore: “Sabes de veras muy poco si crees que el viejo Cebadilla es estúpido – dijo Gandalf –. Es bastante sagaz en su propio terreno.”

fields.title: Prosper Poiredebeurré
fields.subtitle: Propriétaire du Poney Fringant
fields.lore: “‘Vous ne connaissez même pas grand-chose de ceux-là, si vous pensez que le vieux Prosper est bête,' dit Gandalf. ‘Il est assez sagace dans son domaine propre.'”

fields.title: Omorzo Cactaceo
fields.subtitle: Oste del Puledro Impennato
fields.lore: “‘Nemmeno su di loro sai molto, se credi che il vecchio Cactaceo sia sciocco', disse Gandalf. ‘Nel suo campo è assai saggio.'”

cards.title: Durin’s Secret
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf, a Dwarf, and an Elf to make the move limit for this turn +1.
cards.lore: “‘They are wrought of ithildin that mirrors only starlight and moonlight, and sleeps until it is touched by one who speaks words now long forgotten in Middle-earth.'”

fields.title: Durin’s Secret
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf, a Dwarf, and an Elf to make the move limit for this turn +1.
fields.lore: “‘They are wrought of ithildin that mirrors only starlight and moonlight, and sleeps until it is touched by one who speaks words now long forgotten in Middle-earth.'”

fields.title: Durins Geheimnis
fields.lore: "Sie sind aus ithildin gearbeitet, das nur Sternenlicht und Mondlicht widerspiegelt und schläft, bis es von jemandem berührt wird, der Worte spricht, die jetzt in Mittelerde längst vergessen sind.“

fields.title: El Secreto de Durin
fields.lore: “Están labradas en ithildin que solo refleja la luz de las estrellas y la luna, y que duerme hasta el momento en que alguien lo toca pronunciando ciertas palabras que en la Tierra Media se olvidaron tiempo atrás.”

fields.title: Le Secret de Durin
fields.lore: “‘Ils sont faits d'ithildin, qui ne reflète que la lumière des étoiles et de la lune et qui dort jusqu'au moment où il est touché par quelqu'un qui prononce certains mots depuis longtemps oubliés en Terre du Milieu.'”

fields.title: Segreto di Durin
fields.lore: “‘Sono intarsi d'Ithildin, che riflette solo i raggi di luna e di stelle, e dorme sin quando non sente il tocco di chi pronunzia parole ormai da tempo obliate nella Terra di Mezzo.'”

cards.title: Gandalf
cards.subtitle: Friend of the Shirefolk
cards.gameText: Gandalf is strength +1 for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Hobbit, Dwarf, Elf, and Man.
cards.lore: “‘Among the Wise I am the only one that goes in for hobbit-lore: an obscure branch of knowledge, but full of surprises.'”

fields.title: Gandalf
fields.subtitle: Friend of the Shirefolk
fields.gameText: Gandalf is strength +1 for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Hobbit, Dwarf, Elf, and Man.
fields.lore: “‘Among the Wise I am the only one that goes in for hobbit-lore: an obscure branch of knowledge, but full of surprises.'”

fields.subtitle: Freund des Auenlandes
fields.lore: "Unter den Weisen bin ich der einzige, der sich mit Hobbitkunde befasst: ein unbekannter Wissenszweig, aber voller Überraschungen.“

fields.subtitle: Amigo de La Comarca
fields.lore: “Entre los Sabios soy el único que estudia la ciencia hobbit: una oscura rama del conocimiento, pero colmada de raras sorpresas.”

fields.subtitle: Ami des Gens de la Comté
fields.lore: “‘Parmi les Sages, je suis le seul qui s'intéresse à la tradition hobbite: branche obscure de la connaisance, mais pleine de surprises.'”

fields.subtitle: Amico della Gente della Contea
fields.lore: “‘Tra i Saggi sono l'unico ad interessarmi della tradizione hobbit:, un campo estremamente oscuro ma pieno di sorprese.'”

cards.title: Gandalf's Cart
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a Free Peoples artifact (or possession) from hand on this card, or play a card stacked here as if played from hand.
cards.lore: “...a cart came in through Bywater... An old man was driving it all alone.”

fields.title: Gandalf's Cart
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a Free Peoples artifact (or possession) from hand on this card, or play a card stacked here as if played from hand.
fields.lore: “...a cart came in through Bywater... An old man was driving it all alone.”

fields.title: Gandalfs Karren
fields.lore: ...fuhr... ein zweirädriger Karren durch Wasserau. Ein alter Mann saß ganz allein darauf.

fields.title: El Carro de Gandalf
fields.lore: “...un carro que parecía venir del puente del Brandivino entró en Delagua a pleno día. Lo conducía un viejo.”

fields.title: Charrette de Gandalf
fields.lore: “...une charrette entra en plein jour par Lèzeau.... Un vieillard la conduisait seul.”

fields.title: Il Carro di Gandalf
fields.lore: “...un carro traversò Lungacque ... Era guidato da un vecchio.”

cards.title: Gandalf’s Pipe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove X burdens.
cards.lore: “‘I know what is the matter with me,' he muttered, as he sat down by the door. ‘I need smoke!'”

fields.title: Gandalf’s Pipe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove X burdens.
fields.lore: “‘I know what is the matter with me,' he muttered, as he sat down by the door. ‘I need smoke!'”

fields.title: Gandalfs Pfeife
fields.lore: "Ich weiss, was mit mir los ist“, murmelte er, als er sich an die Tür setzte. "Ich brauche was zu rauchen!.“

fields.title: La Pipa de Gandalf
fields.lore: “Ya sé lo que me ocurre – murmuro mientras se sentaba junto a la puerta –. ¡Necesito un poco de humo!”

fields.title: Pipe de Gandalf
fields.lore: “‘Je sais bien ce qui ne va pas,' murmura-t-il en s'asseyant près de la porte. ‘J'ai besoin de fumer !'”

fields.title: La Pipa di Gandalf
fields.lore: “‘So cosa vi è in me che non va', mormorò, sedendosi vicino alla porta. ‘Ho bisogno di fumare!'”

cards.title: Glamdring
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed.
cards.lore: “...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.”

fields.title: Glamdring
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed.
fields.lore: “...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.”
...aber in seiner Rechten glänzte Glamdring, kalt und weiss.
“...pero en la otra relampagueaba Glamdring, fría y blanca.”
“...dans l'autre main Glamdring luisait, froide et blanche.”
“...nella destra Glamdring scintillava, fredda e bianca.”

cards.title: Intimidate
cards.gameText: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “‘Go back to the Shadow!'”

fields.title: Intimidate
fields.gameText: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.
fields.lore: “‘Go back to the Shadow!'”

fields.title: Einschüchtern
fields.lore: "Geh zurück zu den Schatten!“

fields.title: Intimidar
fields.lore: “¡Vuelve a la Sombra!”

fields.title: Intimider
fields.lore: “‘Retournez à l'Ombre !'”

fields.title: Intimidire
fields.lore: “‘Torna nell'Ombra!”

cards.title: Let Folly Be Our Cloak
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert X companions to remove (X).
cards.lore: “‘Well, let folly be our cloak, a veil before the eyes of the Enemy!... Into his heart the thought will not enter that any will refuse it, that having the Ring we may seek to destroy it.'”

fields.title: Let Folly Be Our Cloak
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert X companions to remove (X).
fields.lore: “‘Well, let folly be our cloak, a veil before the eyes of the Enemy!... Into his heart the thought will not enter that any will refuse it, that having the Ring we may seek to destroy it.'”

fields.title: Lasst Torheit unseren Deckmantel sein
fields.lore: "Nun gut, lasst Torheit unseren Deckmantel sein, einen Schleier vor den Augen des Feindes! ...Ihm wird der Gedanke nicht kommen, dass jemand keinen Gebrauch davon machen will, dass wir den Ring haben und dennoch trachten könnten, ihn zu zerstören.“

fields.title: Que La Locura Sea Nuestro Manto
fields.lore: “Bueno. ¡Que la locura sea nuestro manto, un velo en los ojos del Enemigo!... No se le ocurrirá nunca que alguien pueda rehusar el poder, que teniendo el Anillo queramos destruirlo.”

fields.title: Que la Folie Soit Notre Manteau
fields.lore: “‘Eh bien, que la folie soit notre manteau, un voile devant les yeux de l'ennemi ! ...Dans son c*ur n'entrera jamais la pensée que quiconque puisse refuser ce pouvoir, qu'ayant l'Anneau nous puissions chercher à le détruire.'”

fields.title: La Follia sia il Nostro Manto
fields.lore: “‘Ebbene, che la follia sia il nostro manto, un velo dinanzi agli occhi del nemico! ...La sua mente non accetterebbe mai il pensiero che qualcuno possa rifiutare il tanto bramato potere, o che, possedendo l'Anello, voglia distruggerlo. ‘”

cards.title: Mysterious Wizard
cards.gameText: Spell. Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if there are 4 or fewer burdens on the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: “‘...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'”

fields.title: Mysterious Wizard
fields.gameText: Spell. Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if there are 4 or fewer burdens on the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: “‘...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'”

fields.title: Geheimnisvoller Zauberer
fields.lore: "Es gibt schlimmere und ältere Dinge als Orks in den Tiefen dieser Welt.“

fields.title: Mago Misterioso
fields.lore: “... Hay cosas mas viejas e inmundas que los Orcos en las profundidades del mundo.”

fields.title: Mystérieux Magicien
fields.lore: “‘...il y a dans les profondeurs du monde des êtres plus anciens et plus répugnants que les Orques.'”

fields.title: Stregone Misterioso
fields.lore: “‘...ci sono cose più antiche e più immonde degli Orchi nei luoghi profondi della terra.'”

cards.title: The Nine Walkers
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a companion whose race you cannot spot, that companion's twilight cost is -2.
cards.lore: “‘Nine companions to match the Nine Ringwraiths... So be it.'”

fields.title: The Nine Walkers

fields.lore: “‘Nine companions to match the Nine Ringwraiths... So be it.'”

fields.title: Die neun Wanderer
fields.lore: "Neun Gefährten für neun Ringgeister... So sei es!“

fields.title: Los Nueve Caminantes
fields.lore: “Nueve compañeros para igualar a los Nueve Espectros del Anillo... Que así sea.”

fields.title: Les Neuf Marcheurs
fields.lore: “‘Neuf compagnons opposés aux Neuf Spectres de l'Anneau.... Qu'il en soit ainsi.'”

fields.title: I Nove Viandanti
fields.lore: “‘Nove compagni per affrontare i nove spettri dell'Anello ... Così sia.'”

cards.title: Ottar
cards.subtitle: Man of Laketown
cards.gameText: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
cards.lore: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.

fields.subtitle: Mensch aus Seestadt
fields.lore: Die Menschen von Seestadt kommen aus dem Norden, wo sie mit den Zwergen vom Einsamen Berg Handel treiben.

fields.subtitle: Hombre de La Ciudad del Lago
fields.lore: Los Hombres de la Ciudad del Lago vienen del Norte, donde comercian con los Enanos de la Montaña Solitaria.

fields.subtitle: Homme de la Ville du Lac
fields.lore: Les Hommes de la Ville du Lac viennent du Nord, où ils commercent avec les Nains du Mont Solitaire.

fields.subtitle: Uomo di Pontelagolungo
fields.lore: Gli uomini di Pontelagolungo, provengono dal Nord, dove commerciano con i Nani della Montagna Solitaria.

cards.title: Questions That Need Answering
cards.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Take 2 of those cards into hand and discard the rest.
cards.lore: “‘There are some things that I must see to....'”

fields.title: Questions That Need Answering

fields.lore: “‘There are some things that I must see to....'”

fields.title: Fragen, die einer Antwort bedürfen
fields.lore: "...aber ich habe etwas gehört, ...um das ich mich kümmern muss.“

fields.title: Preguntas Que Requieren Respuesta
fields.lore: “Hay algunas cosas que tengo que vigilar...”

fields.title: Des Questions qui Nécessitent des Réponses
fields.lore: “‘Il y a certaines choses auxquelles je dois voir....'”

fields.title: Domande che Richiedono una Risposta
fields.lore: “‘Ci sono alcune cose che devo vedere per....'”

cards.title: Risk a Little Light
cards.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 2 cards of your draw deck. Take one into hand and discard the other.
cards.lore: “‘Let me risk a little more light.'”

fields.title: Risk a Little Light
fields.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 2 cards of your draw deck. Take one into hand and discard the other.
fields.lore: “‘Let me risk a little more light.'”

fields.title: Ein wenig Licht wagen
fields.lore: "Ich will jetzt ein wenig wirkliches Licht wagen.“

fields.title: Arriesgar un Poco de Luz
fields.lore: “Dejad que me arriesgue con un poco mas de luz.”

fields.title: Risquer une Petite Lueur
fields.lore: “‘Laissez-moi risquer un petit peu plus de lumière.'”

fields.title: Rischiare una Piccola Luce
fields.lore: “‘Lasciatemi rischiare un po' più di luce.'”

cards.title: Servant of the Secret Fire
cards.gameText: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make a minion strength -3.
cards.lore: “‘I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor. You cannot pass.'”

fields.title: Servant of the Secret Fire
fields.gameText: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make a minion strength -3.
fields.lore: “‘I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor. You cannot pass.'”

fields.title: Diener des Geheimen Feuers
fields.lore: "Ich bin ein Diener des Geheimen Feuers und Gebieter über die Flamme von Anor. Du kannst nicht vorbei.“

fields.title: Servidor del Fuego Secreto
fields.lore: “Soy un servidor del Fuego Secreto, que es amo de la llama de Anor. No puedes pasar.”

fields.title: Serviteur du Feu Secret
fields.lore: “‘Je suis un serviteur du Feu Secret, qui détient la flamme d'Anor. Vous ne pouvez passer.'”

fields.title: Servitore del Fuoco Segreto
fields.lore: “‘Sono un servitore del Fuoco Segreto, e reggo la fiamma di Anor. Non puoi passare.'”

cards.title: Sleep, Caradhras
cards.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to discard every condition.
cards.lore: “‘Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'”

fields.title: Sleep, Caradhras
fields.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to discard every condition.
fields.lore: “‘Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'”

fields.title: Sleep, Caradhras
fields.gameText: Spell.\Exert Gandalf to discard a Shadow condition and then hinder all other conditions.

fields.title: Schlafe Caradhras!
fields.lore: "Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.“

fields.title: Duerme, Caradhras
fields.lore: “Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.”

cards.title: Strength of Spirit
cards.gameText: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to exert, spot Gandalf to place no token for that exertion.
cards.lore: “‘There are many powers in the world, for good or for evil. Some are greater than I am. Against some I have not yet been measured. But my time is coming.'”

fields.title: Strength of Spirit
fields.gameText: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to exert, spot Gandalf to place no token for that exertion.
fields.lore: “‘There are many powers in the world, for good or for evil. Some are greater than I am. Against some I have not yet been measured. But my time is coming.'”

fields.title: Kraft des Geistes
fields.lore: "Es gibt viele Mächte in der Welt, gute und böse. Manche sind größer als ich. Und mit manchen habe ich mich noch nicht gemessen. Aber meine Zeit naht.“

fields.title: Fuerza del Espíritu
fields.lore: “Hay muchos poderes en el mundo, para el bien y para el mal. Muchos de ellos son más grandes que yo. Contra algunos todavía no me he medido. Pero mi tiempo se acerca.”

fields.title: Force de l'Esprit
fields.lore: “‘Il y a bien des pouvoirs dans le monde, pour le bien comme pour le mal. Certains sont plus grands que je ne le suis. Contre d'autres je ne me suis encore jamais mesuré. Mais mon heure approche.'”

fields.title: Forza dello Spirito
fields.lore: “‘Vi sono molte potenze al mondo, buone e malvagie; alcune sono più forti di me. Altre non le ho ancora incontrate; ma l'ora sta per giungere.'”

cards.title: Treachery Deeper Than You Know
cards.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand.
cards.lore: “‘By foul craft, Saruman has crossed Orc with Goblin Men – he is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard.'”

fields.title: Treachery Deeper Than You Know
fields.gameText: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand.
fields.lore: “‘By foul craft, Saruman has crossed Orc with Goblin Men – he is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard.'”

fields.title: Größerer Verrat, als ihr ahnt
fields.lore: "Durch üblen Zauber hat Saruman Orks mit Goblins gekreuzt – er erschafft eine Armee in den Höhlen von Isengart.“

fields.title: Traición Mas Profunda de Lo Que Imaginas
fields.lore: “Con inmunda habilidad, Saruman ha cruzado Orcos con Hombres Goblin – esta criando un ejercito en las Cavernas de Isengard.”

fields.title: Trahison Plus Profonde que Vous ne le Pensez
fields.lore: “‘Par un artifice infâme, Saroumane a croisé des Orques avec des Hommes – il élève une armée dans les Cavernes d'Isengard.'”

fields.title: Tradimento Inconcepibile
fields.lore: “‘Con una ripugnante abilità, Saruman ha incrociato gli Orchi con Uomini Orchi – lui sta generando un'armata nelle Caverne di Isengard.'”

cards.title: A Wizard Is Never Late
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Play a [GANDALF] character from your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'”

fields.title: A Wizard Is Never Late
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Play a [GANDALF] character from your draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'”

fields.title: A Wizard Is Never Late
fields.gameText: Play a Wizard or [GANDALF] ally from your draw deck.

fields.title: Ein Zauberer kommt nie zu spät
fields.lore: "Ein Zauberer kommt nie zu spät, Frodo Beutlin, ebensowenig zu früh. Er trifft genau dann ein, wann er es beabsichtigt.“

fields.title: Un Mago Nunca Llega Tarde
fields.lore: “Un mago nunca llega tarde, Frodo Bolsón, ni pronto. Llega precisamente cuando tiene que llegar.”

fields.title: Un Magicien n'est Jamais en Retard
fields.lore: “‘Un magicien n'est jamais en retard, Frodon Sacquet, ni en avance. Il arrive précisément quand il en a l'intention.'”

fields.title: Uno Stregone Non è Mai in Ritardo
fields.lore: “‘Uno stregone non è mai in ritardo, Frodo Baggins, né in anticipo. Arriva precisamente quando intende farlo.'”

cards.title: An Able Guide
cards.gameText: Regroup: Spot a ranger to remove (4).
cards.lore: “‘...though I cannot disappear, I have hunted many wild and wary things and I can usually avoid being seen, if I wish.'”

fields.title: An Able Guide
fields.gameText: Regroup: Spot a ranger to remove (4).
fields.lore: “‘...though I cannot disappear, I have hunted many wild and wary things and I can usually avoid being seen, if I wish.'”

fields.title: Ein fähiger Führer
fields.lore: "...und wenngleich ich nicht verschwinden kann, so habe ich doch viele wilde und wachsame Geschöpfe gejagt und kann es, wenn ich will, gewöhnlich vermeiden, gesehen zu werden.“

fields.title: Un Guía Capaz
fields.lore: “...y aunque no puedo desaparecer, he seguido las huellas de muchas criaturas salvajes y cautelosas, y comúnmente evito que me vean, si así lo deseo.”

fields.title: Un Guide Compétent
fields.lore: “‘...bien que je ne puisse disparaître, j'ai chassé maintes créatures sauvages et méfiantes, et je puis généralement éviter d'être vu, si je le désire.'”

fields.title: Un'Abile Guida
fields.lore: “‘...e benché non abbia il potere di scomparire, ho dato la caccia a un sì gran numero di cose selvagge e di esseri guardinghi, che riesco generalmente a evitare di essere visto, quando lo desidero.'”

cards.title: Aragorn
cards.subtitle: Ranger of the North
cards.gameText: Ranger. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters – but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy....'”

fields.title: Aragorn
fields.subtitle: Ranger of the North
fields.gameText: Ranger. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters – but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy....'”

fields.subtitle: Waldläufer des Nordens
fields.lore: "Einsame Männer sind wir, Waldläufer in der Wildnis, Jäger – aber gejagt haben wir immer die Diener des Feindes...“

fields.subtitle: Montaraz del Norte
fields.lore: “Somos hombres solitarios, los Montaraces del desierto, cazadores; pero las presas son siempre los siervos del Enemigo...”

fields.subtitle: Rôdeur du Nord
fields.lore: “‘Nous sommes des hommes solitaires, Rôdeurs des Terres Sauvages, chasseurs – mais toujours chasseurs des serviteurs de l'Ennemi....'”

fields.subtitle: Ramingo del Nord
fields.lore: “‘Siamo uomini solitari, Raminghi delle zone selvagge, cacciatori – ma ostinati cacciatori dei servi del Nemico...'”

cards.title: Aragorn’s Bow
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Exert Aragorn to wound a minion; Aragorn does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: Rangers learn the bow as well as the blade.

fields.title: Aragorn’s Bow
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Exert Aragorn to wound a minion; Aragorn does not add to the fellowship archery total.
fields.lore: Rangers learn the bow as well as the blade.

fields.title: Aragorns Bogen
fields.lore: Waldläufer können mit dem Bogen genauso gut umgehen, wie mit dem Schwert.

fields.title: El Arco de Aragorn
fields.lore: Los Montaraces aprenden a usar el arco así como la espada.

fields.title: Arc d'Aragorn
fields.lore: Les Rôdeurs apprennent l'arc aussi bien que l'épée.

fields.title: Arco di Aragorn
fields.lore: I Raminghi conoscono bene l'arco quanto la spada.

cards.title: Aragorn’s Pipe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal X companions.
cards.lore: “He had a tall tankard in front of him, and was smoking a long-stemmed pipe curiously carved.”

fields.title: Aragorn’s Pipe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal X companions.
fields.lore: “He had a tall tankard in front of him, and was smoking a long-stemmed pipe curiously carved.”

fields.title: Aragorns Pfeife
fields.lore: Er hatte einen hohen Bierkrug vor sich und rauchte aus einer seltsam geschnitzten langstieligen Pfeife.

fields.title: La Pipa de Aragorn
fields.lore: “Tenia un tazón delante de él, y fumaba una pipa de caño largo, curiosamente esculpida.”

fields.title: Pipe d'Aragorn
fields.lore: “Il avait devant lui une grande chope, et il fumait une pipe à long tuyau, curieusement sculptée.”

fields.title: Pipa di Aragorn
fields.lore: “Aveva un grosso boccale di metallo davanti a sé e fumava una pipa dal lungo cannello intagliato stranamente.”

cards.title: Armor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
cards.lore: “Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

fields.title: Armor
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
fields.lore: “Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

fields.title: Armor
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

fields.title: Rüstung
fields.lore: "Dann wurden Elendil der Große und seine mächtigen Söhne Isildur und Anárion große Herrscher; und sie errichteten das Nordreich in Arnor und das Südreich in Gondor...“

fields.title: Armadura
fields.lore: “Luego Elendil el Alto y sus poderosos hijos, Isildur y Anarion, llegaron a ser grandes señores, y fundaron en Arnor el Reino del Norte, y en Gondor, cerca de las bocas de Anduin, el Reino del Sur.”

fields.title: Armure
fields.lore: “Puis Elendil le Beau et ses puissants fils, Isildur et Anárion, devinrent grands seigneurs ; ils créèrent le Royaume du Nord en Arnor et le Royaume du Sud en Gondor....”

fields.title: Armatura
fields.lore: “Quindi vennero i grandi regni di Elendil l'Alto e dei suoi potenti figli di Isildur ed Anárion; Arnor fu allora il Reame del Nord, e Gondor, intorno alle foci dell'Anduin, il Reame del Sud ...”

cards.title: Arwen's Fate
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make Arwen strength +3, or exert Arwen to make Aragorn strength +3.
cards.lore: For the love of a mortal Man, Arwen, daughter of Elrond, must forsake her Elven heritage, and give up forever her journey to the Undying Lands.

fields.title: Arwen's Fate
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make Arwen strength +3, or exert Arwen to make Aragorn strength +3.
fields.lore: For the love of a mortal Man, Arwen, daughter of Elrond, must forsake her Elven heritage, and give up forever her journey to the Undying Lands.

fields.title: Arwens Schicksal
fields.lore: Aus Liebe zu einem Sterblichen muss Elronds Tochter Arwen ihr elbisches Erbe aufgeben und für immer auf die Reise zu den unsterblichen Ländern verzichten.

fields.title: El Destino de Arwen
fields.lore: Por el amor de un Hombre mortal, Arwen, hija de Elrond, debe abandonar su herencia Élfica, y renunciar para siempre a su viaje a las Tierras Imperecederas.

fields.title: Le Destin d'Arwen
fields.lore: Pour l'amour d'un Homme mortel, Arwen, fille d'Elrond, doit abandonner son héritage elfique, et renoncer pour toujours à son séjour dans les Terres Immortelles.

fields.title: Il Fato di Arwen
fields.lore: Per l'amore di un uomo mortale, Arwen figlia di Elrond, deve abbandonare la sua eredità elfica, e rinunciare per sempre al suo viaggio verso le Terre Immortali

cards.title: Athelas
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession to heal a companion or to remove a Shadow condition from a companion.
cards.lore: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the true king be known.

fields.title: Athelas
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession to heal a companion or to remove a Shadow condition from a companion.
fields.lore: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the true king be known.
Die Hände des Königs sind heilende Hände, und so soll der wahre König erkannt werden.
Las manos del rey son las manos de un curador, así será reconocido el verdadero rey.
Les mains du roi sont celles d'un guérisseur. Et ainsi pouvait-on toujours connaître le roi légitime.
Le mani di re sono mani di guaritore, è così che verrà riconosciuto il vero re.

cards.title: Blade of Gondor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to wound an Orc or Uruk-hai he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: With the valour of Boromir's mighty longsword, the Enemies of the West are kept at bay.

fields.title: Blade of Gondor
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to wound an Orc or Uruk-hai he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: With the valour of Boromir's mighty longsword, the Enemies of the West are kept at bay.

fields.title: Das Schwert von Gondor
fields.lore: Boromirs Mut und sein mächtiges Langschwert halten die Feinde des Westens in Schach.

fields.title: Hoja de Gondor
fields.lore: Con el valor de la poderosa espada larga de Boromir los Enemigos del Oeste son mantenidos a raya.

fields.title: Épée de Gondor
fields.lore: Avec la valeur de la puissante épée longue de Boromir, les Ennemis de l'Ouest sont maintenus à distance.

fields.title: Lama di Gondor
fields.lore: Grazie al valore del potente spadone di Boromir, i Nemici dell'Ovest sono tenuti a bada.

cards.title: Boromir
cards.subtitle: Lord of Gondor
cards.gameText: Ranger. Boromir is not overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
cards.lore: “‘...Boromir will also be in the Company. He is a valiant man.'”

fields.title: Boromir
fields.subtitle: Lord of Gondor
fields.gameText: Ranger. Boromir is not overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
fields.lore: “‘...Boromir will also be in the Company. He is a valiant man.'”

fields.subtitle: Herr von Gondor
fields.lore: "Daher wird auch Boromir zur Gemeinschaft gehören. Er ist ein tapferer Mann.“

fields.subtitle: Señor de Gondor
fields.lore: “Por lo tanto Boromir estará también en la Compañía. Es un hombre valiente.”

fields.subtitle: Seigneur de Gondor
fields.lore: “‘...Boromir sera aussi dans la compagnie. C'est un homme valeureux.'”

fields.subtitle: Sire di Gondor
fields.lore: “‘...Boromir farà perciò anch'egli parte della Compagnia. E' un uomo valoroso.'”

cards.title: Boromir
cards.subtitle: Son of Denethor
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make a Hobbit strength +3.
cards.lore: “‘Long has my father, the Steward of Gondor, held the forces of Mordor at bay – by the blood of our people are the lands of others kept safe.'”

fields.title: Boromir
fields.subtitle: Son of Denethor
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make a Hobbit strength +3.
fields.lore: “‘Long has my father, the Steward of Gondor, held the forces of Mordor at bay – by the blood of our people are the lands of others kept safe.'”

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Denethor
fields.lore: "Lange hat mein Vater, der Truchsess von Gondor, die Mächte von Mordor abgewehrt – durch das Blut meines Volkes leben die anderen in Sicherheit.“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Denethor
fields.lore: “Por mucho tiempo mi padre, el Senescal de Gondor, ha mantenido las fuerzas de mordor a raya – por la sangre de nuestra gente las tierras de otros son seguras.”

fields.subtitle: Fils de Denethor
fields.lore: “‘Longtemps mon père, l'Intendant du Gondor, a tenu les forces de Mordor à distance – par le sang de notre peuple les terres des autres sont en sécurité.'”

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Denethor
fields.lore: “‘Da molto tempo, mio padre, il Sovrintendente di Gondor, ha tenuto a bada le forze di Mordor – grazie al sangue della nostra gente le terre degli altri sono mantenute sicure.'”

cards.title: Boromir's Cloak
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.
cards.lore: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”

fields.title: Boromir's Cloak
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.
fields.lore: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”

fields.title: Boromir's Cloak
fields.gameText:
Bearer must be Boromir.
Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.\Response: If a skirmish event or special ability is used during a skirmish involving Boromir, discard this to prevent that.

fields.title: Boromirs Mantel
fields.lore: Er trug Mantel und Stiefel wie für eine Reise zu Pferde; und obwohl seine Kleidung reich war und sein Mantel mit Pelz besetzt, wiesen sie Spuren einer langen Wanderschaft auf.

fields.title: La Capa de Boromir
fields.lore: “Estaba vestido con manto y botas, como para un viaje a caballo, y en verdad aunque las ropas eran ricas, y el manto tenia borde de piel, parecía venir de un largo viaje.”

fields.title: Cape de Boromir
fields.lore: “Il portait un manteau et des bottes comme pour un long trajet à cheval ; et, en vérité, bien que ses vêtements fussent riches et que son manteau fût bordé de fourrure, ils étaient défraichis par un long voyage.”

fields.title: Mantello di Boromir
fields.lore: “Portava mantello e stivali, come se fosse reduce da un lungo viaggio a cavallo; infatti, benché gli abiti fossero sontuosi e la cappa foderata di pelliccia, le tracce della sua cavalcatura erano piuttosto evidenti.”

cards.title: Change of Plans
cards.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger to make an opponent shuffle his hand into his draw deck and draw 8 cards.
cards.lore: “‘Then let me help you. There are other ways, Frodo – other paths that we might take.'”

fields.title: Change of Plans
fields.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger to make an opponent shuffle his hand into his draw deck and draw 8 cards.
fields.lore: “‘Then let me help you. There are other ways, Frodo – other paths that we might take.'”

fields.title: Neue Pläne
fields.lore: "Dann lass mich dir helfen. Es gibt andere Wege, Frodo – andere Pfade, denen wir folgen können.“

fields.title: Cambio de Planes
fields.lore: “Déjame ayudarte pues. Hay otras maneras, Frodo – otros caminos que podemos tomar.”

fields.title: Changement de Plan
fields.lore: “‘Alors laissez-moi vous aider. Il y a d'autres façons, Frodon – d'autres voies que nous pouvons prendre.'”

fields.title: Cambio di Programma
fields.lore: “‘Poi lascia che ti aiuti. Ci sono altre strade, Frodo – altri sentieri che potremmo prendere.'”

cards.title: The Choice of Lúthien
cards.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to heal Arwen, or exert Arwen to heal Aragorn.
cards.lore: “‘But she chose mortality, and to die from the world, so that she might follow him; and it is sung that they met again beyond the Sundering Seas....'”

fields.title: The Choice of Lúthien
fields.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to heal Arwen, or exert Arwen to heal Aragorn.
fields.lore: “‘But she chose mortality, and to die from the world, so that she might follow him; and it is sung that they met again beyond the Sundering Seas....'”

fields.title: Lúthiens Entscheidung
fields.lore: "Sie aber wählte die Sterblichkeit und wollte die Welt verlassen, damit sie ihm folgen könne; und so heisst es in dem Lied, dass sie sich jentseits des Trennenden Meeres wiedertrafen...“

fields.title: La Elección de Lúthien
fields.lore: “Pero ella eligió la mortalidad, y morir para el mundo, para así poder seguirlo, y aun se canta que se encontraron mas allá de los Mares que Separan...”

fields.title: Le Choix de Lúthien
fields.lore: “‘Mais elle choisit l'état de mortelle, voulant quitter le monde pour le suivre ; et l'on chante qu'ils se retrouvèrent au-delà des Mers Séparatrices....'”

fields.title: La Scelta di Lúthien
fields.lore: “‘Ma ella scelse la mortalità, e di morire al mondo, per poterlo seguire. Si canta che si incontrarono nuovamente al di là dei Mari che separano i mondi....'”

cards.title: Coat of Mail
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
cards.lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.

fields.title: Coat of Mail
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
fields.lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.

fields.title: Coat of Mail
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

fields.title: Panzerhemd
fields.lore: Die Soldaten des weissen Turms schätzen bereits lange die Handwerkskunst der Rüstschmiede Gondors.

fields.title: Cota de Mallas
fields.lore: Los Soldados de la Torre Blanca han apreciado durante mucho tiempo el arte de los herreros de Gondor.

fields.title: Cotte de Mailles
fields.lore: Les Soldats de la Tour Blanche ont longtemps apprécié le savoir-faire des forgerons du Gondor.

fields.title: Cotta di Maglia
fields.lore: I soldati della Torre Bianca hanno a lungo apprezzato la maestria dei fabbri ferrai di Gondor.

cards.title: Dagger Strike
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] or [SHIRE] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.
cards.lore: Every warrior needs a sword, bow, or axe – but sometimes, a dagger is enough.

fields.title: Dagger Strike
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] or [SHIRE] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.
fields.lore: Every warrior needs a sword, bow, or axe – but sometimes, a dagger is enough.

fields.title: Dolchstoss
fields.lore: Jeder Krieger braucht ein Schwert, einen Bogen oder eine Axt – aber manchmal genügt auch ein Dolch.

fields.title: Golpe de Daga
fields.lore: Todo guerrero necesita una espada, un arco o un hacha – pero a veces, una daga es suficiente.

fields.title: Coup de Dague
fields.lore: Chaque guerrier a besoin d'une épée, d'un arc et d'une hache – mais parfois une dague est suffisante.

fields.title: Colpo di Pugnale
fields.lore: Ogni guerriero ha bisogno di una spada, arco, o ascia – ma a volte, un pugnale è sufficiente.

cards.title: Elendil's Valor
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Make a [GONDOR] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'”

fields.title: Elendil's Valor
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Make a [GONDOR] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'”

fields.title: Elendils Mut
fields.lore: "Dem alten Königsbrauch Gemäß / Legte er Helm und Rüstung an, / Grub Runen in den Silberschild / Zum Schutze gegen Harm und Not...“

fields.title: El Valor de Elendil
fields.lore: “De una panoplia de antiguos reyes / obtuvo anillos encadenados, / un escudo con letras rúnicas / para evitar desgracias y heridas...”

fields.title: La Vaillance d'Elendil
fields.lore: “‘De l'armure des anciens rois, / D'anneaux attachés par des chaînes il s'arma ; / Son brillant bouclier de runes était gravé / Pour détourner de lui toutes blessures et tout mal....'”

fields.title: Valore di Elendil
fields.lore: “‘Un'armatura dei re antichi, / in maglia di anelli intrecciati; / Sullo scudo intagliate le rune / Contro tutti i pericoli e i mali....'”

cards.title: Eregion's Trails
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a ranger to make each roaming minion strength -3 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “Guided by Aragorn they struck a good path. It looked to Frodo like the remains of an ancient road, that had once been broad and well planned....”

fields.title: Eregion's Trails
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a ranger to make each roaming minion strength -3 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “Guided by Aragorn they struck a good path. It looked to Frodo like the remains of an ancient road, that had once been broad and well planned....”

fields.title: Eregions Pfade
fields.lore: Unter Führung von Aragorn fanden sie einen guten Weg. Frodo kam es vor, als sei er ein Überbleibsel einer alten Strasse..., die einst breit und gut angelegt gewesen war.

fields.title: Los Senderos de Eregion
fields.lore: “Guiados por Aragorn encontraron un buen sendero. Le pareció a Frodo que eran los restos de un antiguo camino, en otro tiempo ancho y bien trazado...”

fields.title: Les Pistes d'Eregion
fields.lore: “Guidés par Aragorn, ils trouvèrent un bon sentier. Il sembla à Frodon que c'étaient les restes d'une ancienne route, qui avait été large et bien tracée....”

fields.title: Sentieri di Eregion
fields.lore: “Sotto la guida di Aragorn si avviarono per un buon sentiero, che a Frodo parve di un'antica strada in passato ampia e ben progettata....”

cards.title: Foes of Mordor
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] character to wound a [SAURON] minion.
cards.lore: Through the long years, the Men of The Tower of Guard have shielded the West from the minions of the Eye.

fields.title: Foes of Mordor
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] character to wound a [SAURON] minion.
fields.lore: Through the long years, the Men of The Tower of Guard have shielded the West from the minions of the Eye.

fields.title: Die Feinde Mordors
fields.lore: All die Jahre haben die Männer des Wachenden Turms den Westen vor den Schergen des Auges bewahrt.

fields.title: Enemigos de Mordor
fields.lore: A través de largos años los Hombres de la Guardia de la Torre han protegido el Oeste de los siervos del Ojo.

fields.title: Ennemis du Mordor
fields.lore: Au fil des ans, les Hommes de la Tour de Garde ont protégé l'Ouest des séides de l'*il.

fields.title: Nemici di Mordor
fields.lore: Per lunghi anni, gli Uomini della Torre di Guardia hanno protetto l'Ovest dai servi dell'Occhio.

cards.title: Gondor's Vengeance
cards.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to discard a minion.
cards.lore: A Ranger in the wild is a deadly foe for the forces of the Shadow.

fields.title: Gondor's Vengeance
fields.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to discard a minion.
fields.lore: A Ranger in the wild is a deadly foe for the forces of the Shadow.

fields.title: Gondors Vergeltung
fields.lore: Ein Waldläufer in der Wildnis ist ein tödlicher Feind für die Mächte des Schattens.

fields.title: La Venganza de Gondor
fields.lore: Un Montaraz en terreno salvaje es un adversario mortal para las fuerzas de la Sombra.

fields.title: La Vengeance de Gondor
fields.lore: Un Rôdeur dans les Terres Sauvages est un ennemi mortel pour les forces de l'Ombre.

fields.title: Vendetta di Gondor
fields.lore: Un Ramingo nelle Terre Selvagge è un nemico mortale per le forze dell'Ombra.

cards.title: Great Shield
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. The minion archery total is -1.
cards.lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.

fields.title: Great Shield
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. The minion archery total is -1.
fields.lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.

fields.title: Great Shield
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. The minion archery total is -1.

fields.title: Langschild
fields.lore: Das Königreich Gondor hat viele Schmiede, die in der Kunst geschult sind, gutes Kriegswerkzeug herzustellen.

fields.title: Gran Escudo
fields.lore: El Reino de Gondor tiene herreros muy hábiles en la creación de poderosas herramientas de guerra.

fields.title: Grand Bouclier
fields.lore: Le Royaume de Gondor a des forgerons plus expérimentés dans la création de solides instruments de guerre.

fields.title: Grande Scudo
fields.lore: Il regno di Gondor ha fabbri molto esperti nel creare forti strumenti di guerra.

cards.title: No Stranger to the Shadows
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a ranger. Limit 1 per ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.
cards.lore: “‘Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. ‘My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'”

fields.title: No Stranger to the Shadows
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a ranger. Limit 1 per ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.
fields.lore: “‘Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. ‘My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'”

fields.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be a ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.

fields.title: Vertraut mit den Schatten
fields.lore: "Ach, da hattet ihr mich nicht dabei“, lachte Streicher. "Meine Wege, ob gerade oder krumm, gehen nicht fehl.“

fields.title: No Le Es Extraño a Las Sombras
fields.lore: “Ah, pero todavía no me teníais con vosotros – dijo Trancos riendo –. Mis atajos, largos o cortos, nunca terminan mal.”

fields.title: Habitué des Ombres
fields.lore: “‘Ah, mais vous ne m'aviez pas avec vous alors,' dit Grands-Pas, riant. ‘Mes raccourcis, courts ou longs, ne tournent jamais mal.'”

fields.title: A Suo Agio tra le Ombre
fields.lore: “‘Ah, ma non c'ero io quella volta' disse ridendo Granpasso. ‘La mie scorciatoie, lunghe o corte che siano, non sgarrano mai.'”

cards.title: One Whom Men Would Follow
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
cards.lore: “‘The skill of the elves can reforge the Sword of Elendil – but only you have the power to wield it.'”

fields.title: One Whom Men Would Follow
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
fields.lore: “‘The skill of the elves can reforge the Sword of Elendil – but only you have the power to wield it.'”

fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

fields.title: Einer, dem man folgen würde
fields.lore: "Die Kunstfertigkeit der Elben kann das Schwert Elendils wiederherstellen – aber nur du kannst es führen.“

fields.title: Uno a Quien Los Hombres Seguirían
fields.lore: “La habilidad de los Elfos puede reforjar la Espada de Elendi – pero solo si tienes el poder para empuñarla.”

fields.title: Quelqu'un que les Hommes Suivraient
fields.lore: “‘Le talent des Elfes peut reforger l'Épée d'Elendil – mais vous seul avez le pouvoir de la manier.'”

fields.title: Colui che gli Uomini Seguirebbero
fields.lore: “‘La destrezza degli Elfi può riforgiare la Spada di Elendil – ma solo tu hai il permesso di maneggiarla.'”

cards.title: Pathfinder
cards.gameText: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
cards.lore: “‘Strider can take you by paths that are seldom trodden. Will you have him?'”

fields.title: Pathfinder
fields.gameText: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
fields.lore: “‘Strider can take you by paths that are seldom trodden. Will you have him?'”

fields.title: Pfadfinder
fields.lore: "Streicher kann euch auf Pfaden führen, die selten begangen werden. Wollt ihr ihn haben?“

fields.title: Explorador
fields.lore: “Trancos podría guiarlo por senderos poco transitados. ¿Lo llevara con usted?”

fields.title: Éclaireur
fields.lore: “‘Grands-Pas peut vous mener par des sentiers rarement parcourus. Le voulez-vous ?'”

fields.title: Esploratore
fields.lore: “‘Grampasso può indicarvi sentieri poco frequentati. Può venire con voi?'”

cards.title: Pursuit Just Behind
cards.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to wound every minion.
cards.lore: “‘We must do something to delay the enemy first. We will make them fear the Chamber of Mazarbul!'”

fields.title: Pursuit Just Behind
fields.gameText: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to wound every minion.
fields.lore: “‘We must do something to delay the enemy first. We will make them fear the Chamber of Mazarbul!'”

fields.title: Sie sind direkt hinter uns!
fields.lore: "Wir müssen erst etwas tun, um den Feind aufzuhalten. Wir wollen sie lehren, die Kammer von Mazarbul zu fürchten!“

fields.title: Acoso En La Retaguardia
fields.lore: “Ante todo tratemos de demorarlos. ¡Haremos que teman a la Cámara de Mazarbul!”

fields.title: À leurs Trousses
fields.lore: “‘Il faut d'abord faire quelque chose pour retarder l'ennemi. Nous allons leur inspirer la crainte de la Chambre de Mazarbul !'”

fields.title: Inseguimento Incalzante
fields.lore: “‘Dobbiamo fare qualcosa per contenere il nemico. Faremo loro temere la Camera di Mazarbul!'”

cards.title: Ranger’s Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1.
cards.lore: Aragorn is a trustworthy companion and a deadly foe. His years roaming the wild have honed his swordfighting skills.

fields.title: Ranger’s Sword
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1.
fields.lore: Aragorn is a trustworthy companion and a deadly foe. His years roaming the wild have honed his swordfighting skills.

fields.title: Das Schwert des Waldläufers
fields.lore: Aragorn ist ein treuer Gefährte und ein tödlicher Gegner. Seine Jahre der Wanderschaft in der Wildnis haben seine Schwertkampfkünste verfeinert.

fields.title: La Espada del Montaraz
fields.lore: Aragorn es un compañero de confianza y un mortífero enemigo. Sus años vagando en las zonas salvajes han afilado su habilidad con la espada.

fields.title: Épée du Rôdeur
fields.lore: Aragorn est un compagnon digne de confiance et un ennemi mortel. Ses années d'errance dans les terres sauvages aiguisèrent ses talents d'épéiste.

fields.title: Spada di Ramingo
fields.lore: Aragorn è un compagno fidato e un nemico letale. I suoi anni di vagabondo nelle terre selvagge hanno affilato le sue abilità di combattente con la spada.

cards.title: A Ranger's Versatility
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a ranger at a river or forest to exhaust a minion.
cards.lore: “‘If you bring a Ranger with you, it is well to pay attention to him, especially if the Ranger is Aragorn.'”

fields.title: A Ranger's Versatility
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a ranger at a river or forest to exhaust up to 2 minions.
fields.lore: “‘If you bring a Ranger with you, it is well to pay attention to him, especially if the Ranger is Aragorn.'”

fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a ranger at a river or forest to exhaust a minion.

fields.title: Die zahlreichen Talente eines Waldläufers
fields.lore: "Wenn man einen Waldläufer bei sich hat, dann tut man gut daran, auf ihn zu hören, besonders wenn der Waldläufer Aragorn ist.“

fields.title: La Versatilidad de un Montaraz
fields.lore: “Si traes a un Montaraz contigo , es bueno prestarle atención, y más aun si el Montaraz es Aragorn.”

fields.title: Polyvalence de Rôdeur
fields.lore: “‘Quand on emmène avec soi un Rôdeur, il est bon de lui prêter attention, surtout quand ce Rôdeur est Aragorn.'”

fields.title: La Versatilità di un Ramingo
fields.lore: “‘Portando seco un Ramingo, è opportuno prestare orecchio alle sue parole, specialmente se quel Ramingo è Aragorn.'”

cards.title: The Saga of Elendil
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
cards.lore: From out of the depths of the Sea, from the foundered land of Númenor, came Elendil to Middle-earth to found the kingdoms of Arnor and Gondor.

fields.title: The Saga of Elendil
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
fields.lore: From out of the depths of the Sea, from the foundered land of Númenor, came Elendil to Middle-earth to found the kingdoms of Arnor and Gondor.

fields.title: Die Legende von Elendil
fields.lore: Aus den Tiefen des Meeres, aus den Gründerlanden der Númenor, kam Elendil nach Mittelerde, um die Königreiche von Arnor und Gondor zu erschaffen.

fields.title: La Saga de Elendil
fields.lore: Desde el mar profundo, desde la hundida tierra de Númenor, vino Elendil a la Tierra Media a fundar los reinos de Arnor y Gondor.

fields.title: La Saga d'Elendil
fields.lore: Des profondeurs de la Mer, des terres submergées de Númenor, vint Elendil dans les Terres du Milieu pour fonder les royaumes d'Arnor et de Gondor.

fields.title: La Saga di Elendil
fields.lore: Dalle profondità del Mare, dalle sprofondate terre di Númenor, Elendil arrivò nella Terra di Mezzo per fondare i regni di Arnor e Gondor.

cards.title: Strength of Kings
cards.gameText: Response: If a Skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [GONDOR] Man, cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'”

fields.title: Strength of Kings
fields.gameText: Response: If a Skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [GONDOR] Man, cancel that event.
fields.lore: “‘Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'”

fields.title: Strength of Kings
fields.gameText: If a skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [GONDOR] companion, cancel that event.

fields.title: Kraft der Könige
fields.lore: "Glaubt nicht, dass im Lande Gondor das Blut der Númenor kraftlos sei oder all sein Stolz und Würde vergessen.“

fields.title: Fuerza de Los Reyes
fields.lore: “No creáis que en las tierras de Gondor se haya extinguido la sangre de Númenor, ni que todo el orgullo y la dignidad de aquel pueblo hayan sido olvidados.”

fields.title: Force des Rois
fields.lore: “‘Ne croyez pas qu'au Pays de Gondor, le sang de Númenor soit épuisé, ni que toute sa fierté et sa dignité soient oubliées.'”

fields.title: Forza dei Re
fields.lore: “‘Non crediate che nella terra di Gondor il sangue di Nùmenor sia del tutto scomparso, e la sua gloria e dignità obliate.'”

cards.title: Swordarm of the White Tower
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +4 if he is defender +1).
cards.lore: “‘By our valour the wild folk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lands behind us, bulwark of the West.'”

fields.title: Swordarm of the White Tower
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +4 if he is defender +1).
fields.lore: “‘By our valour the wild folk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lands behind us, bulwark of the West.'”

fields.title: Schwertarm des Weissen Turms
fields.lore: "Denn durch unsere Beherztheit wird dem wilden Volk des Ostens noch Einhalt geboten und der Schrecken von Mordor in Schach gehalten; und allein dadurch werden Frieden und Freiheit bewahrt in den Ländern hinter uns, die wir das Bollwerk des Westens sind.“

fields.title: Espada de La Torre Blanca
fields.lore: “Nuestro valor ha contenido a los bárbaros del Este, y al terror de Morgul, y solo así han sido aseguradas la paz y la libertad en las tierras que están detrás de nosotros, el baluarte del Oeste.”

fields.title: Bras Droit de la Tour Blanche
fields.lore: “‘Par notre valeur, les gens de l'Est sont encore refrénés et la terreur de Morgul tenue en respect ; et c'est ainsi seulement que la paix et la liberté sont assurées dans les terres qui sont derrière nous, rempart de l'Ouest.'”

fields.title: Braccio Armato della Torre Bianca
fields.lore: “‘E' merito del vostro valore se la gente dell'Est non ha ancora fatto irruzione, e il terrore di Morgul è tenuto lontano; grazie a noi la pace e la libertà perdurano nei paesi alle nostre spalle, baluardo dell'Occidente.'”

cards.title: Swordsman of the Northern Kingdom
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +4 when skirmishing a roaming minion).
cards.lore: “‘This is no mere Ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn... and you owe him your allegiance.'”

fields.title: Swordsman of the Northern Kingdom
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +4 when skirmishing a roaming minion).
fields.lore: “‘This is no mere Ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn... and you owe him your allegiance.'”

fields.title: Schwertkämpfer des nördlichen Königreiches
fields.lore: "Er ist nicht nur ein Waldläufer. Es ist Aragorn, Arathorns Sohn... und ihm gilt euer Treueschwur.“

fields.title: Espadachín del Reino del Norte
fields.lore: “Este no es un simple Montaraz. Él es Aragorn, hijo de Arathorn... y le debes lealtad.”

fields.title: Fine Lame du Royaume du Nord
fields.lore: “‘Ce n'est pas un Rôdeur ordinaire. Il est Aragorn, fils d'Arathorn ... et vous lui devez allégeance.'”

fields.title: Spadaccino del Regno del Nord
fields.lore: “‘Questo è non più un Ramingo. Egli è Aragorn, figlio di Arathorn ... e tu gli devi la tua alleanza.'”

cards.title: Valiant Man of the West
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Make Aragorn defender +1 and he takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase until the regroup phase.

fields.title: Tapferer Mann des Westens
fields.lore: "Ich habe geschworen, dich zu beschützen...“

fields.title: Hombre Valiente del Oeste
fields.lore: “...hago el juramento de protegerte.”

fields.title: Homme Vaillant de l'Ouest
fields.lore: “‘...je jure de vous protéger.'”

fields.title: Intrepido Uomo dell'Ovest
fields.lore: “‘...Ho giurato di proteggerti.'”

fields.title: What Are They?

fields.title: Was sind sie?
fields.lore: "Sie waren Menschen... früher einmal.“

fields.title: ¿Que Son?
fields.lore: “Fueron Hombres... Una vez.”

fields.title: Que Sont-Ils ?
fields.lore: “‘Ils étaient des hommes ... autrefois.'”

fields.title: Che Cosa Sono?
fields.lore: “‘Erano uomini... una volta.'”

fields.lore: “‘Bring them to me.... Kill the others....'”

fields.title: Lebendig und unversehrt
fields.lore: "Bringt sie mir lebendig... Tötet die anderen...“

fields.title: Vivos y Sin Estropear
fields.lore: “Traédmelos... Matad a los otros...”

fields.title: Vivant et Indemne
fields.lore: “‘Apportez-les-moi..... Tuez les autres....'”

fields.title: Vivi e Intatti
fields.lore: “‘Portateli a me... Uccidete gli altri....'”

cards.title: Bred for Battle
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai to make it strength +3.
cards.lore: “‘You are the Uruk-hai of Isengard!... you do not know pain, you do not know fear.'”

fields.title: Bred for Battle

fields.lore: “‘You are the Uruk-hai of Isengard!... you do not know pain, you do not know fear.'”

fields.title: Für den Kampf gezüchtet
fields.lore: "Ihr seid die Uruk-hai von Isengart! Das Blut in euren Adern ist kalt und schwarz – ihr kennt keinen Schmerz, ihr kennt keine Furcht – denn ihr seid Diener der weissen Hand – die euch Menschenfleisch zum Fraß vorwirft.“

fields.title: Criados Para La Batalla
fields.lore: “¡Vosotros sois los Uruk-hai de Isengard!... No conocéis el dolor, no conocéis el miedo.”

fields.title: Élevé pour la Bataille
fields.lore: “‘Vous êtes les Ourouk-Haï d'Isengard ! ... vous ne connaissez pas la souffrance, vous ne connaissez pas la peur.'”

fields.title: Nati Per Combattere
fields.lore: “‘Voi siete gli Uruk-hai di Isengard! Il sangue nelle vostre vene è nero e freddo – non conoscete il dolore, non conoscete la paura.'”

cards.title: Breeding Pit
cards.gameText: Response: If you play an Uruk-hai, take all copies of that card in your discard pile and place them beneath your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘He is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard. An army that can move in sunlight and cover great distance at speed.'”

fields.title: Breeding Pit

fields.lore: “‘He is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard. An army that can move in sunlight and cover great distance at speed.'”

fields.title: Brutstätten
fields.lore: "Er züchtet eine Armee in den Verliesen Isengarts heran. Eine Armee, der die Sonne nichts anhaben kann und die große Entfernungen zurücklegt.“

fields.title: Pozo de Crianza
fields.lore: “Él esta criando un ejército en las Cavernas de Isengard. Un ejercito que se puede mover a la luz del día y cubrir grandes distancias rápidamente.”

fields.title: Fosse d'Élevage
fields.lore: “‘Il élève une armée dans les Cavernes d'Isengard. Une armée qui peut se déplacer à la lumière du soleil et couvrir de grandes distances à grande vitesse.'”

fields.title: Pozzo Generatore
fields.lore: “‘Sta generando un'armata nelle Caverne di Isengard. Un'armata che può muoversi alla luce del sole e coprire in marcia grandi distanze.'”

cards.title: Caradhras Has Not Forgiven Us
cards.gameText: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert a [ISENGARD] minion and spot 5 companions to discard an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: “‘It was no ordinary storm. It is the ill will of Caradhras.'”

fields.title: Caradhras hat uns noch nicht vergeben
fields.lore: "Es war kein gewöhnlicher Schneesturm. Es ist Caradhras‘ Bosheit.“

fields.title: Caradhras No Nos Ha Perdonado
fields.lore: “No era una tormenta ordinaria, sino la mala voluntad de Caradhras.”

fields.title: Caradhras ne Nous a pas Pardonnés
fields.lore: “‘Ce n'était pas une tempête ordinaire. C'est la malveillance de Caradhras.'”

fields.title: Il Caradhras Non Ci Ha Perdonato
fields.lore: “‘Non era una normale tempesta. E' la volontà ostile del Caradhras.'”

cards.title: Cruel Caradhras
cards.gameText: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert a [ISENGARD] minion to make the opponent choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
cards.lore: “‘Yonder stands Barazinbar, the Redhorn, cruel Caradhras....'”

fields.title: Cruel Caradhras
fields.gameText: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert a [ISENGARD] minion to make the opponent choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
fields.lore: “‘Yonder stands Barazinbar, the Redhorn, cruel Caradhras....'”

fields.title: Grausamer Caradhras
fields.lore: "Dort drüben erhebt sich Barazinbar, das Rothorn, der grausame Caradhras...“
“Mas allá se encuentra Barazinbar, el Cuerno Rojo, el cruel Caradhras...”
“‘Là-bas se dresse Barazinbar, le Rubicorne, le cruel Caradhras....'”

fields.title: Crudele Caradhras
fields.lore: “‘Laggiù si erge Barazinbar, il Cornorosso, il crudele Caradhras....'”

cards.title: Greed
cards.gameText: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and remove (2) to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: “‘It is a strange fate that we should suffer so much fear and doubt over so small a thing....'”

fields.title: Greed
fields.gameText: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and remove (2) to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: “‘It is a strange fate that we should suffer so much fear and doubt over so small a thing....'”

fields.title: Habgier
fields.lore: "Es ist schon ein seltsames Schicksal, das uns soviel Angst und Zweifel wegen eines so kleinen Dings, beschert.“

fields.title: Codicia
fields.lore: “Es un extraño destino que suframos tanto miedo y tantas dudas por una cosa tan pequeña...”

fields.title: Avidité
fields.lore: “‘N'est-ce pas un étrange destin que nous dussions endurer tant de peur et de doutes pour une si petite chose....'”

fields.title: Avidità
fields.lore: “‘Non è uno strano destino, dover soffrire tanta paura e tante incertezze per un oggetto così minuto....'”

cards.title: Hunt Them Down!
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘Do not stop until they are found!'”

fields.title: Hunt Them Down!
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘Do not stop until they are found!'”

fields.title: Bringt sie zur Strecke!
fields.lore: "Jagt sie! Bis ihr sie gefunden habt!“

fields.title: ¡Buscad Hasta Dar Con Ellos!
fields.lore: “¡No paréis hasta encontrarlos!”

fields.title: Chassez-les !
fields.lore: “‘N'arrêtez pas jusqu'à ce qu'ils soient trouvés !”

fields.title: Date Loro la Caccia!
fields.lore: “‘Non vi fermate finché non li avrete trovati!”

cards.title: Lurtz
cards.subtitle: Servant of Isengard
cards.gameText: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot another Uruk-hai to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘And now... perfected. Grown beyond the height of Men – straight-limbed and strong, fearing nothing.'”

fields.title: Lurtz
fields.subtitle: Servant of Isengard
fields.gameText: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot another Uruk-hai to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘And now... perfected. Grown beyond the height of Men – straight-limbed and strong, fearing nothing.'”

fields.subtitle: Diener Isengarts
fields.lore: "Nun ist er perfekt. Größer als ein Mensch – aufrecht und stark, sich vor nichts und niemandem fürchtend.“

fields.subtitle: Servidor de Isengard
fields.lore: “Y ahora... Perfeccionado. Mas alto que la estatura de los Hombres – de miembros rectos y fuertes, sin temor a nada.”

fields.subtitle: Serviteur d'Isengard
fields.lore: “‘Et maintenant ... parfait. Grandissant plus haut que les Hommes – des membres droits et forts, ne craignant rien.'”

fields.subtitle: Servo di Isengard
fields.lore: “‘E ora... era perfetto. Cresciuto oltre la statura degli Uomini – dalle membra squadrate e forti, non teme niente.'”

cards.title: Lurtz's Battle Cry
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength -1 and damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Find the Halflings!'”

fields.title: Lurtz's Battle Cry
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength -1 and damage +1.
fields.lore: “‘Find the Halflings!'”

fields.title: Lurtz‘ Kampfschrei
fields.lore: "Findet die Halblinge!“

fields.title: Grito de Combate de Lurtz
fields.lore: “Encontrad a los Medianos!”

fields.title: Cri de Guerre de Lurtz
fields.lore: “‘Trouvez les Semi-Hommes !'”

fields.title: Grido di Battaglia di Lurtz
fields.lore: “‘Trovate i Mezzuomini!'”

cards.title: The Misadventure of Mr. Underhill
cards.gameText: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each companion played to a site which is not a sanctuary is +2.
cards.lore: “‘You're drawing far too much attention to yourself... Mr. Underhill.'”

fields.title: The Misadventure of Mr. Underhill
fields.gameText: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each companion played to a site which is not a sanctuary is +2.
fields.lore: “‘You're drawing far too much attention to yourself... Mr. Underhill.'”

fields.title: Das Missgeschick des Herrn Unterberg
fields.lore: "Ihr erregt zuviel Aufmerksamkeit... Herr Unterberg.“

fields.title: Las Desventuras del Señor Sotomonte
fields.lore: “Estas llamando mucho la atención... Señor Sotomonte.”

fields.title: La Mésaventure de M. Soucolline
fields.lore: “‘Vous attirez par trop l'attention sur vous-même ... M. Soucolline.'”

fields.title: La Disavventura del Signor Sottocolle
fields.lore: “‘Stai attirando troppo l'attenzione su di te... Signor Sottocolle'”

cards.title: No Ordinary Storm
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a weather condition, exert a [GANDALF] companion or [GANDALF] ally.
cards.lore: “‘So Gandalf... you try to lead them over Caradhras. And if that fails – where then will you go?'”

fields.title: No Ordinary Storm
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a weather condition, exert a [GANDALF] companion or [GANDALF] ally.
fields.lore: “‘So Gandalf... you try to lead them over Caradhras. And if that fails – where then will you go?'”

fields.title: Kein gewöhnlicher Sturm
fields.lore: "Nun Gandalf, du versuchst sie über den Caradhras zu führen. Und wenn das fehlschlägt, welchen Weg wählt ihr dann?“

fields.title: No Era una Tormenta Ordinaria
fields.lore: “Así pues Gandalf... Intentas guiarlos a través del Caradhras. Y sí eso falla – ¿a donde iras?”

fields.title: Pas une Tempête Ordinaire
fields.lore: “‘Alors Gandalf ... vous essayez de les mener au-delà du Caradhras. Et si cela échoue – où irez-vous alors ?'”

fields.title: Una Tempesta Straordinaria
fields.lore: “‘Così Gandalf... tu provi a condurli oltre il Caradhras. E se dovessi fallire – poi dove andrai?'”

cards.title: Orthanc Assassin
cards.gameText: Archer. Damage +1.
cards.lore: Black-feathered arrows from Uruk-hai bows reign over the corpses of Saruman's enemies.

fields.title: Orthanc Assassin
fields.gameText: Archer. Damage +1.
fields.lore: Black-feathered arrows from Uruk-hai bows reign over the corpses of Saruman's enemies.

fields.title: Orthanc Attentäter
fields.lore: Schwarzgefiederte Pfeile der Uruk-hai stecken in den Leichen von Sarumans Feinden.

fields.title: Asesino de Orthanc
fields.lore: Las flechas de penachos negros de los arcos Uruk-hai reinan sobre los cadáveres de los enemigos de Saruman.

fields.title: Assassin d'Orthanc
fields.lore: Les flèches empennées de noir des arcs Ourouk-Haï règnent sur les corps des ennemis de Saroumane.

cards.title: Parry
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot an Uruk-hai to cancel the strength bonus from a possession until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: Even the sword of a powerful warrior can be parried by the strength of an Uruk-hai.

fields.title: Parry
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot an Uruk-hai to cancel the strength bonus from a possession until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: Even the sword of a powerful warrior can be parried by the strength of an Uruk-hai.

fields.title: Parade
fields.lore: Selbst das Schwert eines mächtigen Kriegers aus Gondor, kann durch die schiere Kraft eines Uruk-hai aufgehalten werden.

fields.title: Parada
fields.lore: Incluso la espada de un guerrero poderoso puede ser detenida por la fuerza de un Uruk-hai.

fields.title: Parade
fields.lore: Même le coup d'épée d'un puissant guerrier peut être paré par la force d'un Ourouk-Haï.

fields.title: Parata
fields.lore: Anche la spada di un potente guerriero può essere parata dalla forza di un Uruk-hai.

cards.title: Saruman's Ambition
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of your [ISENGARD] events is -1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Uruk-hai strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘I did not expect you to show wisdom, even in your own behalf; but I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, and so saving yourself much trouble and pain.'”

fields.title: Saruman's Ambition
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of your [ISENGARD] events is -1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Uruk-hai strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘I did not expect you to show wisdom, even in your own behalf; but I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, and so saving yourself much trouble and pain.'”

fields.title: Sarumans Ehrgeiz
fields.lore: "Ich habe nicht erwartet, dass du Weisheit erkennen lassen würdest... doch habe ich dir die Möglichkeit geboten, mir freiwillig zu helfen und dir damit viel Ärger und Pein zu ersparen.“

fields.title: La Ambición de Saruman
fields.lore: “No esperé que mostraras mucha sabiduría, ni aun para tu propio beneficio, pero te di la posibilidad de que me ayudaras por tu propia voluntad, evitándote así dificultades y sinsabores.”

fields.title: L'Ambition de Saroumane
fields.lore: “‘Je ne m'attendais pas que vous fissiez preuve de sagesse, fût-ce à votre propre avantage ; mais je vous donnais la chance de m'aider de plein gré et de vous éviter ainsi beaucoup d'ennuis et de souffrance.'”

fields.title: Ambizione di Saruman
fields.lore: “‘Non mi aspettavo saggezza da parte tua, neppure nel tuo stesso interesse; ma ti ho dato l'opportunità di aiutarmi volontariamente, risparmiando in tal modo a te stesso inquietudine e sofferenze.'”

cards.title: Saruman's Chill
cards.gameText: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit who moves from this site must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
cards.lore: Saruman's hand can control the chill of winter.
