fields.lore: Saruman's hand can control the chill of winter.

fields.title: Sarumans Kälte
fields.lore: Sarumans Zauber kann die Kälte des Winters beeinflussen.

fields.title: El Frío de Saruman
fields.lore: La mano de Saruman puede controlar el frío del invierno.

fields.title: La Froideur de Saroumane
fields.lore: La main de Saroumane peut contrôler la froideur de l'hiver.

fields.title: Gelo di Saruman
fields.lore: Le mani di Saruman possono controllare il gelo dell'inverno.

cards.title: Saruman's Frost
cards.gameText: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit at this site is strength -2. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
cards.lore: The small and weak suffer first from the The White Wizard's powerful sorcery.

fields.title: Saruman's Frost

fields.lore: The small and weak suffer first from the The White Wizard's powerful sorcery.

fields.title: Sarumans Frost
fields.lore: Die Kleinen und die Schwachen sind die Ersten, die unter dem machtvollen Zauber von Saruman, dem Weissen, zu leiden haben.

fields.title: La Helada de Saruman
fields.lore: Los débiles y pequeños sufren primero por la poderosa hechicería del Mago Blanco.

fields.title: Le Gel de Saroumane
fields.lore: Le petit et le faible souffrent en premier de la sorcellerie puissante du Magicien Blanc.

fields.title: Freddo di Saruman
fields.lore: I piccoli e i deboli soffrono per primi per la potente magia dello Stregone Bianco.

cards.title: Saruman's Power
cards.gameText: Spell. Shadow: Exert a [ISENGARD] minion to discard all conditions.
cards.lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.

fields.title: Saruman's Power

fields.lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.

fields.title: Saruman's Power
fields.gameText: Spell.\Exert an [isengard] minion to discard a Free Peoples condition and then hinder all other conditions.

fields.title: Sarumans Macht
fields.lore: Sarumans Uruks wurden nach seinem Willen geschaffen, um seine Feinde auf grausame Art und Weise zu zerstören.

fields.title: El Poder de Saruman
fields.lore: Los Uruks de Saruman son criados para ser los instrumentos de su voluntad, destruyendo a sus enemigos con su inmunda crueldad.

fields.title: Le Pouvoir de Saroumane
fields.lore: Les Ourouks de Saroumane sont élevés pour être les instruments de sa volonté, détruisant ses ennemis avec une cruauté immonde.

fields.title: Potere di Saruman
fields.lore: Gli Uruk di Saruman sono generati per essere gli strumenti del suo volere, distruggendo i suoi nemici con ripugnante crudeltà.

cards.title: Saruman's Reach
cards.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to make the opponent choose to either exert 2 companions or make the Ring-bearer put on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: Saruman used both magic and minions to impose his will.

fields.title: Saruman's Reach

fields.lore: Saruman used both magic and minions to impose his will.

fields.title: Sarumans Griff
fields.lore: Saruman benutzt sowohl Zauberkräfte als auch seine Diener, um der Welt seinen Willen aufzuzwingen.

fields.title: El Alcance de Saruman
fields.lore: Saruman uso tanto magia como siervos para imponer su voluntad.

fields.title: L'Emprise de Saroumane
fields.lore: Man*uvre: Affaiblissez un Ourouk-Haï pour obliger l'adversaire à choisir soit d'affaiblir 2 compagnons, soit de faire mettre l'Anneau Unique au Porteur de l'Anneau jusqu'à la phase de ralliement.

fields.title: A Portata di Saruman
fields.lore: Saruman usò sia la magia che i suoi servi per imporre la sua volontà.

cards.title: Saruman's Snows

cards.lore: Saruman's spells can hinder even the wary.

fields.title: Sarumans Schnee
fields.lore: Sarumans Zauberkraft kann selbst den Vorsichtigsten behindern.

fields.title: Las Nieves de Saruman
fields.lore: Los conjuros de Saruman pueden entorpecer incluso a los cautos.

fields.title: Les Neiges de Saroumane
fields.lore: Les sorts de Saroumane peuvent même faire obstacle à celui qui en est avisé.

fields.title: Nevi di Saruman
fields.lore: Gli incantesimi di Saruman possono ostacolare anche chi è cauto.

cards.title: Savagery to Match Their Numbers

cards.lore: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.

fields.title: Ohne Rücksicht auf Verluste
fields.lore: Uruk-hai gleichen die Stärke ihrer Feinde durch ihre wilde Raserei aus.

fields.title: Brutalidad Para Igualar Sus Números
fields.lore: Los Uruk-hai igualan la fuerza de sus enemigos con su propia furia salvaje.

fields.title: Barbarie pour Rivaliser avec leur Grand Nombre
fields.lore: Les Ourouk-Haï rivalisent avec leurs ennemis par leur propre rage sauvage.

fields.title: Orda Selvaggia
fields.lore: Gli Uruk-hai eguagliano la forza dei nemici con la loro furia selvaggia.

cards.title: Spies of Saruman

cards.lore: “‘...they are crebain out of Fangorn or Dunland. I do not know what they are about....'”

fields.title: Sarumans Spione
fields.lore: "...es sind crebain aus Fangorn und Dunland. Ich weiss nicht, was sie vorhaben...“

fields.title: Espías de Saruman
fields.lore: “...son crebain de Fangorn y de las Tierras Brunas. No se que les ocurre...”

fields.title: Espions de Saroumane

fields.title: Spie di Saruman
fields.lore: “‘...provengono da Fangorn e dal Dunland, e sono di razza crebain. Non so cosa stiano facendo...'”

fields.lore: La feroz carga de los Uruk-hai sorprende a los arqueros enemigos buscando sus espadas.

fields.lore: La charge féroce des Ourouk-Haï rejoignit les archers ennemis alors qu'ils cherchaient leurs épées à tâtons.

fields.title: L'Infuriare delle Loro Frecce
fields.lore: La feroce carica degli Uruk-hai sorprende gli arcieri nemici mentre ancora cercano di impugnare le spade.

fields.lore: "In all den langen Kriegen mit dem dunklen Turm war Verrat immer unser größter Feind gewesen.“

fields.title: La Voz del Traidor
fields.lore: “En el curso de las largas guerras con la Torre Oscura la traición ha sido nuestro mayor enemigo.”

fields.title: Voix du Traître
fields.lore: “‘Dans toutes les longues guerres contre la Tour Sombre, la trahison a toujours été notre plus grande ennemie.'”

fields.title: Voce del Traditore
fields.lore: “‘Durante tutte le guerre contro la Torre Oscura, il nostro più gran nemico è stato il tradimento.'”

fields.lore: Attaquant en hordes grouillantes, les Ourouk-Haï arrivent rapidement au contact de l'ennemi pour rendre les armes inutiles.

fields.title: Schiera di Uruk-hai
fields.lore: Attaccando in orde confuse, gli Uruk-hai si avvicinano rapidamente al nemico per rendere inutili le armi.

fields.lore: "Bringt sie mir lebend!“

fields.title: Sed de Sangre Uruk
fields.lore: “¡Encontradlos con vida!”

fields.title: Soif de Sang Ourouk
fields.lore: “‘Prenez-les vivants !'”

fields.title: Brama di Sangue Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Prendeteli vivi!

fields.lore: "Er sieht die Höhlen tief unter diesem Turm hier nicht...und er ahnt nicht was dort heranwächst.“.

fields.title: Cría Uruk
fields.lore: “El no ve las cavernas ocultas bajo esta torre... Y tampoco sabe lo que allí crece.”

fields.title: Couvée d'Ourouk
fields.lore: “‘Il ne voit pas les cavernes cachées profondément sous cette tour ... il ne sait pas non plus ce qui grandit là.'”

fields.title: Progenie degli Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Egli non vede le caverne nascoste nelle profondità sotto questa torre... né sa cosa sia cresciuto lì.'”

cards.title: Uruk Fighter

fields.lore: Nicht Heimlichkeit oder Gerissenheit, sondern vielmehr Kraft und Wildheit sind die Waffen, derer sich Sarumans abscheuliche Armee bedient.

fields.title: Luchador Uruk
fields.lore: Ni el sigilo ni la astucia, sino la fuerza y la ferocidad son las armas del ejercito de abominaciones de Saruman.

fields.title: Combattant Ourouk
fields.lore: Ni rusées ni ingénieuses, mais fortes et féroces sont les armes de l'armée d'abominations de Saroumane.

fields.title: Combattente Uruk
fields.lore: Non azioni furtive o astuzia, ma forza e ferocia sono le armi dell'esercito di abomini di Saruman.

fields.title: Guardián Uruk
fields.lore: “Lobos y Orcos habitaban en Isengard, pues Saruman estaba alistando una gran fuerza...”

fields.title: Garde Ourouk
fields.lore: “‘Des loups et des Orques étaient logés à Isengard, car Saroumane menait une grande force....'”

fields.title: Guardia Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Lupi e Orchi dimoravano a Isengard, perché Saruman stava radunando grandi forze....'”

fields.title: Lugarteniente Uruk
fields.lore: Los Lideres Uruk-hai se aprovechan del salvajismo de sus hordas de seguidores para mantener la ley del mas fuerte.

fields.title: Lieutenant Ourouk
fields.lore: Les chefs Ourouk-Haï gagnent en férocité sur leurs hordes de suivants pour maintenir la règle du plus fort.

fields.title: Luogotenente Uruk
fields.lore: I comandanti Uruk-hai ricavano ferocia dalle loro fedeli orde per mantenere la legge del più forte.

fields.title: Salvaje Uruk
fields.lore: “La amistad de Saruman no se deja de lado fácilmente. Un desdichado giro se merece otro... Tenemos trabajo que hacer.”

fields.title: Barbare Ourouk
fields.lore: “‘L'amitié de Saroumane n'est pas clairement écartée. Un changement mauvais en dessert un autre.... Nous avons du travail à faire.'”

fields.lore: Un ojo vigilante en la misión puede deshacer la búsqueda.

fields.title: Espion Ourouk
fields.lore: Un oeil guettant la mission pourrait ruiner la quête.

fields.title: Spia Uruk
fields.lore: Un occhio sospettoso sulla missione potrebbe rovinare l'impresa.

fields.lore: Potenti e senza paura, i guerrieri Uruk-hai non sono intimiditi dalle armi o dal numero dei loro nemici.

fields.title: Predoni Uruk-hai

fields.title: Furore Uruk-hai
fields.lore: La vittoria suscita ardore nelle ripugnanti creature di Saruman.

fields.lore: “‘Un à un, indépendamment de leur penchant pour le bien ou le mal, ils tombèrent.'”

fields.title: Preoccupazione
fields.lore: “‘Uno dopo l'altro, non curanti se la loro forza fosse rivolta al bene o al male... caddero.'”

cards.title: Ancient Chieftain
cards.gameText: For each other [MORIA] Orc you can spot, Ancient Chieftain is strength +1.
cards.lore: “...a huge orc-chieftain, almost man-high, clad in black mail from head to foot, leaped into the chamber; behind him his followers clustered in the doorway.”

fields.title: Ancient Chieftain
fields.gameText: For each other [MORIA] Orc you can spot, Ancient Chieftain is strength +1.
fields.lore: “...a huge orc-chieftain, almost man-high, clad in black mail from head to foot, leaped into the chamber; behind him his followers clustered in the doorway.”

fields.title: Erfahrener Häuptling
fields.lore: ...sprang ein riesiger Orkhäuptling, fast mannshoch, von Kopf bis Fuss in einen schwarzen Panzer gehüllt, in die Kammer; hinter ihm rotteten sich seine Gefolgsleute an der Tür zusammen.

fields.title: Caudillo Antiguo
fields.lore: “...Un enorme jefe Orco, casi de la altura de un Hombre, vestido con malla negra de la cabeza a los pies, entro de un salto en la cámara; lo seguían otros, que se apretaron en la puerta.”

fields.title: Ancien Chef de Clan
fields.lore: “...un énorme chef Orque presque de la taille d'un homme, vêtu de la tête aux pieds de mailles noires, bondit dans la chambre ; derrière lui, ses suivants se pressaient dans l'embrasure de la porte.”

fields.title: Capo Anziano
fields.lore: “...un enorme capo-Orco, di dimensioni quasi umane, ricoperto dalla testa ai piedi di una armatura di maglia nera, saltò nella stanza; alle sue spalle, gli assalitori affollavano il vano della porta.”

cards.title: Bitter Hatred
cards.gameText: Archery: Spot a [MORIA] archer to wound an Elf.
cards.lore: Bitter and long is the hatred of the Orcs for the Elves, and thus they prefer Elves as targets.

fields.title: Bitter Hatred
fields.gameText: Archery: Spot a [MORIA] archer to wound an Elf.
fields.lore: Bitter and long is the hatred of the Orcs for the Elves, and thus they prefer Elves as targets.

fields.title: Erbitterter Hass
fields.lore: Verbittert und alt ist der Hass, den die Orks für die Elben hegen. Deshalb stürzen sie sich zuerst auf die Elben.

fields.title: Odio Acérrimo
fields.lore: Amargo y largo es el odio de los Orcos hacia los Elfos, y así ellos los prefieren como objetivo.

fields.title: Haine Virulente
fields.lore: Acharnée et tenace est la haine des Orques envers les Elfes, et ainsi ils préfèrent les Elfes pour cibles.

fields.title: Odio Implacabile
fields.lore: Implacabile e duraturo è l'odio degli Orchi per gli Elfi, e per questo preferiscono gli Elfi come bersagli.

cards.title: Cave Troll of Moria
cards.subtitle: Scourge of the Black Pit
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. At an underground site, Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -3.
cards.lore: Frodo's quest nearly ended before his companions halted the Cave Troll's ferocious attack.

fields.title: Cave Troll of Moria
fields.subtitle: Scourge of the Black Pit
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. At an underground site, Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -3.
fields.lore: Frodo's quest nearly ended before his companions halted the Cave Troll's ferocious attack.

fields.title: Höhlentroll von Moria
fields.subtitle: Geissel der schwarzen Grube
fields.lore: Frodos Reise endete beinahe, bevor es den Gefährten gelang den wilden Angriff des Höhlentrolls zurückzuschlagen.

fields.title: Troll de las Cuevas
fields.subtitle: Azote del Pozo Negro de Moria
fields.lore: La búsqueda de Frodo casi termina antes de que sus compañeros detuvieran el feroz ataque del Troll de las Cuevas.

fields.title: Troll des Cavernes
fields.subtitle: Fléau du Puits Noir de la Moria
fields.lore: La quête de Frodon se serait arrêtée là si ses compagnoons n'avaient pas contré la féroce attaque du Troll des Cavernes.

fields.title: Troll delle Caverne
fields.subtitle: Flagello del Pozzo Nero di Moria
fields.lore: L'impresa di Frodo quasi finì, prima che i suoi compagni fermassero il feroce attacco del Troll delle Caverne.

cards.title: Cave Troll's Hammer
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. Cave Troll of Moria is damage +1.
cards.lore: Suddenly the door burst into fragments and the Cave Troll was among them, his huge hammer striking like thunder.

fields.title: Cave Troll's Hammer
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. Cave Troll of Moria is damage +1.
fields.lore: Suddenly the door burst into fragments and the Cave Troll was among them, his huge hammer striking like thunder.

fields.title: Hammer des Höhlentrolls
fields.lore: Plötzlich zerbarst die Tür in 1000 Splitter und der Höhlentroll stürmte herein, und die Schläge seines Hammers hallten wie Donner.

fields.title: El Martillo del Troll de Las Cuevas
fields.lore: De repente la puerta estallo en pedazos y el Troll de las Cuevas estaba entre ellos, su enorme martillo golpeando como el trueno.

fields.title: Marteau du Troll des Cavernes
fields.lore: Brusquement la porte vola en éclats et le Troll des Cavernes fut parmi eux, son énorme marteau frappant comme le tonnerre.

fields.title: Martello del Troll delle Caverne
fields.lore: Improvvisamente la porta finì in frantumi e il Troll delle Caverne fu tra loro, il suo enorme martello che colpiva come il tuono.

cards.title: Denizens Enraged
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +1 for each other [MORIA] Orc you spot (limit +4).
cards.lore: “...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

fields.title: Denizens Enraged
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +1 for each other [MORIA] Orc you spot (limit +4).
fields.lore: “...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

fields.title: Denizens Enraged
fields.gameText: Choose one: make a [moria] minion strength +2, or make a [moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [moria] minion you can spot (limit +5).

fields.title: Aufgebrachte Bewohner
fields.lore: ...als ein großer Lärm anhob: ein rollendes Bum, das aus großen Tiefen zu kommen und in den Steinen zu ihren Füssen zu zittern schien.

fields.title: Habitantes Enfurecidos
fields.lore: “...se oyó un gran ruido, como si algo rodara retumbando en los abismos lejanos, estremeciendo el suelo de piedra.”

fields.title: Habitants Rendus Furieux
fields.lore: “... un grand bruit se fit entendre: un roulement grondant, qui semblait venir des profondeurs lointaines et vibrer dans la pierre sous leurs pieds.”

fields.title: Abitanti Adirati
fields.lore: “...quando si udì un grande rumore: un bum rombante che pareva giungesse dalle profondità sotto di loro, tremando nella roccia ai loro piedi.”

cards.title: Drums in the Deep
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Dwarf).
cards.lore: “The drum-beats broke out wildly: doom-boom, doom-boom, and then stopped... Doom, doom went the drum-beats again....”

fields.title: Drums in the Deep
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Dwarf).
fields.lore: “The drum-beats broke out wildly: doom-boom, doom-boom, and then stopped... Doom, doom went the drum-beats again....”

fields.title: Trommeln in der Tiefe
fields.lore: Die Trommelschläge dröhnten wild: dum-bum, dum-bum, und hörten dann auf...Dum, dum fingen die Trommelschläge wieder an...

fields.title: Tambores en Las Profundidades
fields.lore: “El tambor redobló furiosamente, bum, bum, bum, y enmudeció... Bum, bum, sonaron otra vez los golpes de tambor...”

fields.title: Des Tambours dans les Profondeurs
fields.lore: “Les battements de tambour retentirent furieusement: brrron, brrron, puis s'arrêtèrent ... Brrron, brrron, reprirent les tambours....”

fields.title: Tamburi nell'Abisso
fields.lore: “Il rullo del tamburo proruppe selvaggio, dum-bum, dum-bum, poi d'un tratto s'interruppe ... Dum, dum ricominciarono a rullare i tamburi....”

cards.title: The End Comes
cards.gameText: Assignment: Spot 5 [MORIA] minions to make the Free Peoples player assign the Ring-bearer to a skirmish.
cards.lore: “‘They have taken the Bridge and the second hall; we have barred the gates – but cannot hold them for long....'”

fields.title: The End Comes
fields.gameText: Assignment: Spot 5 [MORIA] minions to make the Free Peoples player assign the Ring-bearer to a skirmish.
fields.lore: “‘They have taken the Bridge and the second hall; we have barred the gates – but cannot hold them for long....'”

fields.title: Das Ende naht
fields.lore: "Sie haben die Brücke und die zweite Halle genommen...wir haben das Tor versperrt...aber wir können es nicht mehr lange halten...“

fields.title: Se Acerca el Fin
fields.lore: “Han tomado el puente y la segunda sala; hemos atrancado las puertas – pero no las podremos mantener por mucho tiempo...”

fields.title: La Fin est Proche
fields.lore: “‘Ils ont pris le Pont et la deuxième salle ; nous avons barricadé les portes – mais ne pouvons les retenir longtemps....'”

fields.title: Giunge La Fine
fields.lore: “‘Hanno preso il Ponte e il secondo salone; abbiamo sbarrato i cancelli – ma non possiamo fermarli a lungo....'”

cards.title: Fool of a Took!
cards.gameText: Shadow: Spot a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal one that is not a [MORIA] minion. Take the revealed cards into hand.
cards.lore: “‘Fool of a Took! Throw yourself in next time and rid us of your stupidity!'”

fields.title: Fool of a Took!
fields.gameText: Shadow: Spot a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal one that is not a [MORIA] minion. Take the revealed cards into hand.
fields.lore: “‘Fool of a Took! Throw yourself in next time and rid us of your stupidity!'”

fields.title: Närrischer Tuk!
fields.lore: "Närrischer Tuk! ...Wirf dich das nächste Mal selbst hinein, dann kannst du uns in Zukunft keinen Ärger mehr bereiten.“

fields.title: ¡Tuk Estúpido!
fields.lore: “¡Tuk estúpido! ¡Tírate tu mismo la próxima vez, y no molestaras mas!”

fields.title: Touque Stupide !
fields.lore: “‘Touque stupide ! Jetez-vous dedans la prochaine fois et débarrassez-nous de votre stupidité !'”

fields.title: Idiota di un Tuc!
fields.lore: “‘Idiota di un Tuc! Gettati tu dentro la prossima volta, così in futuro non ci seccherai più!'”

cards.title: Frenzy
cards.gameText: Assignment: Assign an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish a [MORIA] Orc.
cards.lore: The Goblins of the Misty Mountains, like all of their race, use their teeming numbers to slaughter their foes.

fields.title: Frenzy
fields.gameText: Assignment: Assign an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish a [MORIA] Orc.
fields.lore: The Goblins of the Misty Mountains, like all of their race, use their teeming numbers to slaughter their foes.

fields.title: Raserei
fields.lore: Wie bei ihrer Rasse üblich, benutzen auch die Goblins des Nebelgebirges ihre schier unendliche Anzahl, um ihre Feinde zu überwältigen.

fields.title: Frenesí
fields.lore: Los Goblins de las Montañas Nubladas, al igual que los otros de su raza, usan su ingente numero para exterminar a sus adversarios.

fields.title: Frénésie
fields.lore: Les Gobelins des Monts Brumeux, comme tous ceux de leur race, utilisent leur multitude grouillante pour massacrer leurs ennemis.

fields.title: Frenesia
fields.lore: I Goblin delle Montagne Nebbiose, come tutti quelli della loro razza, usano il loro numero brulicante per dilaniare i loro nemici.

cards.title: Goblin Archer
cards.gameText: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -6.
cards.lore: “An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.”

fields.title: Goblin Archer
fields.gameText: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -6.
fields.lore: “An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.”

fields.title: Goblin Archer
fields.gameText: Archer.\The fellowship archery total is -1 for each [moria] archer you can spot.\Assignment: Exert this minion to prevent [moria] archers from being assigned to skirmishes.

fields.title: Goblin Bogenschütze
fields.lore: Ein Pfeil schwirrte über Frodos Kopf.

fields.title: Arquero Goblin
fields.lore: “Una flecha silbó por encima de la cabeza de Frodo.”

fields.title: Archer Gobelin
fields.lore: “Une flèche siffla au-dessus de la tête de Frodon.”

fields.title: Arciere Goblin
fields.lore: “Una freccia passò sibilando sulla testa di Frodo.”

cards.title: Goblin Armory
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [MORIA] weapon, add (1). Response: If a [MORIA] Orc is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: For scavenging vermin, the weapons of fallen foes are prized possessions.

fields.title: Goblin Armory
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [MORIA] weapon, add (1). Response: If a [MORIA] Orc is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
fields.lore: For scavenging vermin, the weapons of fallen foes are prized possessions.

fields.title: Goblin Rüstkammer
fields.lore: Für plünderndes Ungeziefer sind die Waffen und Pfeile getöteter Feinde wertvolle Besitztümer.

fields.title: Armería Goblin
fields.lore: Para las alimañas, las armas y las flechas de los enemigos caídos son posesiones muy preciadas.

fields.title: Armurerie Gobeline
fields.lore: Pour les charognards, les armes des ennemis tombés sont des biens prisés.

fields.title: Armeria Goblin
fields.lore: Per i parassiti che cercano nei rifiuti, le armi dei nemici caduti sono beni preziosi.

cards.title: Goblin Backstabber
cards.gameText: This minion is damage +2 while in the same skirmish as another [MORIA] Orc.
cards.lore: An attack from behind provides a cowardly Goblin with a boldness much like courage.

fields.title: Goblin Backstabber
fields.gameText: This minion is damage +2 while in the same skirmish as another [MORIA] Orc.
fields.lore: An attack from behind provides a cowardly Goblin with a boldness much like courage.

fields.title: Goblin Meuchler
fields.lore: Ein Angriff von hinten gibt einem feigen Goblin ein Gefühl der Kühnheit, das fast an Mut grenzt.

fields.title: Apuñalador Goblin
fields.lore: Un ataque por la espalda le da a un Goblin cobarde una audacia parecida al coraje.

fields.title: Meurtrier Gobelin
fields.lore: Une attaque par derrière fournit à un lâche Gobelin une hardiesse semblable au courage.

fields.title: Accoltellatore Goblin
fields.lore: Un attacco alle spalle infonde a un Goblin codardo un'audacia molto simile al coraggio.

cards.title: Goblin Domain
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [MORIA] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is played to site 4 or higher, that companion comes into play exhausted.
cards.lore: The once beautiful kingdom of Khazad-dûm has become Moria, the black pit.

fields.title: Goblin Domain
fields.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [MORIA] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is played to site 4 or higher, that companion comes into play exhausted.
fields.lore: The once beautiful kingdom of Khazad-dûm has become Moria, the black pit.

fields.title: Goblinreich
fields.lore: Das einst so große Königreich Khazad-dûm ist zu Moria, der schwarzen Grube, geworden.

fields.title: Dominio Goblin
fields.lore: El una vez bello reino de Khazad-dûm se ha convertido en Moria, el pozo negro.

fields.title: Domaine Gobelin
fields.lore: Le royaume autrefois magnifique de Khazad-dûm est devenu la Moria, le Puits Noir.

fields.title: Dominio dei Goblin
fields.lore: Il regno di Khazad-dûm un tempo splendido divenne Moria, il pozzo nero.

cards.title: Goblin Marksman
cards.gameText: Archer.
cards.lore: “Arrows fell among them. One struck Frodo and sprang back. Another pierced Gandalf's hat and stuck there like a black feather.”

fields.title: Goblin Marksman
fields.gameText: Archer.
fields.lore: “Arrows fell among them. One struck Frodo and sprang back. Another pierced Gandalf's hat and stuck there like a black feather.”

fields.title: Goblin Scharfschütze
fields.lore: Pfeile fielen auf sie. Einer traf Frodo und prallte ab. Ein zweiter durchbohrte Gandalfs Hut und blieb dort wie eine schwarze Feder stecken.

fields.title: Tirador Goblin
fields.lore: “Las flechas cayeron entre ellos. Una golpeo a Frodo y reboto. Otra atravesó el sombrero de Gandalf, y allí se quedo sujeta como una pluma negra.”

fields.title: Tireur d'Élite Gobelin
fields.lore: “Les flèches tombaient parmi eux. L'une frappa Frodon et ricocha. Une autre transperça le chapeau de Gandalf et y resta plantée comme une plume noire.”

fields.title: Tiratore Scelto Goblin
fields.lore: “Delle frecce caddero in mezzo a loro. Una di esse colpì Frodo e rimbalzò. Un'altra penetrò nel cappello di Gandalf, rimanendovi conficcata come una piuma nera.”

cards.title: Goblin Patrol Troop
cards.lore: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”

fields.title: Goblin Patrol Troop
fields.lore: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”

fields.title: Goblin Patrol Troop
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [MORIA] Orc to draw a card.

fields.title: Goblin Patrol Troop
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert this minion or a unique [MORIA] Orc to draw a card.

fields.title: Tropa de Patrulla Goblin
fields.lore: “Mientras corrían oyeron los golpeteos y los ecos de muchos pies que venían detrás, Se oyó un chillido agudo: los habían visto. Hubo luego un clamor y un repiqueteo de aceros.”

fields.title: Patrouille Gobeline
fields.lore: “Tout en courant, ils entendaient le battement et l'écho de nombreux pieds qui se lançaient à leur poursuite. Un cri strident retentit: on les avait vus. Il y eut un tintement et un cliquetis d'acier.”

fields.title: Pattuglia Goblin
fields.lore: “Nella fuga, si udirono lo scalpitio e l'eco di molti piedi frettolosi alle loro spalle. Un urlo stridulo si levò: erano stati visti. L'acciaio squillò e vibrò.”

cards.title: Goblin Runner
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may add (2).
cards.lore: “...a great horn was blown in the hall, and answering horns and harsh cries were heard further off. There was a hurrying sound of many feet.”

fields.title: Goblin Runner
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may add (2).
fields.lore: “...a great horn was blown in the hall, and answering horns and harsh cries were heard further off. There was a hurrying sound of many feet.”

fields.title: Goblin Läufer
fields.lore: ...ein großes Horn wurde in der Halle geblasen, andere Hörner antworteten und von weit her waren rauhe Schreie zu hören. Man hörte viele Füsse rennen.

fields.title: Corredor Goblin
fields.lore: “Otra ronca llamada de cuerno, y unos gritos agudos que reverberaron en las paredes. Unos pies venían corriendo por el pasillo.”

fields.title: Coureur Gobelin
fields.lore: “... un grand cor sonnait dans la salle, auquel répondirent plus loin d'autres cors et des cris stridents. On entendit le bruit de plusieurs pieds qui se hâtaient.”

fields.title: Corridore Goblin
fields.lore: “... un grande corno suonava nel salone, mentre in lontananza si udivano rispondere altri corni, e strilli acuti. Infine il rumore frettoloso di molti passi.”

cards.title: Goblin Scavengers
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may play a weapon from your discard pile on your [MORIA] Orc.
cards.lore: “‘The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'”

fields.title: Goblin Scavengers
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may play a weapon from your discard pile on your [MORIA] Orc.
fields.lore: “‘The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'”

fields.title: Goblin Plünderer
fields.lore: "Die Orks haben Moria oft geplündert; in den oberen Hallen ist nichts zurückgeblieben.“

fields.title: Saqueadores Goblin
fields.lore: “Los Orcos han saqueado Moria a menudo. No queda nada en las salas superiores.”

fields.title: Charognards Gobelins
fields.lore: “‘Les Orques ont souvent pillé la Moria ; il ne reste rien dans les salles supérieures.'”

fields.title: Saccheggiatori Goblin
fields.lore: “‘Gli Orchi hanno più volte saccheggiato Moria; non vi è più nulla nei saloni superiori.'”

cards.title: Goblin Scimitar
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
cards.lore: “Some of the swords were crooked: orc-scimitars with blackened blades.”

fields.title: Goblin Scimitar
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
fields.lore: “Some of the swords were crooked: orc-scimitars with blackened blades.”

fields.title: Goblin Krummsäbel
fields.lore: Einige der Schwerter waren gebogen: Ork-Krummsäbel mit geschwärzten Klingen.

fields.title: Cimitarra Goblin
fields.lore: “Algunas de las espadas eran curvas: cimitarras de orcos con hojas negras.”

fields.title: Cimeterre Gobelin
fields.lore: “Certaines des épées étaient courbes: des cimeterres d'Orques aux lames noires.”

fields.title: Scimitarra Goblin
fields.lore: “Alcune delle spade erano curve e ritorte: le scimitarre degli Orchi dalle lame annerite.”

cards.title: Goblin Sneak
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may place a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
cards.lore: Their limber forms allow the Goblins of Moria to slither past barred doors and collapsed passageways.

fields.title: Goblin Sneak
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may place a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
fields.lore: Their limber forms allow the Goblins of Moria to slither past barred doors and collapsed passageways.

fields.title: Goblin Kriecher
fields.lore: Ihr geschmeidiger Körperbau erlaubt es den Goblins von Moria durch versperrte Türen und zusammengebrochene Gänge zu schlüpfen.

fields.title: Acechador Goblin
fields.lore: Sus ágiles formas permiten a los Goblins de Moria deslizarse a través de puertas enrejadas y pasillos derrumbados.

fields.title: Mouchard Gobelin
fields.lore: La forme de leurs membres permet aux Gobelins de la Moria de se glisser au-delà des portes bloquées et des passages effondrés.

fields.title: Spione Goblin
fields.lore: Le loro figure flessibili permettono ai Goblin di Moria di scivolare oltre porte sbarrate e sentieri franati.

cards.title: Goblin Spear
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] minion. If bearer kills a companion in a skirmish, add 1 burden (or 2 burdens if that companion was a Hobbit).
cards.lore: Simple creatures with simple weapons can be as deadly as an armoured warrior with a fine sword.

fields.title: Goblin Spear
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] minion. If bearer kills a companion in a skirmish, add 1 burden (or 2 burdens if that companion was a Hobbit).
fields.lore: Simple creatures with simple weapons can be as deadly as an armoured warrior with a fine sword.

fields.title: Goblin Speer
fields.lore: Primitive Kreaturen mit primitiven Waffen können genauso tödlich sein wie ein gepanzerter Krieger mit einem guten Schwert.

fields.title: Lanza Goblin
fields.lore: Las criaturas simples con armas simples pueden ser tan mortales como un guerrero con armadura y una buena espada.

fields.title: Lance Gobeline
fields.lore: De simples créatures avec de simples armes peuvent être aussi mortelles qu'un guerrier en armure avec une épée affilée.

fields.title: Lancia Goblin
fields.lore: Semplici creature con semplici armi possono essere tanto letali quanto un guerriero con armatura e con un'eccellente spada.

cards.title: Goblin Swarms
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] Orc wins a skirmish, discard cards and wounds on that Orc and stack that Orc on this condition. Shadow: Play an Orc stacked here as if played from hand.
cards.lore: “Beyond the fire he saw swarming black figures....”

fields.title: Goblin Swarms
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] Orc wins a skirmish, discard cards and wounds on that Orc and stack that Orc on this condition. Shadow: Play an Orc stacked here as if played from hand.
fields.lore: “Beyond the fire he saw swarming black figures....”

fields.title: Goblinschwärme
fields.lore: Hinter dem Feuer sah er wimmelnde schwarze Gestalten...

fields.title: Enjambre Goblin
fields.lore: “Mas allá del fuego vio un enjambre de figuras oscuras...”

fields.title: Grouillements Gobelins
fields.lore: “Au-delà du feu, il vit des formes noires et foisonnantes....”

fields.title: Sciami di Goblin
fields.lore: “Al di là del fuoco scorse uno sciame di figure nere....”

cards.title: Goblin Wallcrawler
cards.gameText: While at an underground site, this minion is strength +2. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -1.
cards.lore: Skittering along the walls of Moria, Goblins attack without warning.

fields.title: Goblin Wallcrawler
fields.gameText: While at an underground site, this minion is strength +2. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -1.
fields.lore: Skittering along the walls of Moria, Goblins attack without warning.

fields.title: Goblin Wandkrabbler
fields.lore: An den Wänden Morias dahinjagend, greifen Goblins ohne Vorwarnung an.

fields.title: Rondador de Muros
fields.lore: Brincando a lo largo de los muros de Moria, los Goblins atacan sin previo aviso.

fields.title: Grimpeur Gobelin
fields.lore: Se glissant le long des murs de la Moria, les Gobelins attaquent sans avertissement.

fields.title: Goblin Camminamuri
fields.lore: Strisciando lungo i muri di Moria, i Goblin attaccano senza avvertimento.

cards.title: Goblin Warrior
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may discard a [DWARVEN] ally or [DWARVEN] condition.
cards.lore: The ancient enmity between Goblins and Dwarves burns brightly still.

fields.title: Goblin Warrior
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may discard a [DWARVEN] ally or [DWARVEN] condition.
fields.lore: The ancient enmity between Goblins and Dwarves burns brightly still.

fields.title: Goblin Krieger
fields.lore: Das Feuer der Feindschaft zwischen Goblins und Zwergen brennt immer noch lichterloh.

fields.title: Guerrero Goblin
fields.lore: La antigua enemistad entre Goblins y Enanos todavía brilla con fuerza.

fields.title: Guerrier Gobelin
fields.lore: L'ancienne haine entre Gobelins et Nains brûlent encore intensément.

fields.title: Guerriero Goblin
fields.lore: L'antica ostilità tra Goblin e Nani divampa ancora chiaramente.

cards.title: Guard Commander
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
cards.lore: “His broad flat face was swart, his eyes were like coals, and his tongue was red....”

fields.title: Guard Commander
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
fields.lore: “His broad flat face was swart, his eyes were like coals, and his tongue was red....”

fields.title: Kommandant der Wache
fields.lore: Sein breites, flaches Gesicht war schwärzlich, seine Augen waren wie Kohlen, und seine Zunge war rot...

fields.title: Comandante de La Guardia
fields.lore: “La cara ancha y chata era morena, los ojos como carbones, la lengua roja...”

fields.title: Commandant de la Garde
fields.lore: “Sa large face plate était basanée, ses yeux, d'un noir de charbon et sa langue, rouge....”

fields.title: Comandante Goblin
fields.lore: “Fosca era la sua larga faccia piatta, e gli occhi come tizzoni, e la lingua rossa....”

cards.title: Host of Thousands
cards.gameText: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
cards.lore: Killing one is no victory, since a dozen from the warrens below will take his place.

fields.title: Host of Thousands
fields.gameText: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
fields.lore: Killing one is no victory, since a dozen from the warrens below will take his place.

fields.title: Eine schier unerschöpfliche Flut
fields.lore: Einen zu töten ist kein Sieg, solange aus den Barracken dort unten ein Dutzend seine Stelle einnehmen.

fields.title: Hueste de Miles
fields.lore: Matar a uno no es una victoria, ya que una docena tomaran su lugar desde los refugios.

fields.title: Cohorte de Milliers
fields.lore: En tuer un n'est pas une victoire, puisqu'une douzaine sortiront du nid pour prendre sa place.

fields.title: Schiera di Migliaia
fields.lore: Ucciderne uno non è una vittoria, dato che una dozzina, provenienti dai labirinti laggiù, prenderanno il suo posto.

cards.title: The Long Dark
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves to site 4 or 5, add (2) for each Dwarf companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make your [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘So ended the attempt to retake Moria! It was valiant but foolish. The time is not come yet.'”

fields.title: The Long Dark
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves to site 4 or 5, add (2) for each Dwarf companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make your [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘So ended the attempt to retake Moria! It was valiant but foolish. The time is not come yet.'”

fields.title: Die große Dunkelheit
fields.lore: "So endete der Versuch, Moria wiederzuerobern! Es war kühn, aber töricht. Die Zeit ist noch nicht gekommen.“

fields.title: La Larga Oscuridad
fields.lore: “¡Así termino el intento de recuperar Moria! Fue valiente, pero insensato. No ha llegado todavía la hora.”

fields.title: La Longue Nuit
fields.lore: “‘Ainsi finit la tentative de reprendre la Moria ! Ce fut courageux mais inconsidéré. Le temps n'est pas encore venu.'”

fields.title: La Lunga Tenebra
fields.lore: “‘In tal modo si concluse il tentativo di riconquistare Moria! Fu valoroso, ma sciocco. L'ora non è ancora giunta.'”

cards.title: Lost to the Goblins
cards.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer exerts or takes a wound, discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [MORIA] minion you spot. For each Shadow card discarded in this way, add a burden (limit 3 burdens).
cards.lore: Dwarven graves stood open in plundered disarray.

fields.title: Lost to the Goblins
fields.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer exerts or takes a wound, discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [MORIA] minion you spot. For each Shadow card discarded in this way, add a burden (limit 3 burdens).
fields.lore: Dwarven graves stood open in plundered disarray.

fields.title: Verloren an die Goblins
fields.lore: Die Plünderung durch die Goblins liess die Zwergengräber in Unordnung zurück.

fields.title: Perdido a Los Goblins
fields.lore: Tumbas Enanas se alzaban abiertas en un desordenado saqueo.

fields.title: Abandonné aux Gobelins
fields.lore: Des tombes Naines étaient ouvertes, pillées.

fields.title: In Mano ai Goblin
fields.lore: Le tombe dei Nani erano rimaste aperte nel disordine del saccheggio.

cards.title: Moria Axe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. Bearer is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him strength +2.
cards.lore: Goblins without scimitars wrest axes from the remains of fallen Dwarves.

fields.title: Moria Axe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. Bearer is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him strength +2.
fields.lore: Goblins without scimitars wrest axes from the remains of fallen Dwarves.

fields.title: Moriaaxt
fields.lore: Goblins, die keine Schwerter haben, entreissen den Überresten gefallener Zwerge deren Äxte.

fields.title: Hacha de Moria
fields.lore: Los Goblins sin cimitarras arrebataron las hachas de los despojos de Enanos caídos.

fields.title: Hache de la Moria
fields.lore: Des Gobelins sans cimeterres arrachent des haches aux restes des Nains tombés.

fields.title: Ascia di Moria
fields.lore: I Goblin senza scimitarra strappano asce dalle spoglie dei Nani caduti.

cards.title: Moria Scout
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, spot an Elf to add (2).
cards.lore: Like their kindred in the North, the Orcs of Moria have keen noses, often following their prey by scent.

fields.title: Moria Scout
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, spot an Elf to add (2).
fields.lore: Like their kindred in the North, the Orcs of Moria have keen noses, often following their prey by scent.

fields.title: Moria Späher
fields.lore: Wie ihre Verwandten im Norden, besitzen die Orks von Moria gute Nasen, und sie folgen oft dem Geruch ihrer Beute.

fields.title: Explorador de Moria
fields.lore: Igual que sus parientes en el Norte, los Orcos de Moria tienen el olfato agudo, a menudo persiguiendo su presa por el olor.

fields.title: Éclaireur de la Moria
fields.lore: Comme leurs cousins du Nord, les Orques de la Moria ont des nez fins, pistant souvent leur proie à l'odeur.

fields.title: Guida di Moria
fields.lore: Come i loro consanguinei del Nord, gli Orchi di Moria hanno un olfatto acuto, spesso seguono le loro prede dall'odore.

cards.title: Pinned Down
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [MORIA] archer, the fellowship archery total is -1.
cards.lore: “Arrows whined and whistled down the corridor as he sprang back.”

fields.title: Pinned Down
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [MORIA] archer, the fellowship archery total is -1.
fields.lore: “Arrows whined and whistled down the corridor as he sprang back.”

fields.title: Pfeilhagel
fields.lore: Pfeile sausten und pfiffen den Gang herunter, als er zurücksprang.

fields.title: Clavado
fields.lore: “...y se tambaleo hacia atrás... Las flechas llegaron silbando...”

fields.title: Coincé
fields.lore: “Des flèches piaulèrent et sifflèrent le long du couloir, tandis qu'il se rejetait en arrière.”

fields.title: Inchiodati a Terra
fields.lore: “Le frecce fischiarono e sibilarono lungo il corridoio mentre egli balzava indietro.”

cards.title: Plundered Armories
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] weapon is discarded, play it from your discard pile (that weapon's twilight cost is -1).
cards.lore: The Goblins of Moria have oft plundered the deep armouries of Durin's folk.

fields.title: Plundered Armories
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] weapon is discarded, play it from your discard pile (that weapon's twilight cost is -1).
fields.lore: The Goblins of Moria have oft plundered the deep armouries of Durin's folk.

fields.title: Geplünderte Waffenkammern
fields.lore: Die Moria Goblins haben bereits mehrfach die Rüstkammer von Durin's Volk geplündert.

fields.title: Armerías Saqueadas
fields.lore: Los Goblins de Moria han saqueado a manudo las profundas armerías del Pueblo de Durin.

fields.title: Armureries Pillées
fields.lore: Les Gobelins de la Moria ont souvent pillé les armureries inférieures du peuple de Durin.

fields.title: Armerie Saccheggiate
fields.lore: I Goblin di Moria hanno spesso derubato le profonde armerie della gente di Durin.

cards.title: Relentless
cards.gameText: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, spot 3 [MORIA] minions to cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘Then dig a hole in the ground,' said Legolas, ‘if that is more after the fashion of your kind. But you must dig swift and deep, if you wish to hide from Orcs.'”

fields.title: Relentless
fields.gameText: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, spot 3 [MORIA] minions to cancel that event.
fields.lore: “‘Then dig a hole in the ground,' said Legolas, ‘if that is more after the fashion of your kind. But you must dig swift and deep, if you wish to hide from Orcs.'”

fields.title: Unerbittlich
fields.lore: "Dann grabe dir eine Höhle im Boden“, sagte Legolas, "wenn das mehr deiner Art entspricht. Aber du musst rasch und tief graben, wenn du dich vor den Orks verstecken willst.“

fields.title: Sin Descanso
fields.lore: “Entonces cava un agujero en el suelo – dijo Legolas –, si esta mas de acuerdo con tus costumbres. Pero tienes que cavar hondo y muy rápido, o no escaparas a los Orcos.”

fields.title: Sans Répit
fields.lore: “‘Eh bien, creusez un trou dans le sol, si c'est davantage dans la façon de votre espèce, dit Legolas. Mais il faudra creuser vite et profond si vous voulez vous cacher des Orques'”

fields.title: Implacabile
fields.lore: “‘Scava allora un fosso nel terreno,' disse Legolas, ‘Se ciò si confà maggiormente alle abitudini della tua razza. Ma devi scavare veloce e in profondità, se desideri nasconderti dagli Orchi.'”

cards.title: Relics of Moria
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [MORIA] possession from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

fields.title: Relics of Moria
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [MORIA] possession from your discard pile.
fields.lore: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

fields.title: Die Relikte von Moria
fields.lore: An beiden Türen sahen sie jetzt viele Knochen liegen und dazwischen zerbrochene Schwerter und Eisen von Äxten und gespaltene Schilde und Helme.

fields.title: Reliquias de Moria
fields.lore: “Junto a las dos puertas podían ver ahora muchos huesos desparramados, y entre ellos espadas y hachas rotas, y escudos y cascos hendidos.”

fields.title: Reliques de la Moria
fields.lore: Ombre: Retirez <symbol>twilight2</symbol> pour jouer une possession <symbol>moria</symbol> de votre pile de défausse.

fields.title: Reliquie di Moria
fields.lore: “Riuscirono ora a vedere che vicino ad ambedue le soglie giacevano molte ossa, miste con spade rotte, pezzi d'asce, scudi spaccati ed elmi.”

cards.title: They Are Coming
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard 3 cards from hand to play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘The last thing written is in a trailing scrawl of elf-letters: they are coming.'”

fields.title: They Are Coming
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard 3 cards from hand to play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
fields.lore: “‘The last thing written is in a trailing scrawl of elf-letters: they are coming.'”

fields.title: Sie kommen
fields.lore: "Das letzte ist in einem langgezogenen Gekritzel von Elbenzeichen geschrieben: sie kommen.“

fields.title: Están Acercándose
fields.lore: “Las ultimas palabras son un garabateo arrastrado en letras élficas: Están acercándose.”

fields.title: Ils Arrivent
fields.lore: “‘La dernière chose écrite est un griffonnage estompé, en lettres elfiques: ils arrivent.'”

fields.title: Stanno Arrivando
fields.lore: “‘L'ultimo tratto di lettere elfiche scarabocchiate è: stanno arrivando.'”

cards.title: Threat of the Unknown
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert your [MORIA] Orc to draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: The danger of what lay hidden in the dark was more terrifying than the known perils of Moria.

fields.title: Threat of the Unknown
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert your [MORIA] Orc to draw 2 cards.
fields.lore: The danger of what lay hidden in the dark was more terrifying than the known perils of Moria.

fields.title: Die unbekannte Bedrohung
fields.lore: Die Gefahr durch das, was im Dunkeln verborgen lag, war schrecklicher, als die bekannten Gefahren Morias.

fields.title: La Amenaza de Lo Desconocido
fields.lore: El peligro de lo que estaba oculto en la oscuridad era más terrorífico que los peligros conocidos de Moria.

fields.title: Menace de l'Inconnu
fields.lore: Le danger de ce qui reposait caché dans le noir était plus terrifiant que les périls connus de la Moria.

fields.title: La Minaccia dello Sconosciuto
fields.lore: Il pericolo di ciò che attendeva nascosto nell'oscurità era molto più terrificante dei pericoli conosciuti di Moria.

cards.title: Through the Misty Mountains
cards.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves to site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
cards.lore: “‘One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

fields.title: Through the Misty Mountains

fields.lore: “‘One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

fields.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Durch das Nebelgebirge
fields.lore: "Man muss dem Pfad folgen, der vor einem liegt.“

fields.title: A Través de Las Montañas Nubladas
fields.lore: “Uno debe seguir el camino que la necesidad elige.”

fields.title: Par les Monts Brumeux
fields.lore: “‘Il faut prendre le chemin que dicte la nécessité.'”

fields.title: Attraverso le Montagne Nebbiose
fields.lore: “‘Bisogna percorrere il sentiero scelto dalla necessità!'”

cards.title: Troll’s Keyward
cards.gameText: Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -2.
cards.lore: Though shorter than a Man, the Troll's Keyward is a deadly adversary.

fields.title: Troll’s Keyward
fields.gameText: Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -2.
fields.lore: Though shorter than a Man, the Troll's Keyward is a deadly adversary.

fields.title: Troll Schlüsselmeister
fields.lore: Obwohl kleiner als ein Mensch, ist der Schlüsselmeister ein gefährlicher Gegner.

fields.title: El Guardián del Troll
fields.lore: Aunque más bajo que un Hombre, el Guardián del Troll es un adversario mortífero.

fields.title: Gardien du Troll
fields.lore: Quoique plus petit qu'un Homme, le Gardien du Troll est un adversaire mortel.

fields.title: Guardiano del Troll
fields.lore: Sebbene più basso di un uomo, il Guardiano del Troll è un avversario letale.

cards.title: The Underdeeps of Moria
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [MORIA] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.
cards.lore: “‘I am afraid Balin is buried deep, and maybe something else is buried there too.'”

fields.title: The Underdeeps of Moria
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [MORIA] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.
fields.lore: “‘I am afraid Balin is buried deep, and maybe something else is buried there too.'”

fields.title: Die tiefsten Tiefen Morias
fields.lore: "Ich fürchte, Balin ist tief begraben, und vielleicht ist auch etwas anderes dort begraben.“

fields.title: Las Profundidades de Moria
fields.lore: “Temo que Balin este sepultado muy profundamente, y quizá también alguna otra cosa.”

fields.title: Les Profondeurs de la Moria
fields.lore: “Je crains que Balin ne soit enterré profondément, et peut-être qu'autre chose est enterré là aussi.'”

fields.title: Le Profondità di Moria
fields.lore: “‘Temo che Balin sia profondamente sepolto, e forse qualcos'altro è seppellito con lui.'”

cards.title: Unfamiliar Territory
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
cards.lore: Knowing the dark terrain of Moria gives Orcs a strategic advantage when attacking their foes.

fields.title: Unfamiliar Territory
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
fields.lore: Knowing the dark terrain of Moria gives Orcs a strategic advantage when attacking their foes.

fields.title: Unbekanntes Terrain
fields.lore: Ihre Kenntnis der dunklen Gänge Morias verschafft den Orks dort einen strategischen Vorteil, wenn sie ihre Feinde angreifen.

fields.title: Terreno Desconocido
fields.lore: Conocer el terreno oscuro de Moria les da a los orcos una ventaja cuando están emboscando a sus enemigos.

fields.title: Territoire Peu Familier
fields.lore: La connaissance du terrain obscur de la Moria donne aux Orques un avantage stratégique lorsqu'ils attaquent de leurs ennemis.

fields.title: Territorio Ignoto
fields.lore: La conoscenza dell'oscuro terreno di Moria fornisce agli Orchi un vantaggio strategico quando attaccano i loro nemici.

cards.title: What Is This New Devilry?
cards.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] Orc. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5 or higher, each companion's twilight cost is +2.

fields.title: What Is This New Devilry?
fields.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] Orc. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5 or higher, each companion's twilight cost is +2.

fields.title: Was ist das für eine neue Teufelei?
fields.lore: "Das ist ein Feind, gegen den ihr alle nichts ausrichten könnt! Flieht!“

fields.title: ¿Que Es Esta Nueva Maldad?
fields.lore: “¡Este enemigo os sobrepasa! Huid Insensatos!”

fields.title: Quelle est cette Nouvelle Diablerie ?
fields.lore: “‘L'ennemi est derrière vous ! Courez !'”

fields.title: Che Cos'è Questa Nuova Diavoleria?
fields.lore: “‘Questo nemico è dietro tutti voi! Correte!'”

cards.title: All Blades Perish
cards.gameText: Response: If a Nazgul is about to take a wound, prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “‘...all blades perish that pierce that dreadful King. More deadly to him was the name of Elbereth.'”

fields.title: All Blades Perish
fields.gameText: Response: If a Nazgul is about to take a wound, prevent that wound.
fields.lore: “‘...all blades perish that pierce that dreadful King. More deadly to him was the name of Elbereth.'”

fields.title: Alle Klingen vergehen
fields.lore: "...alle Klingen, die diesen entsetzlichen König durchbohren, vergehen. Tödlicher für ihn war der Name Elbereth.“

fields.title: Todas Las Hojas Perecen
fields.lore: “... Y las espadas que traspasan a ese rey terrible caen destruidas. Mas mortal fue para él el nombre de Elbereth.”

fields.title: Toutes les Lames Périssent
fields.lore: “‘...toutes les lames qui percent ce terrible Roi périssent. Le nom d'Elbereth lui fut plus mortel.'”

fields.title: Tutte le Lame Si Infrangono
fields.lore: “‘...tutte le lame che feriscono il corpo di quell'orrendo re vanno in frantumi. Più infausto per lui è stato il nome di Elbereth.'”

cards.title: All Veils Removed
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +5 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
cards.lore: “‘Give up the Halfling...!'”

fields.title: All Veils Removed
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +5 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
fields.lore: “‘Give up the Halfling...!'”

fields.title: Alle Schleier gelüftet
fields.lore: "Überlasse uns den Halbling, Elbenweib.“

fields.title: Todos Los Velos Caen
fields.lore: “¡Dadnos al Mediano...!”

fields.title: Tous Voiles Levés
fields.lore: “‘Renoncez au Semi-Homme...!'”

fields.title: Rimossi Tutti i Veli
fields.lore: “‘Lasciate il Mezzuomo...!'”

cards.title: Beauty Is Fading
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to discard a Free Peoples possession or Free Peoples condition. If you can spot no such card, discard an ally or companion (except the Ring-bearer) instead.
cards.lore: “‘...the Three will fail, and many fair things will fade and be forgotten.'”

fields.title: Beauty Is Fading
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to discard a Free Peoples possession or Free Peoples condition. If you can spot no such card, discard an ally or companion (except the Ring-bearer) instead.
fields.lore: “‘...the Three will fail, and many fair things will fade and be forgotten.'”

fields.title: Schönheit verblasst
fields.lore: "Doch mag es auch sein, dass die Drei... dahinschwinden, und viele schöne Dinge verblassen und vergessen sein werden.“

fields.title: La Belleza Se Desvanece
fields.lore: “...los Tres se malogren, y que junto con ellos se marchiten y olviden muchas cosas hermosas.”

fields.title: La Beauté Passera
fields.lore: “‘...les Trois feront défaut et beaucoup de belles choses passeront et seront oubliées.'”

fields.title: La Bellezza Sta Svanendo
fields.lore: “‘...i Tre perdano ogni loro potere, e molte cose belle svaniscano e cadano nell'oblio.'”

cards.title: Bent on Discovery
cards.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. At the beginning of each of your Shadow phases, draw 1 card. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgul or discard this condition.
cards.lore: “The riding figure sat quite still.... From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffing....”

fields.title: Versessen auf Entdeckung
fields.lore: Der Reiter saß ganz still...Unter der Kapuze hervor kam ein Geräusch, wie wenn jemand schnüffelt...

fields.title: Empeñados en Descubrirlo
fields.lore: “El jinete permaneció sentado... Del interior del capuchón vino un sonido, como si alguien olfateara...”

fields.title: Résolu à les Trouver
fields.lore: “Le cavalier resta immobile.... De sous le capuchon vint le son de quelqu'un qui renifle pour saisir une odeur fugitive....”

fields.title: Intento a Cercare
fields.lore: “Il cavaliere rimase immobile... Dall'interno del cappuccio proveniva come un sibilo di uomo che annusasse...”

cards.title: Black Breath
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. Burdens and wounds may not be removed from bearer.
cards.lore: Vile breath infects the living with Shadow.

fields.lore: Vile breath infects the living with Shadow.

fields.title: Schwarzer Atem
fields.lore: Ihr fauler Atem zieht die Lebenden ins Schattenreich.

fields.title: Soplo Negro
fields.lore: El hálito perverso infecta a los vivos con la Sombra.

fields.title: Souffle Noir
fields.lore: Le souffle abominable infecte ce qui vit avec l'Ombre.

fields.title: Alito Nero
fields.lore: L'alito nauseante infetta i viventi con l'Ombra.

cards.title: Black Steed
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
cards.lore: “‘...these horses are born and bred to the service of the Dark Lord in Mordor.'”

fields.title: Black Steed
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
fields.lore: “‘...these horses are born and bred to the service of the Dark Lord in Mordor.'”

fields.title: Schwarzes Ross
fields.lore: "Weil diese Pferde für den Dienst des Dunklen Herrschers in Mordor geboren und gezüchtet werden.“

fields.title: Corcel Negro
fields.lore: “Porque esos caballos nacieron y fueron criados al servicio del Señor Oscuro.”

fields.title: Destrier Noir
fields.lore: “‘...ces chevaux sont nés et élevés pour servir le Seigneur Ténébreux en Mordor.'”

fields.title: Cavallo Nero
fields.lore: “‘...questi cavalli sono cavalli nati e cresciuti al servizio dell'Oscuro Signore di Mordor.'”

cards.title: Blade Tip
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Nazgul wins a skirmish, transfer this condition from your support area to the losing character. Limit 1 per character. Wound bearer at the start of each fellowship phase. (If bearer is the Ring-bearer, add a burden instead )

cards.title: Dark Whispers
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot 3 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +1 and damage +1, or spot 6 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +3 and damage +2.
cards.lore: “‘The Ring... The Ring... The Ring....'”

fields.title: Dark Whispers
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot 3 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +1 and damage +1, or spot 6 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +3 and damage +2.
fields.lore: “‘The Ring... The Ring... The Ring....'”

fields.title: Dunkles Geflüster
fields.lore: "Der Ring...der Ring...der Ring...“

fields.title: Susurros Oscuros
fields.lore: “El Anillo... El Anillo... El Anillo...”

fields.title: Sombres Murmures
fields.lore: “‘L'Anneau ... L'Anneau ... L'Anneau.... ‘“

fields.title: Sussurri Oscuri
fields.lore: “‘L'Anello... L'Anello... L'Anello....'

cards.title: Drawn to Its Power
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, add a burden.
cards.lore: “‘And also the Ring drew them.'”

fields.title: Drawn to Its Power
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, add a burden.
fields.lore: “‘And also the Ring drew them.'”

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, add a burden.

fields.title: Angezogen von seiner Macht
fields.lore: "Und auch der Ring zog sie an.“

fields.title: Atraído por Su Poder
fields.lore: “Y además el Anillo los llamaba de algún modo.”

fields.title: Attiré par son Pouvoir
fields.lore: “‘Et l'Anneau les attire aussi.'”

fields.title: Attirati dal Suo Potere
fields.lore: “‘Inoltre, l'Anello li attirava.'”

cards.title: Fear
cards.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Exert your Nazgul to discard an ally.
cards.lore: “‘Never has such a thing happened in my time!... Guests unable to sleep in their beds, and good bolsters ruined and all! What are we coming to?'”

fields.title: Fear
fields.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Exert your Nazgul to discard an ally.
fields.lore: “‘Never has such a thing happened in my time!... Guests unable to sleep in their beds, and good bolsters ruined and all! What are we coming to?'”

fields.title: Furcht
fields.lore: "Nie in meinem Leben ist so etwas passiert!...Dass Gäste nicht in ihren Betten schlafen können und gute Schlummerrollen ruiniert werden und was nicht alles! Was kommt denn nun noch?“

fields.title: Miedo
fields.lore: “¡Nunca me ocurrió cosa semejante!... ¡Huéspedes que no pueden dormir en cama, y buenas almohadas arruinadas y todo lo demás! ¿Que tiempos son estos?”

fields.title: Peur
fields.lore: “‘Jamais pareille chose n'est arrivée de mon temps ! ...Des hôtes empêchés de dormir dans leur lit, de bons traversins perdus, et tout ! Où va-t-on ?'”

fields.title: Paura
fields.lore: “‘Non è mai successa una cosa del genere in tutta la mia vita! ... Clienti che non possono dormire nei loro letti, bei cuscini rovinati e tutto il resto! Cos'altro ci aspetta?'”

cards.title: Frozen by Fear
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +3 if the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish that has not resolved).
cards.lore: “...he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.”

fields.title: Frozen by Fear
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +3 if the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish that has not resolved).
fields.lore: “...he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.”

fields.title: Starr vor Angst
fields.lore: ...er zitterte, als ob er bitterlich fröre, aber seine Angst ging in der plötzlichen Versuchung unter, den Ring aufzustreifen.

fields.title: Helado por el Miedo
fields.lore: “...temblaba de pies a cabeza, como atacado por un frío intenso, pero la repentina tentación de ponerse enseguida el Anillo se sobrepuso a todo...”

fields.title: Pétrifié par la Peur
fields.lore: “...il tremblait comme sous l'effet d'un froid glacial, mais sa terreur se trouva submergée par la soudaine tentation de mettre l'Anneau.”

fields.title: Pietrificato dalla Paura
fields.lore: “... ma il suo spavento fu improvvisamente come inghiottito dalla forte tentazione d'infilarsi l'Anello.”

cards.title: In the Ringwraith's Wake
cards.gameText: Response: If a Nazgul wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
cards.lore: “‘He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'”

fields.title: In the Ringwraith's Wake
fields.gameText: Response: If a Nazgul wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
fields.lore: “‘He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'”

fields.title: Im Bann des Ringgeists
fields.lore: "Oh, er schwindet...Wir müssen ihn zu meinem Vater bringen.“

fields.title: En El Despertar de Los Espectros del Anillo
fields.lore: “Se esta desvaneciendo... Debemos llevarlo a mi padre.”

fields.title: Dans le Sillage des Spectres de l'Anneau
fields.lore: “‘Il décline..... Nous devons l'amener à mon père.'”

fields.title: Nella Morsa dello Spettro dell'Anello
fields.lore: “‘Sta scomparendo.... Dobbiamo portarlo da mio padre.'”

cards.title: The Master's Will
cards.gameText: Search. Shadow: Spot X Nazgul to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take into your hand all [WRAITH] cards revealed and discard the rest.
cards.lore: “...something seemed to be compelling him to disregard all warnings, and he longed to yield.”

fields.title: The Master's Will
fields.gameText: Search. Shadow: Spot X Nazgul to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take into your hand all [WRAITH] cards revealed and discard the rest.
fields.lore: “...something seemed to be compelling him to disregard all warnings, and he longed to yield.”

fields.title: Der Wille des Meisters
fields.lore: ...aber irgend etwas schien ihn zu zwingen, alle Warnungen zu missachten, und es drängte ihn nachzugeben.

fields.title: La Voluntad del Amo
fields.lore: “...pero algo parecía impulsarlo a desoír todas las advertencias, y dejarse llevar.”

fields.title: La Volonté du Maître
fields.lore: “...mais quelque chose semblait le contraindre à passer outre à tous les avertissements, et il brûlait d'y céder.”

fields.title: Il Volere del Padrone
fields.lore: “... qualcosa sembrava istigarlo, con una potenza quasi irresistibile, a trascurare tutti gli avvertimenti.”

cards.title: Morgul Blade
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer Blade Tip from your support area or discard pile to a companion bearer is skirmishing.

fields.title: Morgul Blade
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer Blade Tip from your support area or discard pile to a companion bearer is skirmishing.

cards.title: Morgul Gates
cards.gameText: Shadow: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -2.
cards.lore: The gates of Minas Morgul issued Nine Riders into the free lands, a blasphemy to ancient kings.

fields.title: Morgul Gates
fields.gameText: Shadow: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -2.
fields.lore: The gates of Minas Morgul issued Nine Riders into the free lands, a blasphemy to ancient kings.

fields.title: Die Tore von Minas Morgul
fields.lore: Die Tore von Minas Morgul spieen die Neun in die freien Länder, eine Blasphemie gegen die alten Könige.

fields.title: Puertas de Morgul
fields.lore: De las puertas de Minas Morgul emergieron Nueve hacia las tierras libres, una blasfemia contra los reyes antiguos.

fields.title: Portes de Morgul
fields.lore: Des portes de Minas Morgul sortirent les Neuf Cavaliers dans les contrées libres, un blasphême aux anciens rois.

fields.title: Cancelli di Morgul
fields.lore: Dai cancelli di Minas Morgul galopparono i Nove Cavalieri verso le terre libere, una bestemmia per gli antichi re.

cards.title: Nazgûl Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While you can spot 3 burdens, bearer is damage +1.
cards.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wielded by unseen hands willed by Sauron's hate.

fields.title: Nazgûl Sword
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While you can spot 3 burdens, bearer is damage +1.
fields.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wielded by unseen hands willed by Sauron's hate.

fields.title: Nazgûl Schwert
fields.lore: Die Waffen der Neun werden von unsichtbaren Händen geführt, die von Saurons Hass gelenkt werden.

fields.title: Espada Nazgûl
fields.lore: Las armas de los Nueve son llevadas por manos invisibles dispuestas por el odio de Sauron.

fields.title: Épée Nazgûl
fields.lore: Les armes des Neuf sont maniées par des mains invisibles animées par la haine de Sauron.

fields.title: Spada del Nazgûl
fields.lore: Le armi dei Nove sono maneggiate da mani invisibili al servizio dell'odio di Sauron.

cards.title: The Nine Servants of Sauron
cards.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Nazgul, you may exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: “‘That Black Rider was looking for something... or someone – Frodo?'”

fields.title: The Nine Servants of Sauron
fields.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Nazgul, you may exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: “‘That Black Rider was looking for something... or someone – Frodo?'”

fields.title: Die neun Diener Saurons
fields.lore: "Der schwarze Reiter hat irgendetwas gesucht...oder jemanden – Frodo?“

fields.title: Los Nueve Servidores de Sauron
fields.lore: “Ese jinete negro estaba buscando algo...o a alguien – ¿Frodo?”

fields.title: Les Neuf Serviteurs de Sauron
fields.lore: “‘Ce Cavalier Noir semblait chercher quelque chose ... ou quelqu'un – Frodon?'”

fields.title: I Nove Servi di Sauron
fields.lore: “‘I Cavalieri Neri stavano cercando qualcosa ... o qualcuno – Frodo?'”

cards.title: Not Easily Destroyed
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver or Skirmish: Remove (3) to heal a Nazgul.
cards.lore: “‘They were Kings... great Kings of Men. Sauron gave to them Nine Rings of Power and with them the promise of eternal rule... unending life.'”

fields.title: Not Easily Destroyed
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver or Skirmish: Remove (3) to heal a Nazgul.
fields.lore: “‘They were Kings... great Kings of Men. Sauron gave to them Nine Rings of Power and with them the promise of eternal rule... unending life.'”

fields.title: Nicht leicht zu töten
fields.lore: "Sie waren Könige...große Könige der Menschen. Sauron gab ihnen neun Ringe der Macht mit dem Versprechen unendlicher Herrschaft und ewigen Lebens.“

fields.title: No Destruidos Fácilmente
fields.lore: “Eran Reyes... Grandes Reyes de los Hombres. Sauron les dio Nueve Anillos de Poder y con ellos la promesa de gobernar eternamente... Vida interminable.”

fields.title: Difficilement Détruit
fields.lore: “‘Il s'agissait de Rois ... de grands Rois des Hommes. Sauron leur donna Neuf Anneaux de Puissance et avec eux la promesse d'une domination éternelle ... une vie sans fin.'”

fields.title: Non Facili da Distruggere
fields.lore: “‘Erano Re... grandi Re degli Uomini. Sauron diede loro Nove Anelli del Potere e con loro la promessa di un dominio eterno... di una vita senza fine.'”

cards.title: The Pale Blade
cards.gameText: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Response: If The Witch-king wins a skirmish, exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
cards.lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

fields.title: The Pale Blade
fields.gameText: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Response: If The Witch-king wins a skirmish, exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
fields.lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

fields.gameText: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.

fields.title: Die Bleiche Klinge
fields.lore: In seiner elenden Hand erhob der Anführer ein bleiches Schwert.

fields.title: La Espada Pálida
fields.lore: Con su penoso agarre, el Capitán levantó una Espada Pálida.

fields.title: L'Épée Blême
fields.lore: Dans sa misérable poigne, le Capitaine tenait une Épée Blême.

fields.title: La Pallida Lama
fields.lore: Con la sua miserabile stretta, il Capitano sollevò la Pallida Spada.

cards.title: Paths Seldom Trodden
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to replace the fellowship's site with your version of the same site.
cards.lore: “‘You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.'”

fields.title: Paths Seldom Trodden
fields.gameText: Search. To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to replace the fellowship's site with your version of the same site.
fields.lore: “‘You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.'”

fields.title: Selten beschrittene Pfade
fields.lore: "Nach dem heutigen Abend werdet ihr die offene Strasse vermeiden müssen; denn die Reiter werden sie Tag und Nacht beobachten.“

fields.title: Senderos Poco Transitados
fields.lore: “Desde esta noche tendrá usted que dejar la carretera, pues los jinetes la vigilaran día y noche.”

fields.title: Des Chemins Rarement Empruntés
fields.lore: “‘Il vous faudra quitter la route découverte ; car les Cavaliers la surveilleront nuit et jour.'”

fields.title: Cammini Percorsi Raramente
fields.lore: “‘Dovrete abbandonare la strada da domani, perché sarà sorvegliata notte e giorno dai Cavalieri.'”

cards.title: Relentless Charge
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every archer companion.
cards.lore: Even the fastest arrows are of no avail against the Black Steeds of the Nine Riders.

fields.title: Relentless Charge
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every archer companion.
fields.lore: Even the fastest arrows are of no avail against the Black Steeds of the Nine Riders.

fields.title: Unnachgiebiger Ansturm
fields.lore: Selbst die schnellsten Pfeile sind nutzlos gegen die schwarzen Rösser der neun Reiter.

fields.title: Carga Sin Descanso
fields.lore: Incluso las flechas más rápidas son inútiles contra los Corceles Negros de los Nueve Jinetes.

fields.title: Une Charge Implacable
fields.lore: Même les flèches les plus rapides ne sont pas efficaces contre les Noirs Destriers des Neuf Cavaliers.

fields.title: Carica Implacabile
fields.lore: Anche le frecce più veloci sono in svantaggio contro i Cavalli Neri dei Nove Cavalieri.

cards.title: Return to Its Master
cards.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring at the end of a skirmish phase, cancel all remaining assignments and assign a Nazgul to skirmish the Ring-bearer; The One Ring's game text does not apply during this skirmish.
cards.lore: “‘The Riders made straight for you....”'

fields.title: Return to Its Master
fields.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring at the end of a skirmish phase, cancel all remaining assignments and assign a Nazgul to skirmish the Ring-bearer; The One Ring's game text does not apply during this skirmish.
fields.lore: “‘The Riders made straight for you....”'

fields.title: Zurück zu Seinem Herrn
fields.lore: "Die Reiter hielten stracks auf dich zu...“

fields.title: Retorno a Su Amo
fields.lore: “Los Jinetes fueron directamente detrás de ti...”

fields.title: Retourner à son Maître
fields.lore: “‘Les Cavaliers vont droit sur vous....”'

fields.title: Ritorno al Suo Padrone
fields.lore: “‘I Cavalieri puntarono diritti su di te....”'

cards.title: Sword of Minas Morgul
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Ulaire Lemenya. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Lemenya to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: The Morgul hilt seared the flesh that would touch it, but the pierce was painless.

fields.title: Sword of Minas Morgul
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Ulaire Lemenya. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Lemenya to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: The Morgul hilt seared the flesh that would touch it, but the pierce was painless.

fields.title: Das Schwert von Minas Morgul
fields.lore: Der Griff der Morgulklinge verbrannte das Fleisch, das es berührte, aber sein Schnitt war schmerzlos.

fields.title: Espada de Minas Morgul
fields.lore: La empuñadura de Morgul marcó la carne que toco, pero la estocada fue indolora.

fields.title: Épée de Minas Morgul
fields.lore: La garde de Morgul dessécha la chair qui l'aurait touchée, mais le blessure était indolore.

fields.title: Spada di Minas Morgul
fields.lore: L'elsa di Morgul ustionava la carne di chi la toccava, ma la sua perforazione era indolore.

cards.title: Their Power Is in Terror
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every ally.
cards.lore: “‘In dark and loneliness they are strongest... and already some in Bree are in their clutch.'”

fields.title: Their Power Is in Terror
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every ally.
fields.lore: “‘In dark and loneliness they are strongest... and already some in Bree are in their clutch.'”

fields.title: Ihre Stärke ist die Furcht
fields.lore: "In Dunkelheit und Einsamkeit sind sie am stärksten...und einige in Bree sind schon in ihren Klauen.“

fields.title: Su Poder Esta en El Terror
fields.lore: “...pues son mucho más fuertes en las tinieblas y la soledad... y ya dominan a muchos en Bree.”

fields.title: Leur Pouvoir est dans la Terreur
fields.lore: “‘C'est dans les ténèbres et la solitude qu'ils sont les plus forts ... et déjà certains à Bree sont sous leur emprise.'”

fields.title: Il Loro Potere È nel Terrore
fields.lore: “‘Sono più forti nell'oscurità e nella solitudine... e già parecchia gente qui a Brea è caduta nelle loro grinfie.'”

cards.title: Threshold of Shadow
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 5 burdens).
cards.lore: “‘They did not need the guidance of their horses any longer: you had become visible to them....”'

fields.title: Threshold of Shadow
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 5 burdens).
fields.lore: “‘They did not need the guidance of their horses any longer: you had become visible to them....”'
