fields.title: An der Schwelle zum Schattenreich
fields.lore: "Sie brauchten sich nicht mehr von ihren Pferden leiten zu lassen: du warst für sie sichtbar geworden...“

fields.title: Umbral de La Sombra
fields.lore: “Ya no necesitaban que los caballos los guiaran: te habías vuelto visible para ellos...”

fields.title: Au Seuil de l'Ombre
fields.lore: “‘Ils n'avaient plus besoin d'être dirigés par leurs chevaux ; vous leur étiez devenu visible....”'

fields.title: Soglia dell'Ombra
fields.lore: “‘Non avevano più bisogno della guida dei loro cavalli: tu eri ormai visibile ai loro occhi....”'

cards.title: The Twilight World
cards.gameText: Response: If Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert a Nazgul to add 2 burdens.
cards.lore: “Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings.”

fields.title: The Twilight World
fields.gameText: Response: If Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert a Nazgul to add 2 burdens.
fields.lore: “Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings.”

fields.title: Die Welt der Geister
fields.lore: Obwohl alles wie vorher blieb, düster und dunkel, wurden die Gestalten sofort erschreckend deutlich. Er vermochte unter ihre schwarzen Hüllen zu schauen.

fields.title: El Mundo de Penumbra
fields.lore: “Inmediatamente, aunque todo lo demás continuo como antes, indistinto y sombrío, las sombras se hicieron terriblemente nítidas. Podía verlas ahora bajo las negras envolturas.”

fields.title: Le Monde Crépusculaire
fields.lore: “Aussitôt, bien que tout le reste demeurât comme avant, indistinct et sombre, les formes devinrent terriblement nettes. Il pouvait voir sous les voilures noires.”

fields.title: Il Mondo del Crepuscolo
fields.lore: “Immediatamente le forme diventarono chiarissime, benché tutto il resto rimanesse tenebroso e scuro. Egli riusciva a vedere al di sotto dei manti neri.”

cards.title: Úlairë Attëa
cards.subtitle: Keeper of Dol Guldur
cards.gameText: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make Ulaire Attea strength +1 (limit +5).
cards.lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the Will of Sauron.

fields.title: Úlairë Attëa
fields.subtitle: Keeper of Dol Guldur
fields.gameText: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make Ulaire Attea strength +1 (limit +5).
fields.lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the Will of Sauron.

fields.subtitle: Wächter von Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Diejenigen, die im Leben als Könige die größte Macht innehatten, wurden unter Saurons Willen für besondere Aufgaben eingesetzt.

fields.subtitle: Guardián de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Aquellos que conocían el poder absoluto como reyes fueron colocados de manera particular por la Voluntad de Sauron.

fields.subtitle: Gardien de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Ceux qui avaient le plus de pouvoir en tant que rois furent employés de façon particulière sous la volonté de Sauron.

fields.subtitle: Guardiano Di Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Quelli che conobbero il maggior potere come re sono stati esposti in modo particolare al Volere di Sauron.

cards.title: Úlairë Cantëa
cards.subtitle: Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
cards.gameText: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Cantea to discard a weapon borne by a character he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: The Ringwraith has no semblance to the Man, its being passed into twilight, life spirit into void.

fields.title: Úlairë Cantëa
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
fields.gameText: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Cantea to discard a weapon borne by a character he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: The Ringwraith has no semblance to the Man, its being passed into twilight, life spirit into void.

fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Ein Ringgeist hat nichts mehr Menschliches an sich, sein Wesen ins Zwielicht vergangen, sein Lebensgeist in die ewige Leere.

fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: El Espectro del Anillo no recuerda en nada al Hombre, ha pasado a la penumbra, espíritu de vida a vació.

fields.subtitle: Lieutenant de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Le Spectre de l'Anneau ne ressemble plus à un Homme, il est passé dans le crépuscule, son âme dans le vide.

fields.subtitle: Luogotenente Di Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Lo Spettro dell'Anello non ha sembianze umane, la sua essenza è svanita nel crepuscolo, il suo spirito vivente nel vuoto.

cards.title: Úlairë Enquëa
cards.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
cards.gameText: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Ulaire Enquea to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

fields.title: Úlairë Enquëa
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
fields.gameText: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Ulaire Enquea to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Minas Morgul
fields.lore: Die neun Reiter verkörpern Saurons Willen und durchsuchen ganz Mittelerde nach seinem Schatz.

fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Morgul
fields.lore: Los Nueve Jinetes eran personificaciones de la voluntad de Sauron, buscando su premio por toda la Tierra Media.

fields.subtitle: Lieutenant de Morgul
fields.lore: Les Neuf Cavaliers sont des incarnations de la volonté de Sauron, cherchant à travers toute la Terre du Milieu pour son compte.

cards.title: Úlairë Lemenya
cards.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
cards.gameText: Each companion or ally who bears a [WRAITH] condition is strength -2.
cards.lore: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

fields.title: Úlairë Lemenya
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
fields.gameText: Each companion or ally who bears a [WRAITH] condition is strength -2.
fields.lore: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Minas Morgul
fields.lore: "Wollt ihr, dass sie euch finden? Sie sind entsetzlich!“

fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Morgul
fields.lore: “¿Permitirá que le den alcance? ¡Son terribles!”

fields.subtitle: Lieutenant de Morgul
fields.lore: “‘Voulez-vous qu'ils vous trouvent ? Ils sont terribles !'”

fields.subtitle: Luogotenente Di Morgul
fields.lore: “‘Volete che essi vi trovino? Sono terribili!'”

cards.title: Úlairë Nelya
cards.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
cards.gameText: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya and spot an opponent's site to replace it with your site of the same number.
cards.lore: Many of the Nine were princes of majesty and power.

fields.title: Úlairë Nelya
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
fields.gameText: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya and spot an opponent's site to replace it with your site of the same number.
fields.lore: Many of the Nine were princes of majesty and power.

fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Minas Morgul
fields.lore: Viele der Neun waren früher einmal mächtige und erhabene Fürsten.

fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Morgul
fields.lore: Muchos de los Nueve eran Príncipes de majestad y poder.

fields.subtitle: Lieutenant de Morgul
fields.lore: Beaucoup des Neuf étaient des princes, majestueux et puissants.

cards.title: Úlairë Nertëa
cards.subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
cards.gameText: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play 1 minion from your discard pile.
cards.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

fields.title: Úlairë Nertëa
fields.subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
fields.gameText: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play 1 minion from your discard pile.
fields.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

fields.gameText: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play a unique [RINGWRAITH] minion from your discard pile.

fields.subtitle: Bote aus Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Einige von ihnen akzeptierten Saurons Geschenk des Ruhms und das Versprechen großer Taten.

fields.subtitle: Mensajero de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Algunos aceptaron el regalo de Sauron por la gloria y la idea de grandes gestas.

fields.subtitle: Messager de Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Certains acceptèrent le cadeau de Sauron pour la gloire et l'espoir de grandes actions.

fields.subtitle: Messaggero Di Dol Guldur
fields.lore: Alcuni hanno accettato il dono di Sauron per la gloria e per il desiderio di grandi imprese.

cards.title: Úlairë Otsëa
cards.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert Ulaire Otsea to make a [WRAITH] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “...under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.”

fields.title: Úlairë Otsëa
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert Ulaire Otsea to make a [WRAITH] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “...under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.”

fields.title: Úlairë Ostëa
fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Minas Morgul
fields.lore: ...unter ihren Mänteln trugen sie lange graue Gewänder, auf ihren grauen Haaren Helme aus Silber; in ihren hageren Händen hielten sie Schwerter aus Stahl.

fields.title: Úlairë Ostëa
fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Morgul
fields.lore: “...bajo los mantos llevaban unas vestiduras largas y grises; yelmos de plata cubrían sus cabelleras canosas, y las manos macilentas sostenían espadas de acero.”

fields.title: Úlairë Ostëa
fields.subtitle: Lieutenant de Morgul
fields.lore: “...sous leurs capes étaient de longues robes grises ; sur leurs cheveux gris étaient des heaumes d'argent ; dans leurs mains décharnées, des épées d'acier.”

fields.title: Úlairë Ostëa
fields.subtitle: Luogotenente Di Morgul
fields.lore: “...sotto le cappe, portavano un abito lungo e grigio, e sui capelli grigi, un elmo d'argento; le loro mani scarne stringevano spade d'acciaio.”

cards.title: Úlairë Toldëa
cards.subtitle: Messenger of Morgul
cards.gameText: Fierce. Assignment: Spot 4 burdens to assign a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish Ulaire Toldea.
cards.lore: “‘Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

fields.title: Úlairë Toldëa
fields.subtitle: Messenger of Morgul
fields.gameText: Fierce. Assignment: Spot 4 burdens to assign a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish Ulaire Toldea.
fields.lore: “‘Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

fields.subtitle: Bote aus Minas Morgul
fields.lore: "Öffne, im Namen von Mordor!" sagte eine dünne, aber drohende Stimme.“

fields.subtitle: Mensajero de Morgul
fields.lore: “¡Abre, en nombre de Mordor! – dijo una voz atiplada y amenazadora.”

fields.subtitle: Messager de Morgul
fields.lore: “‘Ouvrez, au nom du Mordor !' dit une voix ténue mais menaçante.”

fields.subtitle: Messaggero Di Morgul
fields.lore: “‘Aprite, in nome di Mordor!' disse una voce acuta e minacciosa.”

cards.title: The Witch-king
cards.subtitle: Lord of Angmar
cards.gameText: Fierce. For each other Nazgul you can spot, The Witch-king is strength +2.
cards.lore: “...his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown.”

fields.title: The Witch-king
fields.subtitle: Lord of Angmar
fields.gameText: Fierce. For each other Nazgul you can spot, The Witch-king is strength +2.
fields.lore: “...his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown.”

fields.title: Der Hexenkönig
fields.subtitle: Herrscher von Angmar
fields.lore: ...sein Haar war lang und schimmernd, und auf seinem Helm war eine Krone.

fields.title: El Rey Brujo
fields.subtitle: Señor de Angmar
fields.lore: “...tenia una cabellera brillante y larga, y sobre el yelmo llevaba una corona.”

fields.title: Le Roi-Sorcier
fields.subtitle: Seigneur d'Angmar
fields.lore: “...ses cheveux étaient longs et luisants, et sur son heaume se trouvait une couronne.”

fields.title: Il Re Stregone
fields.subtitle: Sire di Angmar
fields.lore: “...i capelli lunghi luccicavano e sull'elmo era posta una corona.”

cards.title: Wreathed in Shadow
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Archery: Remove (1) to make the fellowship archery total -1.
cards.lore: They are beings in twilight, without form to catch the points of weapons.

fields.title: Wreathed in Shadow
fields.gameText: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Archery: Remove (1) to make the fellowship archery total -1.
fields.lore: They are beings in twilight, without form to catch the points of weapons.

fields.title: In Schatten gehüllt
fields.lore: Sie sind Wesen einer Schattenwelt, ohne Form, die von unseren Waffen durchbohrt werden könnte.

fields.title: Envuelto En Sombras
fields.lore: Son seres de penumbra, sin forma para recibir las punzadas de nuestras armas.

fields.title: Entouré par l'Ombre
fields.lore: Ce sont des êtres du crépuscule, informes et donc capables de saisir les extrêmités des armes.

fields.title: Avvolti nell'Ombra
fields.lore: Sono esseri che vivono nel crepuscolo, senza forma che la punta di un'arma possa incontrare.

cards.title: All Thought Bent on It
cards.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
cards.lore: “‘...for the Ring yearns, above all else, to return to the hand of its Master: they are one....'”

fields.title: All Thought Bent on It
fields.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
fields.lore: “‘...for the Ring yearns, above all else, to return to the hand of its Master: they are one....'”

fields.title: Mit aller Macht versessen
fields.lore: "...weil der Ring, mehr als alles andere, zurück zu seinem Meister will: denn sie sind eins...“

fields.title: Todos Los Pensamientos Sobre Él
fields.lore: “... Pues el Anillo ansia, por encima de todo, volver a la mano de su Amo: ellos son uno...”

fields.title: Toutes ses Pensées Vont vers Lui
fields.lore: “‘...car l'Anneau désire, avant tout, retourner dans la main de son Maître: ils sont un....'”

fields.title: Tutti i Pensieri si Rivolgono ad Esso
fields.lore: “‘...la bramosia per l'Anello, sopra ogni altra, per farlo tornare nelle mani del suo Padrone: loro sono uno....'”

cards.title: Band of the Eye
cards.gameText: Response: If this minion wins a skirmish, remove (2) to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
cards.lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.

fields.title: Band of the Eye
fields.gameText: Response: If this minion wins a skirmish, remove (2) to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
fields.lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.

fields.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may remove (2) to add 2 burdens. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Schar des einen Auges
fields.lore: Sauron hat weit mehr Orks in den Höhlen unter Barad-dûr gezüchtet, als sich Saruman je vorstellen könnte.

fields.title: Banda del Ojo
fields.lore: Mas Orcos ha criado Sauron en los pozos bajo Barad-dûr de los que Saruman nunca podría imaginar.

fields.title: Troupe de l'*il
fields.lore: Sauron a élevé beaucoup plus d'Orques dans ses puits sous Barad-dûr que Saroumane ne pourra jamais l'imaginer.

fields.title: Banda Dell'Occhio
fields.lore: Sauron ha generato negli abissi sotto Barad-dûr molti più Orchi di quanti Saruman potrebbe mai immaginare.

cards.title: Curse From Mordor
cards.gameText: Shadow: Spot a [SAURON] Orc to discard an [ELVEN] condition.
cards.lore: The Dark Lord harbors an ancient hatred for descendants of Gil-galad and those that marched with his gleaming host.

fields.title: Curse From Mordor
fields.gameText: Shadow: Spot a [SAURON] Orc to discard an [ELVEN] condition.
fields.lore: The Dark Lord harbors an ancient hatred for descendants of Gil-galad and those that marched with his gleaming host.

fields.title: Mordors Fluch
fields.lore: Der dunkle Herrscher hegt einen uralten Groll gegen die Nachfahren von Gil-galad und derer, die in seiner glorreichen Heerschar marschierten.

fields.title: Maldición de Mordor
fields.lore: El Señor Oscuro alberga un odio antiguo hacia los descendientes de Gil-Galad, y aquellos que marcharon con su hueste resplandeciente.

fields.title: Malédiction du Mordor
fields.lore: Le Seigneur Ténébreux voue une haine ancienne aux descendants de Gil-galad et à ceux qui ont marché avec son armée rayonnante.

fields.title: Maledizione da Mordor
fields.lore: Il Signore Oscuro nutre un odio antico per i discendenti di Gil-Galad e quelli che marciarono con il suo brillante esercito.

cards.title: The Dark Lord's Summons
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [SAURON] card, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it and one other card from hand.
cards.lore: Orcs obey the Dark Lord unquestioningly.

fields.title: The Dark Lord's Summons
fields.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [SAURON] card, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it and one other card from hand.
fields.lore: Orcs obey the Dark Lord unquestioningly.

fields.title: Der Ruf des dunklen Herrschers
fields.lore: Orks folgen dem dunklen Herrscher, ohne zu zögern.

fields.title: La Llamada del Señor Oscuro
fields.lore: Los Orcos obedecen al Señor Oscuro sin hacer preguntas.

fields.title: L'Appel du Seigneur Ténébreux
fields.lore: Les Orques obéissent au Seigneur Ténébreux sans poser de questions.

fields.title: Le Evocazioni dell'Oscuro Signore
fields.lore: Gli Orchi obbediscono all'Oscuro Signore senza far domande.

cards.title: Despair
cards.gameText: Maneuver: If the total number of burdens and companions in the dead pile is at least 12, spot a [SAURON] Orc to corrupt the Ring-bearer.
cards.lore: “‘The Nameless Enemy has arisen again. Smoke rises once more from Orodruin that we call Mount Doom.'”

fields.title: Despair
fields.gameText: Maneuver: If the total number of burdens and companions in the dead pile is at least 12, spot a [SAURON] Orc to corrupt the Ring-bearer.
fields.lore: “‘The Nameless Enemy has arisen again. Smoke rises once more from Orodruin that we call Mount Doom.'”

fields.title: Verzweiflung
fields.lore: "Der Namenlose Feind ist wieder auferstanden. Rauch steigt wieder über dem Orodruin, den wir Schicksalsberg nennen, auf.“

fields.title: Desesperación
fields.lore: “El Enemigo sin nombre se ha alzado de nuevo. El humo asciende otra vez desde el Orodruin que nosotros llamamos Monte del Destino.”

fields.title: Désespoir
fields.lore: “‘L'Ennemi sans Nom s'est de nouveau mis en branle. La fumée s'élève une fois de plus d'Orodruin, que nous appelons la Montagne du Destin.'”

fields.title: Disperazione
fields.lore: “‘Il nemico Innominato è risorto. Il fumo s'innalza nuovamente dall'Orodruin, che noi chiamiamo Monte Fato.'”

cards.title: Desperate Defense of the Ring
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either discard 3 cards from hand or add a burden.
cards.lore: The Company must defend the Ring at all costs.

fields.title: Desperate Defense of the Ring
fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either discard 3 cards from hand or add a burden.
fields.lore: The Company must defend the Ring at all costs.

fields.title: Verzweifelte Verteidigung des Rings
fields.lore: Die Gefährten müssen den Ring unter allen Umständen verteidigen.

fields.title: Defensa Desesperada del Anillo
fields.lore: La Compañía debe defender el Anillo a cualquier precio.

fields.title: Protection Désespérée de l'Anneau
fields.lore: La compagnie doit défendre l'Anneau à tout prix.

fields.title: Difesa Disperata dell'Anello
fields.lore: La Compagnia deve difendere l'Anello a tutti i costi.

cards.title: Desperate Measures
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard top 5 cards from his draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

fields.title: Desperate Measures
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard top 5 cards from his draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

fields.gameText: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to take a [SAURON] card into hand from your discard pile. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 8 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

fields.title: Verzweifelte Massnahmen
fields.lore: "Geh zurück, Sam. Ich werde alleine nach Mordor gehen. Du kannst nicht schwimmen.“

fields.title: Medidas Desesperadas
fields.lore: “Regresa, Sam. No puedes nadar. Voy a Mordor solo.”

fields.title: Moyens Désespérés
fields.lore: “‘Repars, Sam. Tu ne sais pas nager. Je vais au Mordor seul.'”

fields.title: Misure Disperate
fields.lore: “‘Torna indietro, Sam. Non puoi nuotare. Andrò a Mordor da solo.'”

cards.title: Enduring Evil
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a [SAURON] Orc strength -X.
cards.lore: “‘The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'”

fields.title: Enduring Evil
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a [SAURON] Orc strength -X.
fields.lore: “‘The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'”

fields.title: Andauerndes Übel
fields.lore: "Der Schwarze Turm war geschleift, doch seine Grundmauern standen noch; denn sie waren mit der Macht des Ringes gebaut worden, und solange er da ist, bleiben sie erhalten.“

fields.title: Mal Duradero
fields.lore: “La Torre Oscura fue demolida, pero quedaron los cimientos; pues habían sido puestos con el poder del Anillo, y mientras haya Anillo nada podrá desenterrarlos.”

fields.title: Mal Persistant
fields.lore: “‘La Tour Sombre était démolie, mais les fondations n'en étaient pas effacées ; car elles avaient été faites par le pouvoir de l'Anneau et tant qu'il restera, elles demeureront.'”

fields.title: Male Durevole
fields.lore: “‘La Torre Oscura fu demolita, ma le sue fondamenta rimasero perché furono costruite col potere dell'Anello e scompariranno soltanto con esso.'”

cards.title: Enheartened Foe
cards.gameText: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.

fields.title: Enheartened Foe
fields.gameText: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.

fields.title: Beherzter Feind
fields.lore: Das Selbstbewusstsein der Orks wächst mit ihren Erfolgen. Je mehr Erfolg, desto größer die Taten.

fields.title: Enemigo Embravecido
fields.lore: Los Orcos se alimentan en su propio triunfo. Cuanto más grandes sus proezas en la batalla, más grande crece su confianza.

fields.title: Ennemi sans Pitié
fields.lore: Les Orques se nourrissent de leurs propres succès. Plus ils réussissent dans la bataille, plus leur confiance croît.

fields.title: Nemico Rincuorato
fields.lore: Gli Orchi sono nutriti dai loro stessi successi. Più sono grandi le loro imprese in battaglia, più cresce la loro baldanza.

cards.title: Forces of Mordor
cards.gameText: Shadow: Spot X [SAURON] minions to add (X).
cards.lore: “‘....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

fields.title: Forces of Mordor
fields.gameText: Shadow: Spot X [SAURON] minions to add (X).
fields.lore: “‘....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] minion to add (1) for each [SAURON] Orc you can spot (limit (3)).

fields.title: Die Truppen von Mordor
fields.lore: "...der dunkle Herrscher hat Verbündete. Die Ostlinge und Haradrim zollen Mordor nun Tribut.“

fields.title: Fuerzas de Mordor
fields.lore: “... El Señor Oscuro no esta sin aliados. Los Hombres del este y los Haradrim ahora pagan tributo a Mordor.”

fields.title: Ressources du Mordor
fields.lore: “‘....le Seigneur Ténébreux n'est pas sans alliés. Ceux de l'Est et les Haradrim paient maintenant un tribut au Mordor.'”

fields.title: Forze di Mordor
fields.lore: “‘....il Signore Oscuro non è senza alleati. Gli Esterling e gli Haradrim ora pagano il tributo a Mordor.'”

cards.title: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each [SAURON] Orc skirmishing a [GONDOR] character is strength +2. Discard this condition if your [SAURON] Orc loses a skirmish.
cards.lore: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.

fields.title: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each [SAURON] Orc skirmishing a [GONDOR] character is strength +2. Discard this condition if your [SAURON] Orc loses a skirmish.
fields.lore: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.

fields.title: Die glänzenden Türme werden zerfallen
fields.lore: Gondor ist schon lange das Ziel des Hasses von Sauron, dem Großen.

fields.title: Relucientes Espiras Se Derrumbaran
fields.lore: Gondor ha sido durante mucho el objetivo de la ira de Sauron el Grande.

fields.title: Les Tours Rayonnantes s'Écrouleront
fields.lore: Le Gondor a longtemps été la cible du courroux de Sauron le Grand.

fields.title: Scintillanti Guglie Crolleranno
fields.lore: Gondor è stata da lungo tempo il bersaglio della collera di Sauron il Grande.

cards.title: Hate
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.

fields.title: Hate
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.

fields.title: Hass
fields.lore: Orks hassen nicht nur ihre Feinde, sondern alles was lebt.

fields.title: Odio
fields.lore: Los Orcos están llenos de odio no solo por sus enemigos, sino por todo lo que vive.

fields.title: Haine
fields.lore: Les Orques sont remplis de haine non seulement pour leurs ennemis, mais pour tout ce qui vit.

fields.title: Odio
fields.lore: Gli Orchi sono pieni d'odio non solo per i loro nemici, ma per tutto ciò che vive.

cards.title: A Host Avails Little
cards.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.
cards.lore: “‘Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little....'”

fields.title: A Host Avails Little
fields.gameText: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.
fields.lore: “‘Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little....'”

fields.title: Ein Heer würde mir auch nichts nützen
fields.lore: "Hätte ich eine bewaffnete Streitmacht der Elben wie in der Altvorderenzeit, so würde sie wenig nutzen...“

fields.title: Una Hueste Nos Serviría de Poco
fields.lore: “Aunque contáramos con una hueste de Elfos con armas de los Días Antiguos, solo conseguiríamos despertar el poder de Mordor.”

fields.title: Une Phalange Accomplit Peu
fields.lore: “‘Eussé-je une phalange d'Elfes en armes des Anciens Jours que cela servirait seulement à éveiller la puissance du Mordor.'”

fields.title: Un Esercito Serve a Poco
fields.lore: “‘Anche se disponessi ancora di una schiera di Elfi muniti di armatura come nei Tempi Remoti, potrebbe fare ben poco.'”

cards.title: The Irresistible Shadow
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
cards.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

fields.title: The Irresistible Shadow
fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
fields.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. The Ring-bearer is strength +1 for each burden you can spot. If you cannot spot another companion, the Ring-bearer is resistance -2 for each burden you can spot.

fields.title: Unaufhaltsamer Schatten
fields.lore: Wieder wurde Frodo von dem Wunsch befallen, den Ring aufzustreifen, aber diesmal stärker als vorher.

fields.title: La Sombra Irresistible
fields.lore: “Una vez mas Frodo sintió el deseo de ponerse el Anillo, y el deseo era mas fuerte que nunca.”

fields.title: L'Ombre Irrésistible
fields.lore: “Une fois de plus, le désir de glisser l'Anneau à son doigt s'empara de Frodon ; mais cette fois, il était plus fort qu'auparavant.”

fields.title: L'Irresistibile Ombra
fields.lore: “Il desiderio di infilarsi l'Anello s'impadronì di Frodo; ma questa volta con molta più forza.”

cards.title: Journey Into Danger
cards.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 5 companions, each companion's twilight cost is +2.
cards.lore: “‘I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'”

fields.title: Journey Into Danger
fields.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 5 companions, each companion's twilight cost is +2.
fields.lore: “‘I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'”

fields.title: Eine Reise voller Gefahren
fields.lore: "Ich weissage nicht, denn alles Weissagen ist jetzt vergebens: auf der einen Seite liegt Dunkelheit und auf der anderen nur Hoffnung.“

fields.title: Viaje Hacia El Peligro
fields.lore: “No profetizo nada, pues toda profecía es vana ahora; de un lado hay oscuridad y del otro lado nada mas que esperanza.”

fields.title: Voyage au C*ur du Danger
fields.lore: “‘Je ne prédis rien, car toute prédiction serait à présent vaine: d'une part il y a les ténèbres, et de l'autre seulement de l'espoir.'”

fields.title: Viaggio nel Pericolo
fields.lore: “‘Non predico il futuro, perché ogni profezia è vana: da un lato vi è l'oscurità, e dall'altro solo speranza.'”

cards.title: Mordor Enraged
cards.gameText: Plays on a [SAURON] minion. Shadow: Exert bearer to add (1) for each archer companion.
cards.lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

fields.title: Mordor Enraged
fields.gameText: Plays on a [SAURON] minion. Shadow: Exert bearer to add (1) for each archer companion.
fields.lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] minion. Plays on an archer companion. Each time the Free Peoples player uses an archery special ability, bearer must exert.

fields.title: Mordor in Aufruhr
fields.lore: Die Armeen von Elendil und Gil-galad entfachten Saurons Zorn und Hass.

fields.title: Mordor Enfurecido
fields.lore: Los ejércitos de Elendil y Gil-Galad enardecieron la ira y el odio de Sauron.

fields.title: Mordor Exaspéré
fields.lore: Les armées d'Elendil et de Gil-galad enflammèrent la colère de Sauron et sa haine.

fields.title: Furia di Mordor
fields.lore: Le armate di Elendil e Gil-Galad accesero l'ira e l'odio di Sauron.

cards.title: Mordor's Strength
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'”

fields.title: Mordor's Strength
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “‘It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'”

fields.title: Mordors Stärke
fields.lore: "Es hätte damals enden sollen, aber es wurde dem Bösen erlaubt, weiterzubestehen.“

fields.title: La Fuerza de Mordor
fields.lore: “Tendría que haber acabado ese día, pero al mal se le permitió perdurar.”

fields.title: Force de Mordor
fields.lore: “‘Cela aurait dû se terminer ce jour, mais il a été permis au Mal de persister.'”

fields.title: Forza di Mordor
fields.lore: “‘Avrebbe dovuto essere concluso quel giorno, ma al male è stato permesso di resistere.'”

cards.title: Morgul Hunter
cards.gameText: For each companion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
cards.lore: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.

fields.title: Morgul Hunter
fields.gameText: For each companion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
fields.lore: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.

fields.title: Morguljäger
fields.lore: Saurons Hass brennt in den Herzen seiner Diener.

fields.title: Cazador de Morgul
fields.lore: El odio de Sauron vive en los corazones de sus siervos.

fields.title: Chasseur de Morgul
fields.lore: La haine de Sauron se retrouve au sein de ses séides.

fields.title: Cacciatore di Morgul
fields.lore: L'odio di Sauron vive nei cuori dei suoi servi.

cards.title: Morgul Skirmisher
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

fields.title: Morgul Skirmisher
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
fields.lore: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

fields.title: Morgul Plänkler
fields.lore: Die Orks von Mordor, durch den Gedanken an Blutvergiessen und Beute beflügelt, sind gefährliche Gegner im Kampf.

fields.title: Hostigador de Morgul
fields.lore: Los Orcos de Mordor, embravecidos por la promesa de sangre y botín, son enemigos peligrosos en la batalla.

fields.title: Combattant de Morgul
fields.lore: Les Orques du Mordor, portés par la promesse de sang et de butin, sont de dangereux ennemis dans la bataille.

cards.title: Morgul Skulker
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [WRAITH] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
cards.lore: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

fields.title: Morgul Skulker
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [WRAITH] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
fields.lore: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

fields.title: Morgul Schleicher
fields.lore: Die Orks von Minas Morgul, durchtriebene Diener der Ringgeister, sind besonders aufmerksam, was die Wünsche ihrer Meister angeht.

fields.title: Acechador de Morgul
fields.lore: Astutos servidores de los Espectros del Anillo del Valle de Morgul, los Orcos de Morgul están alerta a los deseos de sus amos.

fields.title: Maraudeur de Morgul
fields.lore: Serviteurs sournois des Spectres de l'Anneau de la Vallée de Morgul, les Orques de Morgul sont soucieux des désirs de leurs maîtres.

fields.title: Esploratore
fields.lore: Scaltri servi dello Spettro dell'Anello della Valle di Morgul, gli Orchi di Morgul sono attenti ai desideri dei loro padroni.

cards.title: Morgul Warden
cards.gameText: For each other [SAURON] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
cards.lore: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

fields.title: Morgul Warden
fields.gameText: For each other [SAURON] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
fields.lore: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

fields.title: Morgul Wächter
fields.lore: Mit blinder Hingabe folgen die Orks aus Mordor den Befehlen aus dem Dunklen Turm.

fields.title: Vigilante de Morgul
fields.lore: Con ciega devoción, los Orcos de Mordor siguen las ordenes de la Torre Oscura.

fields.title: Gardien de Morgul
fields.lore: Avec une dévotion aveugle, les Orques du Mordor suivent les ordres venus de la Tour Sombre.

fields.title: Guardiano di Morgul
fields.lore: Con devozione cieca, gli Orchi di Mordor seguono gli ordini emanati dalla Torre Oscura.

cards.title: The Number Must Be Few
cards.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
cards.lore: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

fields.title: The Number Must Be Few
fields.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
fields.lore: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

fields.title: The Number Must Be Few
fields.gameText: Search. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1). When you can no longer spot 7 companions or this card leaves play, this penalty is immediately lost.

fields.title: Ihre Zahl muss klein sein
fields.lore: "Ihre Zahl muss klein sein, denn deine Hoffnung liegt in Schnelligkeit und Heimlichkeit.“

fields.title: Tienen Que Ser Pocos
fields.lore: “Tienen que ser pocos, ya que tus mayores esperanzas dependen de la rapidez y el secreto.”

fields.title: Il les Faut Peu Nombreux
fields.lore: “‘Il les faut peu nombreux, puisque notre espoir réside dans la rapidité et le secret.'”

fields.title: Piccolo Deve Essere il Numero
fields.lore: “‘Piccolo deve essere il numero, poiché la vostra speranza è nella rapidità e nella segretezza.'”

cards.title: Orc Ambusher
cards.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues....'”

fields.title: Orc Ambusher
fields.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
fields.lore: “‘Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues....'”

fields.title: Lauernder Orkräuber
fields.lore: "Orks verfolgen ihre Feinde oftmals über viele Meilen hinweg...“

fields.title: Emboscador Orco
fields.lore: “...los Orcos a menudo persiguen a sus enemigos durante varias leguas...”

fields.title: Orque en Embuscade
fields.lore: “‘Les Orques poursuivent souvent leurs ennemis sur plusieurs lieues....'”

fields.title: Orco Incursore
fields.lore: Risposta: Se un evento raccolta dei Popoli Liberi viene giocato, sforza questo servitore per cancellare quell'evento.

cards.title: Orc Assassin
cards.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.

fields.title: Orc Assassin
fields.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.

cards.title: Orc Banner
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish that involves a [SAURON] Orc, each [SAURON] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.

fields.title: Orc Banner
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a [SAURON] Orc wins a skirmish, each [SAURON] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish that involves a [SAURON] Orc, each [SAURON] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.

fields.title: Orkbanner
fields.lore: Orkstämme aus ganz Mordor scharen sich um das Banner des Dunklen Turms.

fields.title: Estandarte Orco
fields.lore: Tribus de Orcos de todo Mordor se reúnen bajo el estandarte de la Torre Oscura.

fields.title: Bannière Orque
fields.lore: Les tribus d'Orques de tout le Mordor se rallient sous la bannière de la Tour Sombre.

fields.title: Stendardo degli Orchi
fields.lore: Tribù di Orchi da ogni parte di Mordor si radunano sotto il vessillo della Torre Oscura.

cards.title: Orc Bowmen
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [SAURON] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.
cards.lore: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.

fields.title: Orc Bowmen
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [SAURON] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.
fields.lore: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.

fields.title: Ork Bogenschützen
fields.lore: Wo Salven von Orkpfeilen fliegen, dort fallen die Verteidiger des Westens.

fields.title: Arquero Orco
fields.lore: Donde caen las andanadas de flechas Orcas, caen los defensores del Oeste.

fields.title: Archers Orques
fields.lore: Là où les volés de flèches orques tombent, les défenseurs de l'ouest tombent.

fields.title: Arcieri Orchi
fields.lore: Dove le raffiche delle frecce degli Orchi volano, i difensori dell'Ovest cadono.

cards.title: Orc Butchery
cards.gameText: Response: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.
cards.lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

fields.title: Orc Butchery
fields.gameText: Response: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.
fields.lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

fields.gameText: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, then for each card in the dead pile the Free Peoples player must choose to add a burden or discard 4 cards from the top of their draw deck.

fields.title: Ork Schlachtfest
fields.lore: Aus Spaß zerhacken die Orks die Körper derer, die sie erschlagen haben.

fields.title: Matanza Orca
fields.lore: Por deporte, los Orcos se recrean en los cuerpos de los sus victimas.

fields.title: Massacre Orque
fields.lore: Par jeu, les Orques tailladent cruellement les corps de ceux qu'ils tuent.

fields.title: Strage degli Orchi
fields.lore: Per divertimento, gli Orchi infieriscono crudelmente sui corpi di chi hanno ucciso.

cards.title: Orc Chieftain
cards.gameText: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).
cards.lore: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.

fields.title: Orc Chieftain
fields.gameText: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).
fields.lore: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.

fields.title: Ork Häuptling
fields.lore: Ork Häuptlinge sind die brutalsten einer gefühlslosen Rasse. Sowohl Stärke als auch Bosheit sind vonnöten, um solche Wesen anzuführen.

fields.title: Caudillo Orco
fields.lore: Los caudillos Orcos son los más crueles de una raza sin corazón. Tanto la fuerza como la malicia son necesarias para liderar tales seguidores.

fields.title: Chef de Clan Orque
fields.lore: Les Chefs de Clan Orques sont les plus cruels d'une race sans pitié. À la fois force et malice sont nécessaires pour diriger de tels suivants.

fields.title: Capo Orco
fields.lore: I Capi degli Orchi sono i più crudeli di questa razza spietata. Sia la forza che la malvagità sono necessarie per condurre seguaci di tal sorta.

cards.title: Orc Hunters
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight – and the spoils of victory.

fields.title: Orc Hunters
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight – and the spoils of victory.

fields.title: Orkjäger
fields.lore: Zum Kämpfen geboren, leben Saurons Soldaten für die Aufregung der Schlacht – und für die Siegesbeute.

fields.title: Cazadores Orcos
fields.lore: Criados para la batalla, los soldados de Sauron viven por la emoción de la batalla – y por el saqueo de los vencedores.

fields.title: Chasseurs Orques
fields.lore: Élevés pour la bataille, les soldats de Sauron vivent pour le frisson du combat – et le butin de la victoire.

fields.title: Cacciatori Orchi
fields.lore: Generati per combattere, i soldati di Sauron vivono per il brivido della lotta – e i guadagni della vittoria.

cards.title: Orc Inquisitor
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
cards.lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

fields.title: Orc Inquisitor
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
fields.lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Ork Inquisitor
fields.lore: Gemeine Folterknechte Mordors entrissen dem armen Gollum die Information, dass das, was Sauron am meisten begehrt, wiedergefunden worden war.

fields.title: Inquisidores Orcos
fields.lore: Los crueles interrogadores de Mordor arrancaron el secreto del pobre Gollum, que la posesión mas preciada de Sauron se había hallado de nuevo.

fields.title: Inquisiteur Orque
fields.lore: Les inquisiteurs du Mordor extirpèrent le secret du pauvre Gollum: le bien le plus précieux de Sauron avait été trouvé une fois de plus.

fields.title: Orco Inquisitore
fields.lore: I crudeli inquisitori di Mordor estirparono dal povero Gollum il segreto: il bene più prezioso di Sauron era stato ritrovato ancora una volta.

cards.title: Orc Scimitar
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).
cards.lore: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.

fields.title: Orc Scimitar
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).
fields.lore: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.

fields.title: Orkkrummsäbel
fields.lore: Die Waffe eines Orks spiegelt seine Begeisterung für Mord und Totschlag wieder.

fields.title: Cimitarra Orca
fields.lore: El arma de un Orco refleja su pasión por la guerra y la crueldad.

fields.title: Cimeterre Orque
fields.lore: Une arme d'Orque reflète sa passion pour la guerre et la cruauté.

fields.title: Scimitarra degli Orchi
fields.lore: L'arma di un Orco riflette la sua passione per la guerra e la crudeltà.

cards.title: Orc Scouting Band
cards.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
cards.lore: The cunning Ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.

fields.title: Orc Scouting Band
fields.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
fields.lore: The cunning Ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.

fields.title: Ork Spähtrupp
fields.lore: Die geschickt gelegten Hinterhalte der Orks basieren darauf, dass Späher zuerst den Feind entdecken.

fields.title: Partida de Orcos
fields.lore: Las astutas emboscadas de los ejércitos Orcos dependen en los exploradores que encuentran al enemigo.

fields.title: Éclaireurs Orques
fields.lore: Les embuscades sournoises des armées Orques dépendent principalement d'éclaireurs capables de repérer l'ennemi.

cards.title: Orc Soldier
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.

fields.title: Orc Soldier
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.

fields.title: Ork Soldat
fields.lore: Mit grausamen Schwertern bewaffnete Orks strömen aus Mordor heraus, um dem Auge zu dienen.

fields.title: Soldado Orco
fields.lore: Llevando armas crueles, los Orcos cargan por Mordor para servir al Ojo.

fields.title: Soldat Orque
fields.lore: Porteurs d'armes cruelles, les Orques sortent du Mordor pour servir l'*il.

fields.title: Soldato Orco
fields.lore: Impugnando armi spietate, gli Orchi uscirono da Mordor per servire l'Occhio.

cards.title: Orc War Band
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
cards.lore: Sauron has countless armies of Orcs at his disposal.

fields.title: Orc War Band
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
fields.lore: Sauron has countless armies of Orcs at his disposal.

fields.title: Ork Kriegstrupp
fields.lore: Sauron stehen unzählige Orkarmeen zur Verfügung.

fields.title: Partida de Guerra Orca
fields.lore: Sauron tiene incontables ejércitos de Orcos a su disposición.

fields.title: Troupe de Guerre Orque
fields.lore: Sauron a des armées innombrables d'Orques à sa disposition.

fields.title: Banda di Orchi
fields.lore: Sauron ha innumerevoli armate di Orchi a sua disposizione.

cards.title: The Ring's Oppression
cards.gameText: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc kills a companion, add 1 burden (or 3 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
cards.lore: “The Ring that hung upon its chain about his neck grew heavy, heavier than a great stone, and his head was dragged downwards.”

fields.title: The Ring's Oppression
fields.gameText: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc kills a companion, add 1 burden (or 3 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
fields.lore: “The Ring that hung upon its chain about his neck grew heavy, heavier than a great stone, and his head was dragged downwards.”

fields.title: Die Last des Rings
fields.lore: Der Ring, der an seiner Kette um seinen Hals hing, wurde schwer, schwerer als ein großer Stein, und Frodos Kopf wurde nach unten gezogen.

fields.title: La Opresión del Anillo
fields.lore: “El Anillo que le colgaba del cuello se hizo pesado, mas pesado que una gran piedra, y lo obligo a inclinar la cabeza sobre el pecho.”

fields.title: L'Accablement de l'Anneau
fields.lore: “L'Anneau, suspendu à son cou au bout de la petite chaîne, se faisait lourd, plus lourd qu'une grosse pierre, et sa tête était tirée vers le bas.”

fields.title: L'Oppressione dell'Anello
fields.lore: “L'Anello appeso alla catenella intorno al collo divenne pesante, più pesante di un grosso sasso, e trascinava la sua testa verso il basso.”

cards.title: Sauron's Defenses
cards.gameText: To play, exert [SAURON] a Orc. Plays to your support area. While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
cards.lore: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.

fields.title: Sauron's Defenses
fields.gameText: To play, exert [SAURON] a Orc. Plays to your support area. While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
fields.lore: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.

fields.title: Saurons Verteidiger
fields.lore: Saurons Schergen sind überall. Nur wenige Pfade entgehen dem wachsamen Blick des Lidlosen Auges.

fields.title: Las Defensas de Sauron
fields.lore: Los siervos de Sauron están en todas partes. Pocos caminos escapan de la mirada del Ojo sin Párpado.

fields.title: Les Défenses de Sauron
fields.lore: Les séides de Sauron sont partout. Peu de routes échappent au regard de l'*il sans Paupière.

fields.title: Difese di Sauron
fields.lore: I servi di Sauron sono ovunque. Poche strade sfuggono allo sguardo dell'Occhio Senza Palpebre.

cards.title: Seeking It Always
cards.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert a [SAURON] tracker to cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'”

fields.title: Seeking It Always
fields.gameText: Search. Plays to your support area. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert a [SAURON] tracker to cancel that event.
fields.lore: “‘...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'”

fields.title: Stetig auf der Suche
fields.lore: "Doch der einzige Maßstab, den er kennt, ist Begehren, das Streben nach Macht, und danach beurteilt er alle Herzen.“

fields.title: Siempre Buscándolo
fields.lore: “Pero la única medida que conoce es el deseo, deseo de poder, y así juzga todos los corazones.”

fields.title: Toujours à sa Recherche
fields.lore: “‘...la seule mesure qu'il connaisse est le désir, le désir du pouvoir ; et c'est ainsi qu'il juge tous les c*urs.'”

fields.title: Cercandolo Sempre
fields.lore: “‘...l'unica misura che conosce è il desiderio, desiderio di potere, ed egli giudica tutti i cuori alla stessa stregua.'”

cards.title: Seeking Its Master
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and remove (2) to draw a card.
cards.lore: “‘This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'”

fields.title: Seeking Its Master
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and remove (2) to draw a card.
fields.lore: “‘This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'”

fields.title: Sehnsucht nach seinem Herrn
fields.lore: "Das wenigstens ist klar: das Böse des Rings wirkt sich sogar schon auf den Bund aus, und der Ring muss die Gefährten verlassen, ehe er mehr Unheil stiftet.“

fields.title: Buscando a Su Amo
fields.lore: “Esto al menos ya esta claro: la malignidad del Anillo ya esta operando, aun en la Compañía, y antes que haga mas dalo hay que llevarlo lejos.”

fields.title: À la Recherche de son Maître
fields.lore: “‘Une chose au moins est claire: la nocivité de l'Anneau est déjà à l'*uvre même dans la compagnie, et il doit la quitter avant de commettre davantage de méfaits.'”

fields.title: Cercando il Suo Padrone
fields.lore: “‘Una cosa perlomeno è palese: la malvagità dell'Anello sta incominciando a intaccare persino l'integrità della Compagnia; è indispensabile che l'Anello si allontani da loro, prima che la situazione peggiori.'”

cards.title: Shadow's Reach
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.
cards.lore: “‘Is it secret? Is it safe?'”

fields.title: Shadow's Reach
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.
fields.lore: “‘Is it secret? Is it safe?'”

fields.title: Der lange Arm des Schattens
fields.lore: "Ist er versteckt? Ist er sicher?“

fields.title: El Alcance de La Sombra
fields.lore: “¿Esta en un lugar secreto? ¿Esta seguro?”

fields.title: L'Emprise de l'Ombre
fields.lore: “‘Est-il caché ? Est-il en sécurité ?'”

fields.title: Portata dell'Ombra
fields.lore: “‘È nascosto? È in salvo?'”

cards.title: Strength Born of Fear
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +1.
cards.lore: Fear of death in Barad-dûr's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.

fields.title: Strength Born of Fear
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +1.
fields.lore: Fear of death in Barad-dûr's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.

fields.title: Angst verleiht Kraft
fields.lore: Die Furcht vor dem Tod in den Verliesen Barad-dûrs spornt Mordors Diener zu noch größerer Wildheit an.

fields.title: Fuerza Nacida del Miedo
fields.lore: El miedo a la muerte en los calabozos de Barad-dûr incita a los servidores de mordor a mayor salvajismo.

fields.title: Force Née de la Peur
fields.lore: La peur de mourir dans les fosses de Barad-dûr pousse les serviteurs du Mordor à la plus grande sauvagerie.

fields.title: Forza Nata dalla Paura
fields.lore: La paura della morte nei sotterranei di Barad-dûr sprona i servi di Mordor a crudeltà persino più grandi.

cards.title: Thin and Stretched
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).
cards.lore: “‘I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'”

fields.title: Thin and Stretched
fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).
fields.lore: “‘I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'”

fields.title: Dünn und ausgemergelt
fields.lore: "Ich bin alt, Gandalf. Man sieht es mir nicht an...“

fields.title: Flaco y Estirado
fields.lore: “Estoy viejo, Gandalf; no lo parezco...”

fields.title: Maigre et Détiré
fields.lore: “‘Je suis vieux, Gandalf. Je ne le semble pas....'”

fields.title: Magro e Teso
fields.lore: “‘Sono vecchio, Gandalf. Non dimostro i miei anni....'”

cards.title: Tower Lieutenant
cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
cards.lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

fields.title: Tower Lieutenant
fields.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
fields.lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

fields.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Leutnant des Turms
fields.lore: Saurons Wohlwollen gilt denen in seinen Verliesen, die den Ehrgeiz haben, den an den Grenzen seines Reichs gefangenen Spionen Informationen zu entlocken.

fields.title: Teniente de La Torre
fields.lore: Sauron demuestra su favor hacia aquellos en sus mazmorras con la ambición de exprimir la información que él necesita de esos espías atrapados en sus fronteras.

fields.title: Lieutenant de la Tour
fields.lore: Sauron se montre favorable envers ceux dans ses fosses dont l'ambition est d'extorquer les informations dont il a besoin à ceux pris à explorer ses frontières.

fields.title: Luogotenente
fields.lore: Sauron mostra benevolenza verso quelli con l'ambizione di estorcere, nei suoi sotterranei, le informazioni di cui ha bisogno da chi è stato sorpreso a spiare fuori dai suoi confini.

cards.title: Under the Watching Eye
cards.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] tracker. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
cards.lore: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.

fields.title: Under the Watching Eye
fields.gameText: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] tracker. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
fields.lore: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.

fields.title: Unter wachsamenen Blicken
fields.lore: Was den Blicken des Lidlosen Auges entgeht, wird von seinen zahllosen Dienern beobachtet und berichtet.

fields.title: Bajo El Ojo Vigilante
fields.lore: Lo que el Ojo sin Párpado de Sauron no ve, lo observan e informan de ello sus incontables siervos.

fields.title: Sous le Regard Vigilant
fields.lore: Ce que l'*il sans Paupière de Sauron ne voit pas, ses séides innombrables l'observent et le rapportent.

fields.title: Sotto lo Sguardo dell'Occhio
fields.lore: Quello che l'Occhio Senza Palpebre di Sauron non vede, i suoi innumerevoli servi osservano e riferiscono.

cards.title: The Weight of a Legacy
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on Aragorn.
cards.lore: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

fields.title: The Weight of a Legacy
fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on Aragorn.
fields.lore: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a [GONDOR] companion.  Limit 1 per bearer.  While you can spot 2 tales, bearer is strength -2.

fields.title: Die Last des Vermächtnisses
fields.lore: "Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass der Ring die Zeit überdauert...Ich war dort, als die Stärke der Menschen versagte.“

fields.title: El Peso de un Legado
fields.lore: “Es por los Hombres, que el Anillo sobrevive... Yo estaba allí el día que la fuerza de los Hombres fallo.”

fields.title: Le Poids d'un Héritage
fields.lore: “‘C'est la faute des Hommes si l'Anneau existe encore.... J'étais là le jour où la force des Hommes faillit.'”

fields.title: Il Peso Di Un'Eredità
fields.lore: “‘E' a causa degli Uomini che l'Anello sopravvive .... Io c'ero il giorno in cui la forza degli Uomini fallì.'”

cards.title: You Bring Great Evil
cards.gameText: To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion (except an Elf). While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.
cards.lore: “‘And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'”

fields.title: You Bring Great Evil
fields.gameText: To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion (except an Elf). While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.
fields.lore: “‘And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'”

fields.title: Du trägst großes Übel in dir
fields.lore: "Das ist nicht gut. Seit den Dunklen Tagen haben wir nichts mehr mit den Zwergen zu tun gehabt.“

fields.title: Traes un Gran Mal
fields.lore: “¿Que es esto? No tenemos tratos con los Enanos desde los Días Oscuros.”

fields.title: Vous Apportez le Grand Mal
fields.lore: “‘Et qu'est-ce ? Nous n'avons pas eu de rapports avec les Nains depuis les Jours Sombres.'”

fields.title: Tu Porti Una Grande Sventura
fields.lore: “‘E chi è questo? Non trattiamo con i Nani sin dai Giorni Oscuri.'”

cards.title: Bilbo
cards.subtitle: Retired Adventurer
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to shuffle a [SHIRE] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'”

fields.title: Bilbo
fields.subtitle: Retired Adventurer
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to shuffle a [SHIRE] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'”

fields.subtitle: Abenteurer im Ruhestand
fields.lore: "Immerhin glaube ich nicht, dass mir genug Kraft oder Glück geblieben ist, um mit dem Ring fertigzuwerden. Er ist gewachsen und ich nicht.“

fields.subtitle: Aventurero Retirado
fields.lore: “...no creo que me quede bastante fuerza o suerte como para tratar con el Anillo. Ha crecido, y yo no.”

fields.title: Bilbon
fields.subtitle: Aventurier Retraité
fields.lore: “‘...je suppose qu'il ne me reste plus assez de force ou de chance pour m'occuper de l'Anneau. Il a grandi, et moi pas.'”

fields.subtitle: Avventuriero a Riposo
fields.lore: “‘...Suppongo che non ho più forza e fortuna sufficienti per trattare con l'Anello. Esso è cresciuto, e io no.'”

cards.title: Bilbo's Pipe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.
cards.lore: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.

fields.title: Bilbo's Pipe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.
fields.lore: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.

fields.title: Bilbos Pfeife
fields.lore: Bilbo besitzt eine schöne Pfeife, die ihm von seinen Zwergenfreunden gefertigt wurde.

fields.title: La Pipa de Bilbo
fields.lore: Bilbo tiene una buena pipa, hecha por sus amigos enanos para él.

fields.title: Pipe de Bilbon
fields.lore: Bilbon a une magnifique pipe, sculptée pour lui par ses amis Nains.

fields.title: Pipa di Bilbo
fields.lore: Bilbo ha un'eccellente pipa, intagliata per lui dai suo amici Nani.

cards.title: Bounder
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
cards.lore: “‘Aye, reckon we're in for a quiet night... mind how you go.'”

fields.title: Bounder
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
fields.lore: “‘Aye, reckon we're in for a quiet night... mind how you go.'”

fields.title: Nachtwächter
fields.lore: "Aye, ich denke, es wird eine ruhige Nacht...achtet auf den Weg.“

fields.title: Oficial
fields.lore: “Recordad que estamos aquí para pasar una noche tranquila... Cuidado como os marcháis.”

fields.title: Frontalier
fields.lore: “‘Ouais, la nuit s'annonce calme... faites attention à vous.'”

fields.title: Guardafrontiere
fields.lore: “‘Si, calcola che siamo qui per una nottata tranquilla ... io sorveglio in che modo vai.'”

cards.title: Extraordinary Resilience
cards.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.
cards.lore: “‘Don't despair!' said Strider. ‘You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'”

fields.title: Extraordinary Resilience
fields.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.
fields.lore: “‘Don't despair!' said Strider. ‘You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'”

fields.title: Aussergewöhnliche Widerstandskraft
fields.lore: "Verzweifle nicht!“ sagte Streicher. "Du musst mir jetzt vertrauen. Dein Frodo ist aus härterem Holz geschnitzt, als ich vermutet hatte...“

fields.title: Resistencia Extraordinaria
fields.lore: “¡No desesperes! – dijo Trancos –. Confía en mi ahora. Tu Frodo es de una pasta mas firme de lo que yo pensaba...”

fields.title: Résistance Extraordinaire
fields.lore: “‘Ne désespérez pas!' dit Grands-Pas. ‘Il faut me faire confiance, maintenant. Votre Frodon est fait d'une pâte plus ferme que je ne l'avais cru....'”

fields.title: Resistenza Straordinaria
fields.lore: “‘Non disperare!' disse Granpasso. ‘Devi aver fiducia in me, d'ora in poi. Il tuo Frodo è fatto di una pasta più dura di quanto credessi....'”

cards.title: Farmer Maggot
cards.subtitle: Chaser of Rascals
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.
cards.lore: “‘Old Maggot is really a stout fellow – if you leave his mushrooms alone.'”

fields.title: Farmer Maggot
fields.subtitle: Chaser of Rascals
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.
fields.lore: “‘Old Maggot is really a stout fellow – if you leave his mushrooms alone.'”

fields.title: Bauer Maggot
fields.subtitle: Lausbubenschreck
fields.lore: "Der alte Maggot ist wirklich ein Prachtskerl – sofern du seine Pilze in Frieden lässt.“

fields.title: Granjero Maggot
fields.subtitle: Perseguidor de Granujas
fields.lore: “El viejo Maggot es realmente un buen tipo, si dejas sus setas en paz.”

fields.title: Père Maggotte
fields.subtitle: Chasseur de Garnements
fields.lore: “‘Le Vieux Maggotte est vraiment un brave homme – si tu ne touches pas à ses champignons.'”

fields.title: Vecchio Maggot
fields.subtitle: Cacciatore di Birbanti
fields.lore: “‘Il vecchio Maggot è una gran brava persona – se lasci stare i suoi funghi.'”

cards.title: Frodo
cards.subtitle: Old Bilbo's Heir
cards.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). At the start of each of your turns, you may heal a Hobbit ally.
cards.lore: “‘But be that as it may, Mr. Frodo is as nice a young hobbit as you could wish to meet.'”

fields.title: Frodo
fields.subtitle: Old Bilbo's Heir
fields.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). At the start of each of your turns, you may heal a Hobbit ally.
fields.lore: “‘But be that as it may, Mr. Frodo is as nice a young hobbit as you could wish to meet.'”

fields.subtitle: Erbe des alten Bilbo
fields.lore: "Aber sei dem, wie ihm wolle, Herr Frodo ist ein so netter junger Hobbit, wie man ihn sich nur wünschen kann.“

fields.subtitle: El Heredero del Viejo Bilbo
fields.lore: “Pero de cualquier modo el Señor Frodo es un joven Hobbit tan agradable como el que más.”

fields.title: Frodon
fields.subtitle: Héritier du Vieux Bilbon
fields.lore: “‘Mais quoi qu'il en soit, M. Frodon est un jeune Hobbit aussi gentil qu'on pourrait le souhaiter.'”

fields.subtitle: Erede del Vecchio Bilbo
fields.lore: “‘Comunque, di Hobbit gentili come il signor Frodo è difficile incontrarne.'”

cards.title: Frodo
cards.subtitle: Son of Drogo
cards.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Exert another companion who has the Frodo signet to heal Frodo.
cards.lore: “‘I think you'll find there's more to this Hobbit than meets the eye.'”

fields.title: Frodo
fields.subtitle: Son of Drogo
fields.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Exert another companion who has the Frodo signet to heal Frodo.
fields.lore: “‘I think you'll find there's more to this Hobbit than meets the eye.'”

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Drogo
fields.lore: "Ich denke, es steckt mehr in diesem Hobbit, als man sieht.“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Drogo
fields.lore: “Creo que descubrirás que hay mas en este Hobbit de lo que se ve a simple vista.”

fields.title: Frodon
fields.subtitle: Fils de Drogon
fields.lore: “‘Je pense que vous trouverez qu'il y a davantage en ce Hobbit qu'il n'y paraît à première vue.'”

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Drogo
fields.lore: “‘Penso che troverai che c'è molto più in quest'Hobbit di quanto non colpisca la vista.'”

cards.title: The Gaffer
cards.subtitle: Sam's Father
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.
cards.lore: “No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....”

fields.title: The Gaffer
fields.subtitle: Sam's Father
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.
fields.lore: “No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....”

fields.title: Der Ohm
fields.subtitle: Sams Vater
fields.lore: Niemand hatte aufmerksamere Zuhörer als der alte Ham Gamdschie, der landauf, landab als der Ohm bekannt war. Er schwang seine Reden im Efeubusch, einer kleinen Gastwirtschaft an der Wasserauer Strasse; und was er sagte, hatte einiges Gewicht, denn er hatt

fields.title: El Tío
fields.subtitle: El Padre de Sam
fields.lore: “Nadie tuvo auditorio más atento que el viejo Ham Gamyi, conocido comúnmente como El Tío. Contaba sus historias en La Mata de hiedra, una pequeña posada en el camino de Delagua, y hablaba con cierta autoridad, pues había cuidado el jardín de Bolsón Cerrad

fields.title: L'Ancien
fields.subtitle: Père de Sam
fields.lore: “Personne n'eut d'auditoire plus attentif que le vieux Ham Gamegie, communément appelé l'Ancien. Il pérorait au Buisson de Lierre, une petite auberge de la route de Lèzeau, et il parlait avec quelque autorité, car il avait entretenu le jardin de Cul-de-Sa

fields.title: Il Gaffiere
fields.subtitle: Padre di Sam
fields.lore: “Il pubblico più attento era certo quello del vecchio Ham Gamgee detto il Gaffiere, alla piccola osteria l'Edera sulla via di Lungacque. Parlava autorevolmente, essendo stato per quarant'anni il giardiniere di Casa Baggins...”

cards.title: The Gaffer's Pipe
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove (X).
cards.lore: “‘This... is the one art that we certainly claim to be our own invention. When Hobbits first began to smoke is not known....'”

fields.title: The Gaffer's Pipe
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove (X).
fields.lore: “‘This... is the one art that we certainly claim to be our own invention. When Hobbits first began to smoke is not known....'”

fields.title: Die Pfeife des Ohm
fields.lore: "Das... ist die einzige Kunst, von der wir behaupten können, dass wir sie erfunden haben. Wann die Hobbits zuerst mit Rauchen begannen, ist nicht bekannt...“

fields.title: La Pipa del Tío
fields.lore: “Este arte...es el único que podemos reclamar como de invención nuestra. En que época empezaron a fumar los Hobbits es un enigma...”

fields.title: Pipe de l'Ancien
fields.lore: “‘Ceci ... est le seul art que nous réclamons à coup sûr comme étant de notre propre invention. Nous ignorons cependant à quel moment les Hobbits commencèrent à fumer....'”

fields.title: La Pipa del Gaffiere
fields.lore: “‘Questa ... è un'arte che possiamo certo dire di aver inventata noi. Quando gli Hobbit incominciarono a fumare nessuno lo sa...'”

cards.title: Halfling Deftness
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit to make him strength +3.
cards.lore: “...though they are inclined to be fat and do not hurry unnecessarily, they are nonetheless nimble and deft in their movements.”

fields.title: Halfling Deftness
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit to make him strength +3.
fields.lore: “...though they are inclined to be fat and do not hurry unnecessarily, they are nonetheless nimble and deft in their movements.”

fields.title: Halbling Geschick
fields.lore: ...und obwohl sie dazu neigen, Fett anzusetzen und sich nicht unnötigerweise zu beeilen, sind sie dennoch flink und behende in ihren Bewegungen.

fields.title: Destreza de Mediano
fields.lore: “Y aunque engordan fácilmente, y nunca se apresuran si no es necesario, se mueven con agilidad y destreza.”

fields.title: Habileté de Semi-Homme
fields.lore: “...et s'ils ont une tendance à l'embonpoint et ne se pressent pas sans nécessité, ils n'en sont pas moins lestes et adroits dans leurs mouvements.”

fields.title: Destrezza dei Mezzuomini
fields.lore: “...benché tendano a essere grassocci e piuttosto pigri, sono agili e svelti nei movimenti.”

cards.title: Hobbit Appetite
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Add (X) to heal a Hobbit companion X times.
cards.lore: “‘What about Elevenses, Luncheon, Afternoon Tea and Supper – he knows about them, doesn't he?'”

fields.title: Hobbit Appetite
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Add (X) to heal a Hobbit companion X times.
fields.lore: “‘What about Elevenses, Luncheon, Afternoon Tea and Supper – he knows about them, doesn't he?'”

fields.title: Hobbit Appetit
fields.lore: "Was ist mit zweitem Frühstück, Mittagessen, Nachmittagstee und Abendbrot – darüber weiss er doch Bescheid, oder?“

fields.title: Apetito Hobbit
fields.lore: “¿Que hay del desayuno, el almuerzo, el té de la tarde y la cena – los conoce, verdad?”

fields.title: Appétit Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘Et à propos de la collation de 11 heures, du déjeuner, du goûter et du souper – il est au courant, n'est-ce pas ?'”

fields.title: Appetito degli Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘E circa la Prima Colazione, il Pranzo, il Tè del pomeriggio e la Cena – lui li conosce, non è vero?'”

cards.title: Hobbit Farmer
cards.gameText: While you can spot your site 1, this ally has the game text of that site. Fellowship: Exert this ally and spot opponent's site 1 to replace it with your site 1.
cards.lore: “‘...where our hearts truly lie is in peace and quiet and good-tilled earth....'”

fields.title: Hobbit Farmer
fields.gameText: While you can spot your site 1, this ally has the game text of that site. Fellowship: Exert this ally and spot opponent's site 1 to replace it with your site 1.
fields.lore: “‘...where our hearts truly lie is in peace and quiet and good-tilled earth....'”

fields.title: Hobbitbauer
fields.lore: "...unsere Herzen sehnen sich nach Frieden und Ruhe und gut bestellter Erde...“

fields.title: Granjero Hobbit
fields.lore: “... Donde verdaderamente residen nuestros corazones es en la paz y la calma y en la tierra bien arada...”

fields.title: Fermier Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘...le véritable siège du c*ur est la paix, le calme et a terre bien cultivée....'”

fields.title: Contadino Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘... e ciò a cui i nostri cuori invero anelano è la pace e la quiete e un campo ben lavorato....'”

cards.title: Hobbit Intuition
cards.gameText: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 4, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +3.
cards.lore: “‘What? That were just a little detour, that's all... a shortcut.'”

fields.title: Hobbit Intuition
fields.gameText: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 4, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +3.
fields.lore: “‘What? That were just a little detour, that's all... a shortcut.'”

fields.title: Hobbit Eingebung
fields.lore: "Was denn? Das war nur ein kleiner Ausflug... eine Abkürzung.“

fields.title: Intuición Hobbit
fields.lore: “Debo dejar la Comarca... Sam y yo debemos ir a Bree.”

fields.title: Intuition Hobbite
fields.lore: “‘Quoi ? C'était seulement un petit détour, c'est tout ... un raccourci.'”

fields.title: Intuito degli Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘Cosa? Quella è stata solo una piccola deviazione, è tutto ... una scorciatoia.'”

cards.title: Hobbit Party Guest
cards.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal this ally. Fellowship: Exert this ally to heal another Hobbit ally whose home is site 1.
cards.lore: “‘More promising still (to the hobbits' mind): an enourmous open-air kitchen was erected....'”

fields.title: Hobbit Party Guest
fields.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, heal this ally. Fellowship: Exert this ally to heal another Hobbit ally whose home is site 1.
