fields.lore: “‘More promising still (to the hobbits' mind): an enourmous open-air kitchen was erected....'”

fields.title: Hobbit Partygast
fields.lore: Noch verheissungsvoller war (nach Ansicht der Hobbits) eine riesige Küche, die in... unter freiem Himmel aufgebaut wurde.

fields.title: Invitado a La Fiesta Hobbit
fields.lore: “Aun algo mas promisorio para la mentalidad hobbit: se levanto una enorme cocina al aire libre...”

fields.title: Invité de la Fête Hobbite
fields.lore: “‘Une chose était plus prometteuse encore (dans l'esprit d'un Hobbit): une énorme cuisine en plein air fut érigée....'”

fields.title: Hobbit Ospite della Festa
fields.lore: “‘Fatto ancora più promettente (per gli Hobbit), fu installata un'enorme cucina all'aria aperta ....'”

cards.title: Hobbit Stealth
cards.gameText: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 5, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +2.
cards.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by....”

fields.title: Hobbit Stealth
fields.gameText: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 5, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +2.
fields.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by....”

fields.title: Heimliche Hobbits
fields.lore: Von Anfang an beherrschten sie die Kunst, rasch und geräuschlos zu verschwinden, wenn große Leute, denen sie nicht begegnen wollen, dahertrapsen...

fields.title: Sigilo Hobbit
fields.lore: “Dominaron desde un principio el arte de desaparecer rápido y en silencio, cuando la gente grande con la que no querían tropezar se les acercaba casualmente...”

fields.title: Ruse Hobbite
fields.lore: “Ils ont toujours eu l'art de disparaître rapidement et en silence quand de Grandes Gens qu'ils ne désirent pas rencontrer viennent par hasard de leur côté....”

fields.title: Segretezza degli Hobbit
fields.lore: “Sin dal principio possedevano l'arte di sparire velocemente e silenziosi al sopraggiungere di genti che non desideravano incontrare....”

cards.title: Hobbit Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
cards.lore: “‘Strap these on....'”

fields.title: Hobbit Sword
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
fields.lore: “‘Strap these on....'”

fields.title: Hobbitschwert
fields.lore: "Legt euch diese an...“

fields.title: Espada Hobbit
fields.lore: “Ceñios estas...”

fields.title: Épée Hobbite
fields.lore: “‘Prenez ceci....'”

fields.title: Spada degli Hobbit
fields.lore: “‘Legala alla cinghia....'”

cards.title: Longbottom Leaf
cards.gameText: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand.
cards.lore: Longbottom Leaf is the pipeweed enjoyed by most Hobbits throughout the Shire.

fields.lore: Longbottom Leaf is the pipeweed enjoyed by most Hobbits throughout the Shire.

fields.title: Langgrundblatt
fields.lore: Langgrundblatt ist das am meisten gerauchte Pfeifenkraut im Auenland.

fields.title: Hoja Valle Largo
fields.lore: La Hoja Valle Largo es la hierba para pipa que disfrutan la mayoría de Hobbits a lo largo de la Comarca.

fields.title: Feuille de Longoulet
fields.lore: La Feuille de Longoulet est l'herbe à pipe appréciée par la plupart des Hobbits de la Comté.

fields.title: Erba di Pianilungone
fields.lore: L'erba di Pianilungone è l'erba pipa preferita dalla maggioranza degli Hobbit, dovunque nella Contea.

cards.title: Master Proudfoot
cards.subtitle: Distant Relative of Bilbo
cards.gameText: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add (2) to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all [SHIRE] cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
cards.lore: “His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....”

fields.title: Master Proudfoot
fields.subtitle: Distant Relative of Bilbo
fields.gameText: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add (2) to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all [SHIRE] cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
fields.lore: “His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....”

fields.title: Meister Stolzfuß
fields.subtitle: Verwandter von Bilbo
fields.lore: Sein Name war natürlich Stolzfuß und wohlverdient; seine Füsse waren groß und aussergewöhnlich pelzig...

fields.title: Maestro Ganapié
fields.subtitle: Familiar Distante de Bilbo
fields.lore: “Tenia en verdad el nombre que merecía. Los pies, que había puesto sobre la mesa, eran grandes y excepcionalmente velludos.”

fields.title: Maître Fierpied
fields.subtitle: Parent Éloigné de Bilbon
fields.lore: “Il s'appelait Fierpied, bien entendu, et il méritait bien son nom: ses pieds étaient grands, exceptionnellement velus....”

fields.title: Signor Tronfipiede
fields.subtitle: Parente alla Lontana di Bilbo
fields.lore: “Il suo cognome era beninteso Tronfipiede, e a buon diritto: i suoi piedi erano enormi, straordinariamente pelosi...”

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: Friend to Sam
cards.gameText: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him twice to add his strength to another companion.
cards.lore: “‘We're coming too! You'll have to send us home tied up in a sack to stop us!'”

fields.title: Merry
fields.subtitle: Friend to Sam
fields.gameText: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him twice to add his strength to another companion.
fields.lore: “‘We're coming too! You'll have to send us home tied up in a sack to stop us!'”

fields.subtitle: Sams Freund
fields.lore: "Wir kommen auch mit. Um uns daran zu hindern, werdet ihr uns in einen Sack verschnürt heimschicken müssen.“

fields.subtitle: Amigo de Sam
fields.lore: “¡Nosotros también venimos! ¡Tendrás que mandarnos a casa atados dentro de un saco para detenernos!”

fields.subtitle: Ami de Sam
fields.lore: “‘Nous venons aussi ! Tu devras nous renvoyer chez nous ficelés dans un sac pour nous arrêter !'”

fields.subtitle: Amico di Sam
fields.lore: “‘Veniamo anche noi! Dovresti spedirci a casa legati in un sacco per fermarci!'”

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
cards.gameText: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

fields.title: Merry
fields.subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
fields.gameText: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

fields.title: Merry
fields.subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
fields.gameText: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Merry to make him strength +1 for each hand weapon you can spot (limit +3).

fields.subtitle: von jenseits des Brandywein
fields.lore: "Ich weiss gar nicht, warum er sich so aufregt, es sind doch nur ein paar Mohrrüben... ich finde, er übertreibt.“

fields.subtitle: de Ma' Allá del Brandivino
fields.lore: “No sé porque esta tan enfadado, solo son un puñado de zanahorias... Mi opinión es, se esta pasando.”

fields.subtitle: De par le Brandevin
fields.lore: “‘Je ne sais pas pourquoi il est si fâché, ce ne sont que quelques carottes ... mon avis est qu'il réagit de manière excessive.'”

fields.subtitle: Da Oltre il Brandivino
fields.lore: “‘Non lo so perché è così sconvolto, sono solo poche carote ... secondo me reagisce esageratamente.'”

cards.title: Noble Intentions
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.
cards.lore: “‘You carry the fate of us all, little one.... If this is indeed the will of the Council, then Gondor will see it done.'”

fields.title: Noble Intentions
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.
fields.lore: “‘You carry the fate of us all, little one.... If this is indeed the will of the Council, then Gondor will see it done.'”

fields.title: Noble Absichten
fields.lore: "Du trägst unser aller Schicksal mit dir, kleiner Mann... Wenn dies nun der Wille des Rates ist, wird Gondor dafür sorgen, dass es so geschieht.“

fields.title: Intenciones Nobles
fields.lore: “Llevas nuestro destino, pequeño... Si esa es la voluntad del Concilio, Gondor hará que se cumpla.”

fields.title: Nobles Intentions
fields.lore: “‘Vous portez notre destin à tous, petit être.... Si c'est vraiment la volonté du Conseil, alors le Gondor l'acceptera.'”

fields.title: Nobili Intenzioni
fields.lore: “‘Tu sostieni il peso del destino di tutti noi, piccolino... Se questo è veramente il volere del Consiglio, allora Gondor lo vedrà realizzato.'”

cards.title: Old Toby
cards.gameText: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
cards.lore: Bilbo's favorite pipeweed is Old Toby, the finest weed in the Southfarthing.

fields.title: Old Toby
fields.gameText: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
fields.lore: Bilbo's favorite pipeweed is Old Toby, the finest weed in the Southfarthing.

fields.title: Alter Tobi
fields.lore: Bilbos bevorzugtes Pfeifenkraut ist Alter Tobi, das beste Kraut im Südviertel.

fields.title: Viejo Toby
fields.lore: La hierba para pipa favorita de Bilbo es Viejo Toby, la mejor hierba de la Cuaderna del Sur.

fields.title: Vieux Tobie
fields.lore: L'herbe à pipe favorite de Bilbon est celle du Vieux Tobie, la meilleure herbe du Quartier Sud.

fields.title: Vecchio Tobia
fields.lore: L'erba pipa favorita da Bilbo è la Vecchio Tobia, l'erba più squisita del Decumano del Sud.

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Friend to Frodo
cards.gameText: Your opponent may not discard your [SHIRE] tales from play.
cards.lore: “‘Baggins? Sure I know a Baggins – Frodo's my second cousin once-removed, on his mother's side and my third cousin twice-removed on his father's side, if you follow me.'”

fields.title: Pippin
fields.subtitle: Friend to Frodo
fields.gameText: Your opponent may not discard your [SHIRE] tales from play.
fields.lore: “‘Baggins? Sure I know a Baggins – Frodo's my second cousin once-removed, on his mother's side and my third cousin twice-removed on his father's side, if you follow me.'”

fields.subtitle: Frodos Freund
fields.lore: "Beutlin? Sicher kenne ich einen Beutlin – Frodo ist mein Vetter zweiten Grades mütterlicherseits und mein Cousin dritten Grades väterlicherseits, wenn ihr mir folgen könnt.“

fields.subtitle: Amigo de Frodo
fields.lore: “¿Bolsón? Claro que conozco un Bolsón – Frodo es mi segundo primo primero, por parte de madre y mi tercer primo segundo por parte de padre, si me sigue.”

fields.subtitle: Ami de Frodon
fields.lore: “‘Sacquet ? Sûr que je connais un Sacquet – Frodon est mon cousin issu de germain, du côté de sa mère et mon cousin deux fois issu de germain du côté de son père, si vous me suivez.'”

fields.title: Pipino
fields.subtitle: Amico di Frodo
fields.lore: “‘Baggins? Certo conosco un Baggins – Frodo è il mio secondo cugino di primo grado, e dalla parte di madre è il mio terzo cugino di secondo grado, se mi segui.'”

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
cards.gameText: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or wound from a companion.
cards.lore: “‘Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'”

fields.title: Pippin
fields.subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
fields.gameText: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or wound from a companion.
fields.lore: “‘Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'”

fields.subtitle: Hobbit von gewisser Intelligenz
fields.lore: "Wie dem auch sei, man braucht Leute mit Verstand für diese Abenteuer – was auch immer Geschichte!“

fields.subtitle: Hobbit de Cierta Inteligencia
fields.lore: “De todos modos, necesitas gente de inteligencia en este tipo de misión... búsqueda... cosa.”

fields.subtitle: Hobbit Presque Intelligent
fields.lore: “‘De toute façon, vous avez besoin de personnes intelligentes pour cette sorte de mission ... quête ... chose.'”

fields.title: Pipino
fields.subtitle: Hobbit Assai Intelligente
fields.lore: “‘ad ogni modo, ti servono persone intelligenti per questa sorta di missione... impresa... cosa.'”

cards.title: Power According to His Stature
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Add 1 burden to wound each minion skirmishing the Ring-bearer.
cards.lore: “‘The ring had given him power according to his stature.'”

fields.title: Power According to His Stature
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Add 1 burden to wound each minion skirmishing the Ring-bearer.
fields.lore: “‘The ring had given him power according to his stature.'”

fields.title: Macht entsprechend seiner Veranlagung
fields.lore: "Der Ring hatte ihm Macht gegeben entsprechend seiner Veranlagung.“

fields.title: Poder de Acuerdo Con Su Estatura
fields.lore: “El Anillo le había dado poder, de acuerdo con su talla...”

fields.title: Un Pouvoir Proportionnel à sa Stature
fields.lore: “‘L'anneau lui avait donné un pouvoir proportionné à sa stature.'”

fields.title: Potere Proporzionato alla Sua Statura
fields.lore: “‘L'anello gli aveva conferito un potere proporzionato alla sua statura .'”

cards.title: Rosie Cotton
cards.subtitle: Hobbiton Lass
cards.gameText: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie Cotton to heal Sam.
cards.lore: “‘Go on Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.'”

fields.title: Rosie Cotton
fields.subtitle: Hobbiton Lass
fields.gameText: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie to heal Sam.
fields.lore: “‘Go on Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.'”

fields.gameText: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie Cotton to heal Sam.

fields.title: Rosie Hüttinger
fields.subtitle: Mädchen aus Hobbingen
fields.lore: "Komm schon, Sam. Frag Rosie, ob sie mit dir tanzt.“

fields.title: Rosita Coto
fields.subtitle: Muchacha de Hobbiton
fields.lore: “Venga Sam, pídele a Rosita un baile.”

fields.title: Rose Chaumine
fields.subtitle: Jeune Fille de Hobbitebourg
fields.lore: “‘Allez Sam, demande à Rose une danse.'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Faithful Companion
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Play Bill the Pony from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
cards.lore: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

fields.title: Sam
fields.subtitle: Faithful Companion
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Play Bill the Pony from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
fields.lore: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

fields.title: Sam
fields.subtitle: Faithful Companion
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam to take a [SHIRE] item into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

fields.subtitle: Treuer Gefährte
fields.lore: "Damit das klar is', ohne mich geht Herr Frodo nirgendwo hin!“

fields.subtitle: Compañero Fiel
fields.lore: “¡El Señor Frodo no irá a ninguna parte sin mi!”

fields.subtitle: Fidèle Compagnon
fields.lore: “‘M. Frodon n'ira nulle part sans moi !'”

fields.subtitle: Fedele Compagno
fields.lore: “‘Il Signor Frodo non andrà da nessuna parte senza di me!'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Son of Hamfast
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
cards.lore: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

fields.title: Sam
fields.subtitle: Son of Hamfast
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
fields.lore: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Sam and another companion to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

Fellowship: Exert Sam and another companion to remove a burden. Then, exert Sam again unless you can spot 2 [SHIRE] allies (or Rosie Cotton). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Hamfast
fields.lore: "Oh, ich hielt noch nie die Hand eines Mädchens...ich denke, lieber werd' ich noch'n Bier trinken.“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Hamfast
fields.lore: “Oh, nunca le sujete antes la mano a una chica. Yo... Creo que me tomare otra cerveza.”

fields.subtitle: Fils de Hamfast
fields.lore: “‘Oh, je n'ai jamais tenu la main d'une fille auparavant. Je ... Je pense que je devrais seulement reprendre une choppe.'”

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Hamfast
fields.lore: “‘Oh, io non ho mai sostenuto la mano di una ragazza prima. Io ... Io penso che potrei prendermi un'altra birra chiara.'”

cards.title: Sorry About Everything
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.
cards.lore: “‘I am sorry that I brought this upon you... sorry you must carry this burden.'”

fields.title: Sorry About Everything
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.
fields.lore: “‘I am sorry that I brought this upon you... sorry you must carry this burden.'”

fields.title: Das alles tut mir wirklich leid
fields.lore: "Es tut mir leid, dir dies alles aufgebürdet zu haben... es tut mir leid, dass du diese Last nun tragen musst.“

fields.title: Perdón por Todo
fields.lore: “Lamento haberte metido en esto... lamento que tengas que llevar esta carga.”

fields.title: Désolé pour Tout
fields.lore: “‘Je suis désolé de t'avoir apporté cela... désolé que tu doives porter ce fardeau.'”

fields.title: Scusa per Tutto
fields.lore: “‘Mi dispiace di aver attirato questo su di te ... mi dispiace che tu debba portare questo fardello.'”

cards.title: Sting
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (4)).
cards.lore: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

fields.title: Sting
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (4)).
fields.lore: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

fields.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (2)).

fields.title: Stich
fields.lore: "Das ist Stich... Nimm es, wenn du magst.“

fields.title: Dardo
fields.lore: “Esta es Dardo... Tómala, si quieres.”

fields.title: Dard
fields.lore: “‘Voici Dard.... Prends-la, si tu veux.'”

fields.title: Pungolo
fields.lore: “‘Questo è Pungolo.... Prendilo, se vuoi.'”

cards.title: Stone Trolls
cards.gameText: Tale. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character. Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.
cards.lore: ‘“For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins, / ‘I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'”

fields.title: Stone Trolls
fields.gameText: Tale. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character. Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.
fields.lore: ‘“For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins, / ‘I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'”

fields.title: Steintrolle
fields.lore: "Gib nicht so an“, sagt Troll, "lieber Mann, Ich mach' mich gleich an dich selber ran! Solch frisches Gericht hatt' ich lange nicht...“

fields.title: Trolls de Piedra
fields.lore: “‘Un poco mas', dijo el Troll sonriendo, ‘y a ti también te comeré y roeré las tibias. ¡Un bocado de carne fresca me caerá bien!”

fields.title: Trolls de Pierre
fields.lore: ‘“Pour un peu,' dit Troll avec une grimace, / ‘Je te mangerais aussi et rongerais tes tibias. / Un bout de viande fraîche serait un délice !'”

fields.title: Troll di Pietra
fields.lore: ‘“Ho una buona idea,' disse il viandante sghignazzando / ‘Ora mangio anche te, e il tuo stinco masticando. / Infine un po' di carne fresca potrò assaporare!'”

cards.title: Stout and Sturdy
cards.gameText: Maneuver or Skirmish: Heal a Hobbit.
cards.lore: “‘You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'”

fields.title: Stout and Sturdy

fields.lore: “‘You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'”

fields.title: Beherzt und robust
fields.lore: "Du hast ein wackeres Herz, kleiner Hobbit. Aber das wird dich nicht retten.“

fields.title: Fornido y Recio
fields.lore: “Tienes un corazón firme, pequeño hobbit, pero solo tu valor no te salvara.”

fields.title: Solide et Robuste
fields.lore: “‘Vous avez le c*ur solide, petit Hobbit, mais votre courage seul ne vous sauvera pas.'”

fields.title: Coraggioso e Forte
fields.lore: “‘Hai un cuore coraggioso, piccolo hobbit, ma il tuo coraggio da solo non ti salverà.'”

cards.title: A Talent for Not Being Seen
cards.gameText: Stealth. To play, exert a Hobbit. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the shadow number -1 (or spot 4 to make it -2).
cards.lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

fields.title: Eine Begabung, ungesehen zu bleiben
fields.lore: Ihre geringe Körpergröße erlaubt es Hobbits, sich in kleinsten Löchern zu verstecken und ihre Spuren sind schwer zu finden.

fields.title: Talento para No Ser Visto
fields.lore: Con su pequeño tamaño, los Hobbits usan cualquier hueco para esconderse, y su rastro es difícil de detectar.

fields.title: Un Don pour ne pas Être Vu
fields.lore: Avec leur petite taille, les Hobbits utilisent n'importe quel trou pour s'y cacher, et leur piste est difficile à remarquer.

fields.title: Un Talento per Non Essere Visto
fields.lore: Con la loro piccola taglia, gli Hobbit usano qualsiasi buco come nascondiglio, e le loro tracce sono difficili da notare.

cards.title: There and Back Again

cards.lore: “‘So there I was – at the mercy of three monstrous trolls....'”

fields.title: Hin und wieder zurück
fields.lore: "Da war ich nun – der Gnade dreier riesiger Trolle ausgeliefert...“

fields.title: De Una Ida y Una Vuelta
fields.lore: “Y ahí estaba yo – a merced de tres monstruosos Trolls...”

fields.title: Histoire d'un Aller et Retour
fields.lore: Man*uvre: Défaussez cette situation pour donner à chaque compagnon Hobbit +2 en force jusqu'à la phase de ralliement.

fields.title: Di Là e Indietro di Nuovo
fields.lore: “‘Così io ero là – in balia di tre mostruosi Troll...'”

cards.lore: Bilbo still keeps a map of Erebor, the Lonely Mountain, as a memento of his journey with the Dwarves many years ago.

fields.subtitle: Der Graue
fields.lore: ...aber sein langes weisses Haar, sein wallender Silberbart und seine breiten Schultern liessen ihn wie einen weisen König aus einer alten Sage erscheinen.

fields.subtitle: El Mago Gris
fields.lore: “...la larga melena blanca, la abundante barba gris, y los anchos hombros, le daban un aspecto de rey sabio, salido de antiguas leyendas.”

fields.subtitle: Le Magicien Gris
fields.lore: “...ses longs cheveux blancs, son abondante barbe grise et ses larges épaules lui donnaient l'air de quelque roi sage des légendes anciennes.”

fields.subtitle: Lo Stregone Grigio
fields.lore: "...ina la lunga chioma bianca, la folta barba d'argento e le spalle possenti facevano pensare a qualche saggio re delle leggende."

fields.subtitle: König im Exil
fields.lore: "Er hat sich von diesem Weg vor langer Zeit abgewandt. Und sich für das Exil entschieden.“

fields.subtitle: Rey En El Exilio
fields.lore: “Abandonó ese camino hace mucho tiempo. La ha elegido el exilio...”

fields.subtitle: Roi en Exil
fields.lore: “‘Il s'est détourné de cette voie il y a longtemps. Il a choisi l'exil....'”

fields.subtitle: Re in Esilio
fields.lore: "'Lui devio dal sentiero molio tempo fa. Aveva scelto l'esilio.'"
